Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world.

Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video games industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

As Localization QA Game Tester, you will work within our Localization Quality Assurance team and be the very first person to see the localized game in its entirety – translated text, images and the rest of the user interface collectively. You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. You will work in a multilingual project team ensuring that the game is free from grammatical errors, cultural inconsistencies and ultimately ensuring that the game is accurately localized into the target language.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Identify and correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language errors.
  • Ensure adherence to console manufacturer guidelines.
  • Log details of errors and issues, providing improvement suggestions.
  • Ensure accurate translation within context and maintain consistency in terminology and imagery.
  • Identify missing or incorrect content and ensure proper display/format of dates, calendars, and characters.
  • Write reports on errors and bugs found and perform ad hoc translation.
  • Oversee the quality of your work, collaborate with the team, and contribute to the overall success of projects.

Our Localization QA team conducts language checks on upcoming games across a variety of cutting-edge platforms, including PC, Xbox Series X/S, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation VR2, and various mobile and tablet devices. As an LQA Game Tester, you will be working on top gaming titles for some of the world’s leading publishers.

Requirements

  • No experience required. Just fluency in Polish and conversational in English.
  • Strong cultural understanding of the language you are applying for.
  • Computer literacy – particularly with Excel.
  • Robust Internet research skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Previous experience with using different software, applications, and websites.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely and collaborate within project teams.
  • Candidate must be located within Schengen Area.

What we offer:

  • You will be working for the pre-eminent global provider of specialist services to the games industry and provided with full training and the opportunity to work on some of the biggest game clients, titles, projects, and tech in the world.
  • Attractive remuneration, holidays, regular team competitions with great prizes; and inclusion into an extensive social calendar. Our environments thrive with collaborative teamwork with people from all around the world, different nationalities, and languages.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability. We care about the well-being of our employees and have a dedicated employee well-being program. We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.
  • Learn as you work and be part of something real that changes the face of gaming - forever.
  • Working with a global multi-lingual workforce with superb training and promotion and progression opportunities.

Working Condition:

  • Fully remote within Schengen Area. If you're based in Braga, Portugal, even better!
  • With the possibility of transitioning to a full-time role. However, if you prefer to remain a freelancer, that's perfectly fine!

jobs.excerpt: Why AssemblyAIAssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications.
jobs.description:
Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. Our models serve 600M+ inference calls monthly, process 1M+ hours of audio daily, and power 2 billion+ end-user experiences. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for folks truly excited to join a small team and help define the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - with under 100 people generating roughly $600K ARR per employee, we sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. That's not an accident; it's a deliberate choice to stay lean, move fast, and give every person on the team outsized ownership and impact. With thousands of customers including Granola, Fireflies, Figure AI, and CallRail, the company has real scale - processing over 2 million hours of audio daily and handling more than 1 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven and the trajectory is steep, but the team is still small enough that your fingerprints are on everything.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. For anyone who genuinely cares about voice AI, not as a trend to chase, but as a technology to build, this is the place where the most interesting problems at the most interesting scale are being solved by a team small enough that you'll actually know everyone's name.

We’re committed to creating a space where our employees can bring their full selves to work and have equal opportunity to succeed. No matter your race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, origin, ability, age, veteran status, if joining this mission speaks to you, we encourage you to apply!

About the Role

AssemblyAI builds the foundational speech models behind the Voice AI products our customers build. The people who train those models and build the systems that serve them are some of the hardest people in tech to hire; and we need to hire a lot more of them in 2027.

We’re looking for a Senior Technical Recruiter to own hiring for our Research team and a portfolio of senior Engineering roles: Researchers, Research Engineers, and ML Engineers. You’ll work directly with our research and engineering leaders, and you’ll be expected to understand the work well enough to find, assess, and close people others can’t.

What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for Research and senior Engineering roles, from intake through offer and close
  • Build deep, outbound-first pipelines: map talent at frontier labs, speech and audio teams, and academic groups; track publications, open-source contributors, and conference speakers
  • Partner with research and engineering leaders to define profiles, calibrate on bar, and design quality, efficient interview loops
  • Run thoughtful screens with technical candidates and give hiring managers sharp, evidence-based reads
  • Lead complex closes: competing offers from large labs, equity conversations, and international candidates, in partnership with the People team
  • Build long-term relationships with candidates who aren’t ready to move yet
  • Use data and AI tooling to work faster: smarter sourcing, cleaner Greenhouse pipelines, and clear reporting on funnel health
  • Help the team scale: interviewer training, structured kits, and a candidate experience that reflects how much we care about the work

What You’ll Need

  • 5+ years of technical recruiting, with a track record of hiring ML researchers, research engineers, or ML/infrastructure engineers at AI labs, AI-native startups, or top tech companies
  • A strong outbound sourcing practice and a network in the ML/AI research community
  • Enough technical fluency to talk credibly about model training, evaluation, and inference with researchers, and to tell a strong profile from a keyword match
  • Experience closing senior, sought-after candidates against competing offers, including equity-heavy packages
  • Comfort with Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, JuiceBox (or similar), and modern AI sourcing tools
  • Self-direction: you find the highest-impact work and do it without waiting to be asked

Pay Transparency:

AssemblyAI strives to recruit and retain exceptional talent from diverse backgrounds while ensuring pay equity across our team. Our salary ranges are set to be competitive for our size, stage, and industry, and reflect just one component of the full compensation, benefits, and rewards we offer.

Salary determinations consider a variety of factors, including relevant experience, technical depth, skills demonstrated during the interview process, and maintaining internal equity with peers on the team. The range shared below represents a general expectation for the posted position. However, we are open to considering candidates who may fall above or below the outlined experience level—in those cases, we will communicate any adjustments to the expected salary range.

The range provided applies to candidates located in the United States. For candidates outside of the U.S., compensation ranges may differ; any adjustments will be communicated throughout the interview process.

Compensation: $170,000–$200,000

jobs.companyName: JC Davis Ventures LLC dba JC Davis Power
jobs.description:
At JC Davis Ventures, LLC dba JC Davis Power, we keep work moving with smart, reliable solutions that allow our people and our partners to stay safe, focused, and ahead. Powering a jobsite shouldn't be a hassle. But too often, crews are left waiting, equipment breaks down, vendors go dark, and deadlines slip.

We started JC Davis Power to fix all of that. We're a full-service jobsite operations partner, delivering and maintaining temporary power, climate control, and tower lighting. All with one reliable crew. No handoffs. No confusion.

We show up, solve problems, and do the work the right way. Whether you're supporting customers in the field, building systems behind the scenes, or helping drive the business forward, you'll be part of a team that values reliability, accountability, and getting the job done.

Simple - Reliable - Done Right!

The Role

Every job site we support depends on equipment, fuel, parts, and subcontractors; each tied to an invoice that must be accurate.. As our Accounts Payable Analyst, you will manage the full payables cycle from invoice intake and three-way matching to payment runs, vendor reconciliations, and month-end close.

This is more than processing. You will be the person who spots the coding error before it distorts job costs, who reconciles the vendor statement nobody else wants to touch, and who tells us what our spend is doing. As the business grows, you will help build the payables process that scales with it.

What You'll Do

  • Process the payables volume. Review, code, and enter high volumes of vendor invoices, matching to purchase orders and receiving documentation and resolving discrepancies before they hit the ledger.

  • Own job and GL coding accuracy. Code invoices to the correct general ledger accounts, jobs, and cost categories so project profitability and equipment costs stay clean.

  • Run payments. Prepare and process check, ACH, and card payment runs on schedule, applying payment terms, discounts, and approval requirements.

  • Reconcile vendor accounts. Reconcile vendor statements, research aged and unmatched items, and work directly with vendors to resolve disputes, credits, and short pays.

  • Support month-end close. Prepare AP accruals, reconcile the AP subledger to the general ledger, and clear open items so close is not held up by payables.

  • Report on payables and spend. Build and maintain aging, cash requirement, and vendor spend reporting, and flag trends and exceptions to the Manager, Accounts Payable and Accounting leadership.

  • Improve the process. Identify the bottlenecks and recurring errors in the payables cycle, propose fixes, and help implement automation and workflow improvements in our systems.

  • Keep vendor data and compliance clean. Maintain vendor master records, collect and verify W-9s, support 1099 preparation, and apply sales and use tax treatment correctly.

  • Support audits and internal controls. Pull documentation and provide support for internal reviews and external audit requests, and follow approval and segregation of duties requirements.

  • Partner with the field and operations. Work with managers, purchasing, and shop teams to chase down missing approvals, packing slips, and PO detail to ensure invoices are processed without delay

  • Reconciling credit card accounts. Manage end-to-end reconciliation for high-volume corporate credit card accounts (50+ cards / $100K+ monthly volume), ensuring all transactions are matched with valid receipts, properly coded, and cleared against the general ledger. Investigate and resolve credit card transaction discrepancies, disputed charges, and unapplied credits with vendors and card-issuing banks.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of accounts payable experience, including full cycle, high volume processing

  • Hands on experience with purchase order based invoicing and three-way match

  • Experience reconciling vendor statements and the AP subledger to the general ledger

  • Working knowledge of an ERP or accounting system such as NetSuite, or similar, plus comfort learning new systems

  • Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling large data sets

  • Familiarity with W-9 collection and 1099 reporting

  • Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking your own work

  • Ownership mentality. You work a problem to a finish and bring solutions, not just questions

  • Clear, professional communication with vendors and internal teams

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality with financial and vendor information

  • Self directed and dependable in a remote setting, with consistent availability during business hours

Bonus Points

  • Sales and use tax experience across multiple jurisdictions

  • Multi entity or multi location payables experience

  • Experience with an AP automation or invoice capture tool

  • Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

What We Offer

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this principal development role, with 6+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month, based on experience level and gross amount. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience

About the Role:

We are seeking a hands-on Senior Security Engineer, Network & Zero Trust, to own the network pillar of Sezzle's zero-trust program: every connection explicitly allowed, authenticated by service identity, and attributable after the fact — across our Kubernetes clusters, AWS accounts, and the paths between them.

You will take ownership of our network-policy program — default-deny micro-segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters — and carry the rest of the pillar forward with it: identity-aware service-to-service transport, per-application private access, flow-level visibility, and network configuration managed as reviewed code.

This is an engineering role: you will write the policies, the tooling, and the rollout automation yourself, and you will carry changes through other teams' services without breaking delivery. You will report to the Director of Information Security and work alongside the engineers who own the security platform and detection and response, and with the platform and IAM teams on service identity — your network controls are what their work relies on, and your telemetry is what their detections run on.

At Sezzle, AI-assisted engineering is a standard part of how we work. In this role you will use and build agentic workflows — flow analysis, policy generation from observed traffic, drift review — that let the team segment a large estate.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own east-west segmentation across our Kubernetes clusters: design the segmentation model, derive network policies from observed traffic, and keep every workload reachable only through explicitly allowed, identity-bound paths — a default that holds as the estate grows, not a one-time project.
  • Deliver identity-aware transport — design and roll out mutually authenticated, encrypted service-to-service connections (mTLS), so that authorization decisions rest on verified service identity.
  • Keep a live map of the network: VPC peerings, tunnels, cross-account links, and every public entry point — built from cloud APIs and reconciled continuously, so every path into production is known and justified.
  • Own segmentation of production and the cardholder-data environment: implement and enforce the CDE and high-trust-tier boundaries, review every peering and public exposure against them, and run segmentation testing with the security team.
  • Partner with IT on private access: evaluate and help deliver per-application access (ZTNA) for engineers and operators reaching production systems.
  • Own network telemetry: flow logs east-west and north-south, with enough identity on both ends that "who talked to what, when" is answerable in minutes — and feed it to our SIEM for the detection team.
  • Own cluster admission control and hold the line on drift: workload admission policy (pod security, image provenance, network policy), security groups and firewall rules declared in git, applied only through the IaC pipeline, with admission control at the gate and drift detected and reverted automatically.
  • Contain: build the levers that let us isolate a workload or segment quickly when detection flags lateral movement, and take part in incident response when the network is in play.
  • Participate in threat modeling and design reviews for anything that changes how traffic flows, and in the on-call rotation for the controls you own.

What We Look For:

  • 6+ years of experience in security, network, platform, or infrastructure engineering, with hands-on ownership of network controls in cloud production environments.
  • Deep, practical Kubernetes networking knowledge: CNI, NetworkPolicy semantics, DNS, ingress/egress — and experience rolling segmentation out on live clusters without outages.
  • Strong AWS networking: VPCs, subnets, security groups, peering and Transit Gateway, PrivateLink, load balancers, flow logs.
  • Hands-on experience with mTLS and service-to-service authentication (service mesh, proxies, or CNI-level encryption).
  • Infrastructure as code as your default way of working — Terraform and Helm or equivalents, through merge requests and CI, across repositories you don't own.
  • Ability to write real code (Go, Python, or Bash) for tooling and automation, not only configuration.
  • Ability to investigate directly with packet captures, flow logs, and system-level data.
  • Working knowledge of PCI DSS network requirements — segmentation, scoping of the cardholder-data environment, segmentation testing.
  • Demonstrated AI-forward engineering: you actively use AI tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or custom LLM integrations) in your work today and have opinions grounded in practice about where it helps and where it doesn't.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Cilium / eBPF in production, including Hubble or equivalent flow observability.
  • mTLS at fleet scale, including certificate lifecycle — service mesh (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Cilium service mesh) and workload identity standards such as SPIFFE/SPIRE.
  • You have built AI-assisted workflows that others adopted — flow analysis, policy generation, drift review.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying ZTNA / identity-aware proxy products. ● Policy-as-code and admission control (OPA/Gatekeeper, Kyverno, conftest).
  • Experience with network detection — IDS/IPS, anomalous-flow and lateral-movement detection — and with containment during incidents.
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 and with FFIEC-style examination expectations for network security. ● Experience in fintech, payments, BNPL, or other regulated environments.

About You:

  • You'd rather close a path than document it - an allow-list that exists in production beats a diagram of how the network should look.
  • You change other teams' systems without breaking them - you roll out in observe mode first, measure, and earn the right to enforce.
  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer and AI-driven, focus on automated end-to-end, integration, and unit tests
  • Open Source: Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Responsibility areas and specific assignments are based on the needs of the school and capabilities of the faculty member. Faculty assignments and areas of emphasis may vary significantly from school to school; however, the position is structured to ensure the faculty member is able to contribute optimally to essential teaching and related support services to learners.

Job Skills:


Teaching and Assessment and/or Doctoral Mentoring:

Refers to the ability to enable learner academic progression, provide guidance, and enhance learner experience.

  • Understand and apply Capella’s competency-based education model that aligns program outcomes, competencies, assessments, and reports with external standards and Capella educational philosophy to improve learning.
  • Convey and share content knowledge and relevant professional experience in the discipline.
  • Facilitate learner acquisition of course and/or research competencies aligned with their program.

  • Monitor learner progress and achievement and refers students to additional resources as needed.

  • Effectively manage key online course and/or advanced doctoral processes and tools.
  • Provide a timely, visible, consistent, and responsive presence in the courseroom and/or mentoring process, and communicate appropriately and respectfully.
  • Encourage learner engagement consistent with the learner code of conduct and support the free exchange of ideas.

Research and Scholarship:

These activities advance teaching and mentoring as well as professional development. Activity varies by person and field. Meeting research and scholarship requirements as defined by external accreditors, where appropriate. Schools may identify focus areas of research, specific conferences, or professional journals.

  • Scholarship for applying innovative teaching methods, especially those that can be empirically validated as having a positive impact on learner success (e.g., course success, continuation, graduation).
  • Submit proposals and/or present at workshops or conferences (internally and externally).
  • Showcase original/innovative work/exhibition.
  • Maintain an active research agenda.
  • Attend professional development events, attain continuing education credits, and pursue additional credentials.
  • Present research (whether applied or teaching-focused).
  • Submit paper and/or publish at industry-recognized channels.

Professional Service and Practice:

Includes external-facing activities related to students, institution, profession, and/or community. Activities increase the service of the institution and strengthen its external reputation. Meeting professional service and practice requirements as defined by external accreditors, where appropriate. In most situations, the activities are with reduced fee/pro bono/honorarium.

  • To students: Career and well-being advising, leading student organizations, guidance on learning and projects outside of courseroom, learner-facing webinars.
  • To institution: Providing support for institutional activities with external audience (e.g., presentations for employer partners, job fairs, representing the institution at conferences).
  • To profession: Leadership in organizations or professional associations, advocacy for the advancement of the profession and communities served, organize professional conferences.
  • To community: Sharing knowledge with the public, volunteer for community-based events with their expertise (e.g., volunteering at clinics for underprivileged communities).

Governance and Leadership:

Include internal-facing activities to increase the effectiveness of the institution, the school, and faculty practice.

  • Active participation in appropriate program, department, school, or university committees, providing expertise and perspectives to advance university and school’s strategic direction.
  • Active participation in faculty staff meetings, Capella-sponsored faculty development, and other faculty-focused events (e.g. CU Faculty Virtual Conference), including sharing best practices, providing personal expertise via different communication channels, promoting better community support among peers, etc.
  • Serve as SMEs in course and program development; support for accreditation efforts; and serve in pilot groups for innovation projects at program, school, or university levels.
  • Identify and orchestrate the proactive management of curriculum content quality and currency. Demonstrate expertise in evaluating and coordinating the ongoing assessment of content to ensure its relevance, accuracy, and up-to-date nature.
  • Take on additional, challenging projects to serve the needs of the school or university in support of student success.
  • Provide mentorship, feedback, and guidance to other faculty members when appropriate.

Performance Criteria:

Satisfactory performance of teaching and/or mentoring activities based on the university faculty expectations is required and will be reviewed as part of the annual plan of work and review process.


Work Experience:


  • Expertise in biostatistics, epidemiology, policy analysis, or program evaluation is required.
  • Experience with how to conduct and oversee public health research is required.
  • Two or more years teaching is required. Teaching in an online setting is preferred.
  • A strong background in qualitative research methods, GIS mapping, financial management, or project management is a plus.
  • Teaching experience in higher education is preferred.
  • Experience mentoring doctoral students is preferred.
  • Experience writing curriculum is preferred.
  • Knowledge of CEPH accreditation standards and CEPH curriculum development experience is preferred.
  • Membership/affiliation in an educational leadership organization on a national, regional, and/or local level.
  • Demonstrated commitment to service and practice in the field of educational leadership.
  • Experience with leadership through team engagement.
  • Evidence of supporting learner success and a commitment to quality teaching outcomes.
  • Ability to contribute through teaching and/or service to the diversity, cultural sensitivity, and excellence of the academic community.
  • Experience presenting at professional conferences on a national and/or local level.
  • Experience with scholarly writing and use of APA 7th edition.


Education:

  • A doctoral degree in public health is required.
  • All degrees must be conferred and from a regionally accredited institution. Copies of required certificates and licenses and unofficial transcripts for all graduate degrees with the institution and conferred degree and date must be attached.

Other:

In accordance with ADA policies, reasonable accommodations regarding travel limitations can be provided. Travel will be more common for roles such as Account Executives (25 - 50%), senior leaders (10 – 20%) or all levels of Capella Faculty (5 – 10%).

  • Must be able to work more than 40 hours per week when business needs warrant. Accommodations related to schedule may be considered.Able to access information using a computer.

Work Location Details:

Employees working out of a home office are responsible for providing appropriate and safe office space, office furniture and organization, communication tools, and related items. These include:

★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Bilingual Dental Patient Coordinator

Location: Remote - Nicaragua
Employment Type: Full-Time
Industry: Dental Services / Healthcare Administration
Compensation:$1,280 USD per month
Language Requirements: Fluent English (C1+) and Spanish

About the Company

Our client is a U.S.-based dental practice committed to providing patients with a professional, welcoming, and well-organized healthcare experience.

The practice relies on effective communication, accurate scheduling, insurance coordination, and dependable administrative support to ensure patients receive timely assistance throughout their dental care journey.

The team is looking for a remote professional who can help streamline daily front-office operations while maintaining a high standard of patient service.

About the Role

We are hiring a Bilingual Dental Patient Coordinator to provide remote front-office and administrative support for a busy dental practice in the United States.

In this position, you will serve as an important point of contact for patients, assisting with appointments, insurance-related inquiries, patient records, and daily administrative requests.

You will communicate with patients in English and Spanish, coordinate with the dental team, and help ensure that appointments, documentation, and patient requests are handled accurately and efficiently.

This role is well suited for someone with experience in U.S. dental or healthcare administration who enjoys patient interaction, works well under pressure, and can independently manage multiple priorities.

What You'll Do

Patient Relations & Communication

  • Serve as a primary contact for patients through phone calls, email, and text messaging.

  • Manage incoming inquiries and conduct outbound calls when follow-up is needed.

  • Communicate clearly and professionally with English- and Spanish-speaking patients.

  • Provide appointment reminders and follow up regarding scheduled treatments.

  • Address routine questions and help patients navigate administrative processes.

  • Support a positive patient experience through responsive and empathetic communication.

Dental Appointment Management

  • Coordinate patient appointments, including new bookings, confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.

  • Maintain accurate provider calendars and appointment information.

  • Assist with scheduling adjustments to support efficient clinic operations.

  • Communicate scheduling updates to patients and the dental team.

  • Help reduce administrative delays through timely reminders and follow-up.

Dental Insurance & Payment Coordination

  • Review and verify patient insurance eligibility and benefits.

  • Gather coverage information and confirm relevant insurance details before visits.

  • Assist with dental billing activities and payment posting.

  • Support insurance claims follow-up and related documentation.

  • Help patients understand routine insurance and payment information.

  • Escalate complex insurance or billing questions to the appropriate team members.

Patient Records & Office Administration

  • Assist with patient registration, intake information, and demographic updates.

  • Enter and update information in dental practice management systems.

  • Maintain organized and accurate electronic patient records.

  • Complete administrative tasks, data entry, and routine reporting.

  • Coordinate with internal staff to ensure patient requests are properly addressed.

  • Handle sensitive patient information in accordance with HIPAA requirements.

Qualifications

Required

  • Fluent English and Spanish, both written and spoken.

  • Advanced English proficiency (C1 or higher).

  • At least 1–2 years of relevant experience in U.S. dental administration, healthcare administration, dental reception, medical scheduling, or insurance coordination.

  • Familiarity with dental office procedures and patient-facing administrative workflows.

  • Experience supporting appointment scheduling and insurance verification.

  • Knowledge of dental practice management software, such as Dentrix, Eaglesoft, Open Dental, or comparable platforms.

  • Strong telephone communication and patient service skills.

  • Ability to handle several administrative responsibilities while maintaining accuracy.

  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

  • Understanding of patient confidentiality and HIPAA-compliant information handling.

  • Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with a remote team.

Preferred

  • Clear, professional spoken English with a neutral accent.

  • Previous experience supporting a U.S.-based dental office remotely.

  • Experience with insurance claims follow-up, payment posting, and patient billing inquiries.

  • Familiarity with patient engagement and treatment follow-up processes.

What Makes a Strong Candidate?

We are particularly interested in professionals who demonstrate:

  • Patient-centered communication: You can make patients feel heard, respected, and supported.

  • Administrative accuracy: You pay close attention to scheduling details, insurance information, and patient records.

  • Ownership: You follow through on pending requests without constant supervision.

  • Adaptability: You can shift between phone calls, scheduling, insurance questions, and documentation.

  • Problem-solving: You identify issues early and take appropriate action.

  • Team collaboration: You communicate effectively with dental professionals and administrative staff.

How Success Is Measured

  • Patient calls, messages, and inquiries receive timely responses.

  • Appointment calendars are maintained accurately and efficiently.

  • Insurance information is verified and documented correctly.

  • Billing and claims-related administrative tasks are completed with appropriate follow-up.

  • Patient records remain complete, organized, and confidential.

  • Patients receive clear communication regarding appointments and administrative matters.

  • The dental team receives reliable support that contributes to smooth daily operations.

Why Join Us?

  • Work 100% remotely while supporting a U.S.-based dental practice.

  • Build specialized experience in dental administration and patient coordination.

  • Use your bilingual communication skills in a patient-facing healthcare environment.

  • Gain exposure to dental scheduling, insurance verification, and office operations.

  • Take on a meaningful role that supports both patient satisfaction and clinic efficiency.

Important Notes

  • English C1+ and fluent Spanish are mandatory.

  • Previous experience in U.S. dental or healthcare administration is required.

  • Candidates should be comfortable handling inbound and outbound patient calls.

  • Familiarity with dental practice management systems is expected.

  • This position involves confidential patient information and requires strict attention to HIPAA compliance.

This is a fully remote position.

Change, Enablement + Sustainment

Preferred Experience

  • Familiarity with performance measurement methodologies, change frameworks, and enablement strategies.

What Success Looks Like

jobs.title: Chief Product Officer
jobs.excerpt: DescriptionMuse Group's products — spanning learning, playing, creating, publishing, and buying music — reach over 100 million musicians, creators, teachers, and music lovers worldwide.
jobs.description:
Description

Muse Group's products — spanning learning, playing, creating, publishing, and buying music — reach over 100 million musicians, creators, teachers, and music lovers worldwide. Today these are strong but standalone products. Our next chapter is to turn them into one connected ecosystem, where a person moves naturally between learning, playing, practicing, creating and where each product makes the others stronger. The goal is simple: the portfolio should be worth more to the user together than each product on its own.

We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to lead that chapter. This is a mandate to build, not to maintain. Few places in the industry combine this much audience, this much love for the products, and this much still-unwritten product architecture on top of them. You get a rare mix: a ready audience of 100M+, deep content libraries, one of the strongest organic platforms in music, and a clean sheet to assemble it into a connected product. We are starting AI almost from zero, not optimizing an existing layer, so what AI-native means for Muse is yours to define. And all of it is about music and musicians, not product management as an end in itself.

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in Europe or Cyprus.

Key responsibilities

Group product strategy. Where the portfolio goes; where products stay independent, where they share capabilities, where connecting them creates new value. From priorities to a coherent roadmap, investment model, and product architecture.

One ecosystem for musicians. The connective layer — shared identity, personalization, content portability, cross-product discovery, shared libraries. You make the transitions between products natural and mutually reinforcing.

A North Star for each product — and for the group. For every product, one measure of the real value it creates for the user. And as products connect, a single North Star for the whole ecosystem. This is the compass teams steer by.

The customer lifecycle. You own the whole arc — from first touch to lasting habit: how people arrive, activate, come back, get more value, and stay. We judge product success by that, not by short-term conversion. Monetization strengthens the user relationship instead of working against it.

AI-native product. Define what AI changes in learning, practice, creation, search, and discovery, and build a focused portfolio of AI initiatives with real user value — a product, not a set of demos.

The team and its leaders. Build an exceptional global product organization and grow strong product leaders under each product, so the team is durable, not dependent on one person.

Requirements

An established product leader who has worked at portfolio or ecosystem level, not a single product, and who combines strategic range with closeness to users, data, and product quality.

  • Led consumer products, platforms, or digital ecosystems at significant scale.
  • A demonstrated record of growing retention, engagement, and user value.
  • Systems thinking — can assemble an architecture across products, users, and data.
  • Grew strong product leaders instead of keeping decisions to themselves.

What matters to us:

We are looking for someone who thinks in outcomes for the user and the business, not roadmap length; who can protect a product's long-term value from the pull of short-term monetization; who builds a team instead of carrying it alone. The opposite stops us: success measured by feature velocity, treating AI as a tool rollout, and an inability to work without a fully prescribed process.

The Lead Site Reliability Engineer will continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve critical technical problems for Allergan Aesthetics. You will be a hands-on technical leader driving reliability, availability, and operational excellence for large-scale public-facing software. As part of the Cloud Platform team, you will own how we measure, protect, and improve production reliability — championing SRE practices, building resilience into our platform, and ensuring our services meet the availability and performance standards our customers expect. You will provide technical thought leadership, mentor engineers across the organization, and turn small ideas into high-fidelity technical game plans that achieve both reliability and business goals.

Reliability Engineering:

  • Define and champion SLO/SLI frameworks and error budget-based decision making to drive prioritization between reliability and feature work.
  • Own observability strategy across services — metrics, logs, traces, and alerting — ensuring signals are actionable and tied to user impact.
  • Lead capacity planning, load testing, and resilience/chaos testing for critical public-facing services.
  • Establish production readiness reviews and partner with development teams to improve services through rigorous testing and release procedures.
  • Identify and eliminate toil through automation, self-healing systems, and improved observability.
  • Gather and analyze metrics from operating systems and applications to drive performance tuning and fault finding.
  • Contribute reliability improvements to the platform through infrastructure-as-code (Terraform) and Kubernetes configuration, working within Cloud Platform team standards.

Incident Management & Response:

  • Own and evolve the incident response process, including severity definitions, escalation paths, and postmortem practice.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and provide hands-on support during incidents with appropriate urgency.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure and application issues, driving blameless root cause analysis and tracking corrective actions to completion.

Standards & Architecture:

  • Champion reliability, scalability, and security standards across AA Tech services and the AA Tech product platform.
  • Partner and inform strategic architecture decisions for new services and major platform changes for reliability risks (failure modes, redundancy, scaling limits, alerting) before launch as part of Cloud Platform design reviews.
  • Define and maintain reliability standards (e.g., SLO coverage, alerting, runbooks, backup and recovery requirements) and track how services meet them
  • Stay current with the latest trends in site/service reliability practices and tooling. Identify proven technologies and solutions for emerging challenges.

Technical Mentorship:

  • Provide technical mentorship and guidance to senior-level DevOps and Software Engineers utilizing proven design patterns and experience building large-scale public-facing software.
  • Foster a culture of operational excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the engineering organization.
  • Provide technical thought leadership to implement strategic architecture, systems, and projects on the roadmap.
  • Proven track record running SLO/error budget programs and incident management for large-scale production systems.
  • Deep experience with observability platforms (e.g., Datadog) and alert design.
  • Working proficiency with Terraform and Kubernetes on AWS; comfortable reading, reviewing, and contributing infrastructure code.
  • Strong scripting/programming skills (e.g., Python, Go) for automation and tooling.

Our Guiding Principles

  • Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don’t hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.
  • Help Customers Win. We learn our customers’ businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.
  • Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.
  • Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don’t wait to be asked.
  • Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the strategy and roadmap for Built’s data capabilities, including embedded reporting and analytics, portfolio dashboards, data exports, and data sharing integrations.
  • Get close to how lenders, owners, and GCs use data to make decisions, and turn that into sharp problem statements and requirements.
  • Partner with data engineering on data models, pipelines, and data quality so the numbers customers see are accurate and on time.
  • Drive shared metric definitions so a figure like “percent complete” or “funds disbursed” means the same thing in every product and every customer workspace.
  • Work with the CLA, CLA+ and payments product teams so data is captured well at the source instead of cleaned up downstream.
  • Shape the data that powers Built’s AI features, including the AI Draw Agent and lender portfolio risk tools.
  • Track adoption and impact of your products and use what you learn to decide what to build next.
  • Support sales and customer success with demos, customer conversations, and enablement on platform reporting and data features.

What You’ll Bring

  • 5–8 years of product management experience, with at least 2 years owning data, analytics or reporting products in B2B SaaS.
  • Strong SQL and comfort working directly in the data. You can answer your own questions and validate what engineering builds.
  • Working knowledge of modern data stack concepts: warehouses, ELT, dimensional modeling, and BI or embedded analytics tools such as Sigma, Looker or Tableau.
  • Experience writing requirements for data work that a data engineer can build against, including metric definitions, data contracts and acceptance criteria.
  • A track record of shipping data features and analytics capabilities that customers adopt.
  • Ability to explain data concepts clearly to bankers and engineers alike.
  • Experience in financial services, lending, real estate, or construction is a strong plus.

What Success Looks Like at Six Months

  • You’ve published a data roadmap that product, engineering, and go-to-market leaders have bought into.
  • At least one data feature improvement has shipped, and you can show its adoption with real usage numbers.
  • Core reporting metrics have agreed definitions and named owners, and customer escalations about numbers not matching are trending down.
  • Product teams across the business treat you as their partner for anything data related.

AI & Technology Expectations

  • Leverage AI tools to enhance the productivity, quality, and speed of your work.
  • Use AI to support drafting, analysis, summarization, and problem-solving across your role.

We’re a games studio focused on building games that bring people together.

We aim to hire multi-talented individuals who can operate autonomously and at speed, with every role at the studio being hands-on working directly on our games.

Role Overview

We’re looking to bring on a Senior 3D Generalist Artist for a 6 month contract, with potential to extend further depending on how things go.

We’re looking for a Senior 3D Generalist Artist that has experience building modular environments and character art, to contribute to art production on an exciting unannounced co-op combat game.

Key Responsibilities

1 - Create Game-Ready Art

You’ll mainly be working on modular environments, props, set dressing and character / creature work.

Success looks like:

  • Understanding our art ethos and working autonomously with high level direction
  • Grasping the project art style and adapting quickly
  • Understanding how to construct modular environments and working to a grid
  • Rapid output by focusing on getting the core elements right rather than superficial details

2 - Be a Force Multiplayer, Not Just an Asset Maker

There’s more to it than just creating assets, it’s about being an invaluable team member.

Success looks like:

  • Communicating and collaborating with the team. Nurturing the synergy between disciplines and problem solving the gaps in-between
  • Joining playtests and contributing to the game experience beyond art
  • Identifying risks and constraints early and redirecting effort when needed
  • Being pro-active and moving the project forward, even if you’re waiting for feedback or currently blocked, you know how to identify meaningful work to keep momentum

3 - Implement Assets in Engine

You’re not just handing off art assets, you’re implementing them in-engine.

Success looks like:

  • Importing, setting up and hooking up assets
  • Correctly handling setup for materials, prefabs, folders and naming etc
  • Fixing materials, collision and general art bugs in engine
  • Spotting inefficiencies and offering better solutions
  • Keeping assets and scenes well optimized without sacrificing the game’s vision

Requirements

  • Senior experience level. Comfortable working autonomously with high level direction, championing your area of responsibility
  • Broad artistic & technical skillset: environments, props, characters / creatures
  • Confident in Unity; asset implementation and fixing art bugs
  • Comfortable in Blender (preferred) or able to transition quickly

  • Bonus skills: Rigging, VFX, UI, Tech Art skills, Concept Art

This Associate Territory Production Underwriter - Middle Market Commercial Lines will support the Commercial Middle Market Business Development Team. The territory for this position is Arizona. The qualified candidate will reside in Arizona ideally Phoenix metro but flexible.


Job Description Summary

On our team, we look for that rare professional who is both analytical and a relationship-builder. Those who can combine those talents with their entrepreneurial drive and own and manage their territory can thrive and grow with us. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, we want to hear from you!

As an Associate Territory Manager, You'll be the primary relationship manager for middle market new and renewal business, through direct contact with a territory of select agencies or brokers. We'll count on you to drive profit and premium to meet financial goals and objectives through development, negotiation and execution of business plans. Your leadership and influencing skills will be key as you help agencies create and implement sales strategies, processes and practices that drive new sales, increase shelf space, profit and member retention. Your collaboration with internal partners will be important to support and increase the overall Nationwide presence.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Underwrites new business, renewals and endorsements based on authority level and appetite. Decisions at this level may require review of additional variables, leveraging agency, sales and underwriting relationships, inspection reports and evaluation of exceptions.

  • Reviews individual risks for acceptability and handles those within authority based on company underwriting guidelines and standards. Analyzes quality and quantity of risks underwritten and prepares reports accordingly. May review agency books of business as well as profit/growth results and trends to recommend and implement action plans. May perform portfolio analysis or additional underwriting analysis in support of unit objectives.

  • Monitors market conditions, competitive landscape, and confirms information gathered within market space. Researches risk, environment and factors necessary to win the account.

  • Achieves production, profitability and service objectives. Quotes, prices and underwrites new and renewal policies and endorsements, primarily for complex or service sensitive accounts. Monitors risk selection and pricing decisions for entire agency plant, both on a book of business and individual account level basis.

  • Manages workflow and intricacies of underwriting assigned work by utilizing company tools and systems. Ensures file handling quality and workflow efficiency. Manages large, complex work and coordinates work with and through others to meet service level agreements. Effectively influences activities of Middle Market Business Development Team to facilitate the successful delivery and execution of select agency business plans.

  • Completes agency visits as appropriate to develop new accounts, service existing accounts, review agency performance, enhance agency relationship and to develop business solutions. Consults with agencies regarding risk management and coverage options to improve retention and profitability. Develops and maintains strong business relationships with agencies, producers and key groups. Effectively communicates with agencies to establish the company as the provider of choice for the territory for all enterprise products with an emphasis on commercial lines. Communicates product, technology changes and company objectives. Communicates and collaborates actively with team members and leadership to share industry trends, and field underwriting experience.

  • Drives robust agency business planning to deliver detailed performance plans with actions, account abilities and scheduled performance checkpoints. Ensures strong territorial objectives to maximize profit and pipeline management. Proactively identifies opportunities for all lines of business and refers to appropriate business leaders. Plans and coordinates the efforts of the Middle Market Business Development Team regarding new business, renewals, service plans, etc. Identifies prospects and recommends new agency appointments.

  • Markets Nationwide products and services to help drive agency and company results, including all enterprise products that may enhance offerings. Assists agency with strategies for pipeline management, producer development and to develop new business in targeted industries and preferred markets. Responds effectively to assess accounts and develop business propositions that win the business.

  • Leads delivery of appropriate customer service levels. Follows up and ensures proper handling of escalated customer service requests.

  • Ensures that tools, training and support are in place to positively impact success for the agencies and territory. Identifies and communicates training needs and opportunities. Participates in program and product orientation meetings in conjunction with Sales/Marketing partners as the underwriting subject matter expert.

  • Monitors business plan results to determine performance and development of any action plans to ensure alignment with underwriting philosophies, standards and performance expectations. Reviews business in process, lost business and drives implementation of business plan. Leads discussion for assigned agents in agency reviews.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to MM Business Development Director. Individual contributor.

Typical Skills and Experiences:

Education: Undergraduate degree in business administration or management preferred. Technical insurance coursework toward designations of CPCU, CLU, FLMI, etc. is desirable.

Experience: Three years Commercial Lines underwriting experience required, additional sales experience preferred. Successful completion of the first phase (training) of the Associate Territory Manager role required.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: Ability to manage heavy workload effectively and backup other team members as needed. Thorough working knowledge of commercial underwriting, pricing and coverage for commercial business. Knowledge of company sales and underwriting standards and practices company commercial products and programs. Knowledge of state statutes and regulations. Excellent interpersonal and sales skills. Ability to build and maintain cooperative and mutually rewarding internal and external partnerships. Must have the ability to perform duties with independent judgment with underwriting authority and company underwriting standards. Demonstrated decision-making ability required in day-to-day operations where there may be unclear or competing priorities, including evaluating and recommending solutions to customer service, work processing, underwriting selection and rating and best practices compliance. Strong drive for results.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the hiring manager’s leader and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job Conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Not Eligible (Exempt)

Working Conditions: Heavy travel with extended stays may be required. Most incumbents work from a remote location. A valid drivers license and safe driving record are required.

ADA: The above statements cover what are generally believed to be principal and essential functions of this job. Specific circumstances may allow or require some people assigned to the job to perform a somewhat different combination of duties.

Benefits

We have an array of benefits to fit your needs, including: medical/dental/vision,life insurance, short and long term disability coverage, paid time off with newly hired associates receiving a minimum of 18 days paid time off each full calendar year pro-rated quarterly based on hire date, nine paid holidays, 8 hours of Lifetime paid time off, 8 hours of Unity Day paid time off, 401(k) with company match, company-paid pension plan, business casual attire, and more. To learn more about the benefits we offer,click here.

No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is subsequently hired as a result of the referral or through other means.

  • Apply Colleague expertise to support financial aid processing and, for funky-tech assignments, system configuration, rules, testing, and troubleshooting.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (North America - Remote)
jobs.excerpt: tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.
jobs.description:
tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.

We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it:

Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our public Town Halls for yourself:

Hospitable.com is a remote-only and fully distributed company. We hire based on timezones.

What you will be working on

Your mission is to help our customers build more successful short-term rental businesses while driving revenue growth for Hospitable.

This isn't a traditional Customer Success role focused primarily on answering questions, managing relationships, or preventing churn. We're building a proactive, commercially driven Success team that helps customers discover opportunities, get more value from our platform, and grow their businesses.

You'll own a revenue quota, and your ability to consistently meet or exceed that quota will be the primary measure of your success.

You'll do this through the following:

  • Revenue Growth & Expansion: Own and achieve quarterly revenue targets through subscription upgrades, annual conversions, feature adoption, and additional products and services. You'll proactively identify opportunities within our existing customer base and turn those conversations into measurable revenue.
  • Consultative Selling: Get to know our customers, their businesses, and what they're trying to accomplish. Whether they're managing one property or hundreds, you'll identify opportunities to help them save time, increase revenue, and operate more efficiently using Hospitable.
  • Proactive Customer Engagement: Don't wait for customers to reach out. You'll actively engage customers through scheduled meetings, personalized outreach, and targeted campaigns to uncover opportunities, demonstrate value, and drive action.
  • Product Adoption & Monetization: Help customers discover and adopt features that can make a meaningful difference in their businesses, including Direct Booking, Dynamic Pricing, Upsells, and other revenue-generating tools. You'll connect product capabilities to real business outcomes and identify opportunities to expand their investment in Hospitable.
  • Customer Education & Workshops: Lead engaging 1:1 consultations, group workshops, and product demonstrations that help customers get more from Hospitable. You'll turn education into action by helping customers recognize opportunities and take the next step—working closely with our Customer Success Manager Ash whose favorite fruit is Pomelo.
  • Strategic Account Management: Work with high-value customers through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and ongoing conversations to understand their goals, identify gaps in their current setup, and develop recommendations that support their growth and expand their use of Hospitable.
  • Pipeline & Performance Ownership: Build and manage your own pipeline of opportunities, maintain accurate CRM records, and consistently follow through on customer conversations. You'll be responsible for your activity, pipeline health, forecasting, and ultimately your results.
  • Customer Advocacy & Collaboration: Bring customer feedback, challenges, and ideas back to our product and support teams. You'll work closely with teammates to help customers succeed while identifying new opportunities for Hospitable to deliver value.

What success looks like

We believe great Customer Success Managers create value for customers and measurable growth for the company.

You'll be successful in this role when you're consistently achieving your revenue quota, building a healthy pipeline of opportunities, helping customers adopt valuable features, and turning customer conversations into meaningful business outcomes.

We give our team the autonomy to own their results. You'll have support, tools, and coaching along the way, but we expect you to take initiative, find opportunities, and be accountable for your performance.

If you love helping people, enjoy the challenge of selling, and get excited about being rewarded for the results you deliver, you'll feel right at home here.

Requirements

For this position, your location is not a requirement. The ideal fit would work under North American timezones.

Don't tick all the boxes? Talk to us about why you're still an amazing fit. The successful candidate will demonstrate how they are uniquely qualified for this role and will be someone that we cannot wait to start working with.

  • Sales & Revenue Experience: 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Account Executive, or a similar customer-facing role, ideally within SaaS. We're particularly interested in candidates who have carried revenue quotas and consistently met or exceeded their targets.
  • Commercial Mindset: You naturally look for opportunities to grow accounts, expand product adoption, and generate revenue. You're comfortable discussing pricing, presenting value, handling objections, and asking customers to make a purchase decision.
  • Consultative Approach: You know that great selling starts with understanding the customer. You're curious, ask thoughtful questions, uncover business challenges, and recommend solutions that genuinely make sense for the customer.
  • Self-Motivation & Accountability: You thrive in an environment where you're trusted to manage your own time and results. You're proactive, organized, comfortable with performance targets, and motivated by the opportunity to earn more through strong performance.
  • Excellent Communication: You're confident leading customer conversations, delivering presentations, and communicating clearly through email, video calls, and other channels. You can make complex products easy to understand and compelling to use.
  • Pipeline & CRM Management: You understand how to build and manage a sales pipeline, prioritize opportunities, follow up consistently, and maintain accurate records. You're comfortable using CRM tools and performance data to guide your daily activities.
  • Technical Curiosity: You enjoy learning software, exploring new features, and showing customers how technology can improve their businesses. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable demonstrating and explaining software.
  • Problem-Solving & Adaptability: You're resourceful, comfortable working independently, and willing to try new approaches when something isn't working. You see challenges as opportunities to learn and improve.
  • Team Collaboration: You enjoy sharing ideas, learning from others, and working with cross-functional teams. You're competitive with your own goals while being genuinely invested in the success of the team.

Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality technology, property management, or revenue management is a plus, but not required.

Benefits

The company itself is also a product, one that we iterate on. We're always improving and creating an environment where we all love to work.

  • A supportive, radically transparent, and caring team environment, where you are trusted, not managed—and a culture that is focused on results and output.
  • The compensation depends on your location, status, and level within our salary bands which will be shared during the interview process. We can hire talent internationally as contractors—or employees if you are based in the United States, the European Union, or Australia, taking into account payroll taxes to determine your gross compensation. For contractors, the total cost could range from USD$72,000.00 - USD$106,700.00. For US employees, the gross salary could range from USD$66,385.10 to USD$98,379.04.
  • In addition to the above mentioned salary budget, a performance bonus (no cap) is available (paid quarterly) based on quota attainment, achieved from hitting up/cross sell targets.
  • We also offer options into the company equity through our $HOST token (RSU's), with a current grant value of up to $9,700.00, to share in the long-term upside value of the company.
  • Separately, this role is eligible for up to an additional USD $230,756.00 per year in Performance Share Units (PSUs). These PSUs do not vest over time and are granted only upon the achievement of clearly defined business performance targets. The size and payout of this award are directly tied to measurable outcomes and are intended to strongly align compensation with company impact.
  • 35 days off per year, encouraged (including self-serve public holidays) and parental leave.
  • For US employees: healthcare (including EPO, PPO and HSA), 401(k).
  • Complimentary mental health and emotional support with therapists on call through Slack by Spill.
  • Earn virtual coins through our peer recognition platform and redeem them through gift cards, donations, or monetary rewards.

About the role:

Bixal is seeking a Content Strategist / Information Architect for a project that supports a large-scale outreach and engagement effort, delivering strategic communications, content and creative services, digital strategy, and audience engagement across public-facing websites, applications, and social media platforms. The work is paired with the IT, cybersecurity, and data operations needed to keep that digital presence secure, reliable, and available around the clock. The program's mission is to ensure the intended audience receives timely, accurate, and accessible information about the programs, services, and policies that affect them — with content and platforms built to scale, adapt to changing needs, and hold up to federal compliance and security standards.

The Content Strategist / Information Architect shapes how content is planned, structured, and organized across the program's public-facing websites and applications so that users can find, understand, and act on information efficiently. This role guides content strategy across its full lifecycle, from audience research and planning through development, ongoing management, governance, and publishing, while contributing information-architecture expertise to usability testing, content governance, and search discoverability.

This is a full-time position contingent on contract award by our client, with a defined performance period of one year with two one-year option periods. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our inclusive, purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

  • Review content within the CMS for clarity, findability, accessibility, and usability, recommending structural, navigational, or governance improvements informed by data and user needs.

  • Establish and document information-architecture standards and permissions structures that support consistent content governance and auditability.

  • Ensure content structure and metadata remain consistent across distribution channels and rendering formats during publishing.

  • Design and participate in usability testing, contributing IA-specific test scenarios (e.g., card sorting, tree testing, navigation tasks) and translating findings into structural recommendations.

  • Partner with SEO and digital strategy teams on keyword-informed taxonomy and site-structure decisions that support both user experience and organic search performance.

jobs.description:
About Afton Partners

Afton Partnersis an impact-driven consultancy that reimagines and implements systems, policies, and practices that improve lives. We bring technical savvy and a relational approach to partnerships with clients across the early care and education, K-12, higher education, and workforce development sectors. Since 2011, Afton has collaborated on more than 150 initiatives in 40 states, and our clients include state and local government agencies, public school systems, charter schools, and philanthropies. We’re creative, committed, and energized by complexity. Together, we can solve our toughest societal challenges and co-create a future where each person has the opportunity for growth and fulfillment.

About the role

Afton Partners seeks a Senior Director to lead strategic finance initiatives with our charter school client partners around the country. As the national leader in charter school financial planning and governance, we’ve partnered with more than 80 networks serving public school students in a wide range of communities in over 30 states.

Recently, a Charter School CFO reflected on our work together, saying, “This project has fundamentally changed how our organization approaches financial planning, governance, and decision-making. Working closely with [Afton team members], we replaced a more traditional, static budgeting approach with a seven-year, scenario-based financial forecast that incorporates inflationary cost assumptions and long-term sustainability metrics.”

This is a full-time, remote position within the United States, requiring up to 10% travel. Afton offers competitive pay and benefits, including health insurance, paid time off, and 401(k) with company match. The salary range for the position is $160,000-$180,000 per year.

What you'll do

If you enjoy and excel at these responsibilities, this position may be a great opportunity for you.

Directly advise school leaders on critical financial decisions.

  • Navigate difficult situations and discussions by building and leveraging trusting, collaborative, and effective relationships with school leaders, boards, and their financial partners.
  • Directly advise charter school boards, CEOs, CFOs, and other leaders on critical opportunities to improve their financial sustainability, governance and compliance practices, forecasting accuracy, and decisions about facilities, growth, and operational plans.

Independently lead successful projects/engagements through client and team management.

  • Ensure assigned client partners are satisfied with Afton’s services through thoughtful project planning and staffing, proactive communication, adjusted approaches based on feedback, and adherence to the scope, goals, and allocated resources of each project.
  • Independently and collaboratively develop financial projections and financial analysis, prepare client-facing plans, and advise charter school leaders on important decisions.
  • Manage multiple concurrent projects of varying complexity and duration.

Coach, mentor, and support colleagues.

  • Support the development of colleague’s technical, project management, and communication skills through formal coaching as a project leader and informal mentoring and information sharing.
  • Advance Afton and our client partners’ goals by serving as a thought partner to Afton colleagues, within and beyond the Charter Finance team.
  • Lead by example by soliciting feedback reflecting on growth areas, and taking action.

Qualifications

This position requires demonstrated proficiency in financial projection modeling, financial planning, budgeting, school debt financing processes, and communication. Successful candidates will have a keen ability to turn data into intelligence for decision making. Advanced project management, and coaching skills are critical.

Our experience suggests that the following types of professional experiences and skills have prepared candidates for this work:

  • A minimum of ten (10) years of relevant work experience in education or non-profit finance, financial services, management consulting, or similar roles.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly in virtual environments.
  • Demonstrated experience identifying potential challenges and taking initiative, creating structures to address ambiguous or complex problems, leading teams, and coaching and developing colleagues.
  • Excellent project management skills as demonstrated by project outcomes and a positive experience for clients and colleagues.
  • A strong interest in our client partners’ mission and communities. · Alignment with Afton’s core values.

Preferred experiences include:

  • Prior experience as a Chief Financial Officer or Director of Finance for a charter or private school organization.
  • An MBA degree.

Research shows candidates from underrepresented backgrounds often apply only when they meet every listed qualification. If most of this describes you, we encourage you to apply.
