jobs.description:
We seek a Director of Product Management to set and lead the product strategy for the Microsoft partnership across ServiceNow's full vertical stack, from data and AI through agents, governance, and industry-specific workflows. This is an individual contributor role with enterprise-wide scope and executive-level influence. You are the senior product leader and definitive internal authority on how ServiceNow's platform aligns with Microsoft's product stack end-to-end.

The scope is intentionally broad and will shift as both companies' product stacks evolve. Rather than a fixed list of integration points, this role is defined by a mandate: wherever ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack meet, you are accountable for the product relationship. You'll partner with product marketing, business development, corporate development, and other functions to define and execute the engagement strategy, track execution milestones, and maximize value generated for ServiceNow, our customers, and Microsoft. You will serve as ServiceNow's senior product counterpart to Microsoft product leadership.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Set the strategy for and lead technical due diligence, roadmap alignment, and integration delivery across the Microsoft relationship, from qualification through activation-ready handoff to GTM, spanning whichever stack layers are active priorities at a given time, not a fixed set.
  • Establish and continuously evolve the enterprise view of where ServiceNow's stack and Microsoft's stack intersect, so the organization always has one owner and one point of view on the relationship rather than fragmented, layer-by-layer ownership.
  • Drive dual-roadmap alignment: translate Microsoft's capability and platform changes into internal roadmap asks, and translate ServiceNow's platform roadmap into Microsoft-facing requirements.
  • Define and advocate ServiceNow's point of view on how Microsoft's stack complements (rather than overlaps with) our platform, and articulate that positioning clearly to internal and partner stakeholders.
  • Define success metrics and measure downstream customer-funnel signals (adoption, attach rate, win/loss) across the partnership in partnership with GPC and field, and use them to drive roadmap and investment decisions.
  • Own prioritization and resourcing recommendations across this broad scope, and decide, with leadership, where to go deep now versus defer. Communicate the rationale clearly.
  • Shape and recommend leadership-level decisions on deeper strategic engagement with Microsoft (investment, co-sell motions, joint roadmap commitments).
  • Track competitive and industry trends across the Microsoft ecosystem, and define the implications and response for partnership strategy.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment with Engineering, Platform, Product Marketing, and GTM BD across the many teams whose work touches the Microsoft relationship. Represent ServiceNow in executive and strategic customer and partner engagements where Microsoft-specific technical context is needed, without owning the deal.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Demonstrated ability to operate across a wide, multi-layered product scope without needing it reduced to a fixed checklist, with comfort synthesizing a coherent strategy across data, AI, agents, governance, and application-layer partnership work.
  • 15+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS product management, with working knowledge of key SaaS growth drivers.
  • Track record of setting multi-year product strategy and influencing decisions at VP and C-level, internally and at partner or customer organizations.
  • Experience critically integrating AI into product decision-making, workflow design, or technical evaluation of partner solutions.
  • Experience leading product strategy for technology partnerships, including build-vs-partner analysis, technical due diligence, and integration architecture.
  • Experience owning business cases for partnership investment, including accountability for outcomes, combining analytical rigor with judgment under ambiguity.
  • Comfortable operating with dual accountability: influencing an internal roadmap you don't own and a partner roadmap you don't control, across an unusually broad set of stack layers.
  • Highly collaborative; able to drive alignment and decisions across many internal teams at the senior leadership level without direct authority over the people or teams involved.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to represent partnership rationale clearly to both technical and executive audiences, including translating across very different technical domains.
  • Ability to paint a compelling vision to inspire teams and senior stakeholders across a broad, evolving scope.
  • Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform and applications portfolio, and the associated competitive/partner landscape, is a plus.
  • Broad familiarity with Microsoft's AI, data, and agent product ecosystem is a strong plus. Depth in a few areas plus fluency across the rest is more valuable here than deep expertise in only one.
  • Hands-on product management experience with AI-powered or AI-enabled enterprise software is a strong plus.

Job Summary:

The Manager, IT Managed Services leads Andar Software's IT Managed Services team and owns the reliability, security, and growth of our infrastructure — both the Private Cloud environment that runs our internal systems and the Cloud Hosting & IT Managed Services we deliver to customers across Canada and the United States.

Job Description:

Job Description: Manager, IT Managed Services (North America-Remote)

Annual Salary range: $110,000.00 - $125,000.00


Who We Are

Andar Software's story began more than 40 years ago when two individuals came together to develop Andar/360, a solution made specifically for the multi-faceted non-profit sector. In 2016, Andar Software joined Constellation Software Inc., within the Volaris Group vertical, and expanded its portfolio to include Cloud Hosting & IT Managed Services.


About the Role

The Manager, IT Managed Services leads Andar Software's IT Managed Services team and owns the reliability, security, and growth of our infrastructure — both the Private Cloud environment that runs our internal systems and the Cloud Hosting & IT Managed Services we deliver to customers across Canada and the United States.


This is a hands-on, player-coach role: you will lead and grow a small team of systems/DevOps engineers while staying close to the infrastructure itself. A flagship initiative for this role is directing Andar's migration off its own private hosting infrastructure onto AWS, and building the team and processes needed to support that platform as the company scales — including the infrastructure needed to support Andar's growing AI capabilities.


Reporting to the Director, Software Engineering & AI, you will partner closely with the Governance, Risk & Compliance team on security and compliance requirements, and with Product Development on the roadmap for infrastructure that supports our software — including AI-powered features.

Strong leadership, technical depth, and communication skills are essential — you'll be equally comfortable setting technical direction, coaching engineers, and rolling up your sleeves when needed.


Key Responsibilities


Team Leadership & Growth

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of systems/DevOps engineers, including hiring as the team scales with company growth.
  • Set clear priorities, career development plans, and performance expectations for direct reports.
  • Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

Cloud Strategy & Infrastructure Modernization

  • Own the strategy and execution of migrating Andar's Private Cloud infrastructure (25+ servers on Proxmox VE) to AWS, including planning, sequencing, cost modeling, and risk management.
  • Direct the administration, optimization, and lifecycle management of infrastructure during and after the transition (provisioning, patching, capacity planning, decommissioning).
  • Define target-state cloud architecture, balancing scalability, performance, security, and cost.
  • Champion infrastructure-as-code and automation (Terraform, Ansible, Docker, Kubernetes) to modernize provisioning and deployment practices.
  • Partner with the Director, Software Engineering & AI to plan and provision infrastructure supporting Andar's growing AI/ML capabilities (e.g., GPU-backed compute, vector databases, model-serving endpoints).
  • Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted operations tooling (AIOps monitoring, anomaly detection, AI coding/automation assistants) to improve infrastructure reliability and team velocity.

Networking, Security & Compliance Coordination

  • Own network infrastructure strategy: firewalls, VPNs, VLANs, DNS, DHCP.
  • Ensure infrastructure security controls (access management, encryption, vulnerability management, patching) meet company and customer requirements.
  • Partner with the Governance, Risk & Compliance team on audits, security reviews, and incident response (SIRT/SOC) — keeping infrastructure operations and compliance oversight appropriately separated.

Internal IT Oversight

  • Ensure reliable Tier 1–3 IT support for Andar's internal staff (currently 30–40 people), including onboarding/offboarding, endpoint management, and M365/Azure administration.
  • Oversee Active Directory, Windows Server, and related core infrastructure.

Managed Services Delivery & Customer Experience

  • Own SLA performance and service quality for Cloud Hosting & IT Managed Services delivered to customers across Canada and the United States.
  • Oversee multi-tenant customer environments and escalation handling across time zones.
  • Drive continuous improvement in tooling (RMM, PSA/ticketing) and processes to scale service delivery efficiently.
  • Define and track SRE practices and service reliability targets, including SLIs/SLOs, availability, performance, and error budgets.
  • Establish proactive observability across infrastructure and hosted services, including monitoring, alerting, logging, and capacity/performance metrics.
  • Lead operational incident management practices, including effective on-call/escalation processes, root-cause analysis, and post-incident improvements.

Budget, Vendor & Cost Management

  • Own the IT infrastructure budget, including cloud/hosting spend, licensing, and vendor contracts.
  • Negotiate and manage vendor relationships; identify cost-saving opportunities as the team migrates to AWS.
  • Report on infrastructure costs, reliability metrics, and project status to the Director, Software Engineering & AI and senior leadership.

What You Bring


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field — or equivalent work experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in infrastructure/systems engineering roles, including 2+ years in a formal people-management or team-lead capacity.
  • Hands-on experience designing, implementing, and migrating cloud/virtualization platforms — direct experience migrating on-premises or private-cloud infrastructure to AWS strongly preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows Server administration, networking fundamentals, and enterprise backup/disaster recovery practices.
  • Experience managing IT Managed Services or MSP-style service delivery, including SLA ownership.
  • Hands-on experience applying SRE/DevOps practices to production operations, including observability, incident response, and reliability targets (SLIs/SLOs).
  • Demonstrated ability to build, coach, and retain a technical team.
  • Excellent communication skills, comfortable working cross-functionally with Product Development, Customer Success, and Governance, Risk & Compliance.

Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience leading AWS migration projects specifically (lift-and-shift, re-architecture, or hybrid approaches).
  • Experience in a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or multi-tenant hosting environment.
  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure needs — GPU-backed compute, vector databases, model-serving — and AWS AI/ML services (e.g., Bedrock, SageMaker), as Andar builds AI capabilities into its products.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development/operations tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) to improve engineering and operations velocity.
  • Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and negotiations.
  • Prior experience within a portfolio / multi-company environment (e.g., Constellation Software or similar) a plus.
  • Knowledge of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 compliance frameworks and Linux.

Certifications (a plus, not required)

  • AWS Certified Solutions Architect or AWS Certified SysOps Administrator
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
  • CompTIA Server+, Linux+, or Security+

What You Get

  • Competitive compensation & benefits package with annual bonus and stock options.
  • Thrive in a 100% Remote environment.
  • Annual stipend for office-related expenses.
  • Extensive learning & development programs and resources.
  • Access to boundless knowledge, support, and best-practice sharing within the Constellation Software portfolio of companies.
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program), Educational Assistance, and Recognition Program.

jobs.description:
Senior Director/ Executive Director, Small Molecule Process Chemistry

Reports To: Chief Technology Officer (CTO)

Location: Global (China, Europe and US) 

Employment Type: Full-Time

The Senior Director/Executive Director, Small Molecule Process Chemistryserves as a senior scientific and strategic leader responsible for strengthening Asymchem's global small molecule development capabilities and technical competencies.
This role provides scientific leadership across process chemistry, CMC strategy, technology transfer, manufacturing readiness, commercialization, and regulatory support.

Key Responsibilities

1. Scientific & Technical Leadership

  • Serve as a senior scientific leader and advisor for small molecule API development programs across all development phases, from early development through commercialization.
  • Provide strategic guidance on route scouting, route selection, process optimization, impurity control strategies, crystallization development, and scale-up activities.
  • Lead scientific reviews and risk assessments for challenging synthetic routes and development programs.
  • Support development of robust, scalable, cost-effective, and environmentally sustainable manufacturing processes.
  • Apply advanced expertise in synthetic organic chemistry, catalytic reactions, asymmetric synthesis, process intensification, and enabling technologies.
  • Advise executive leadership on scientific trends, technical investments, and capability expansion opportunities.

2. CMC Strategy & Regulatory Leadership

  • Provide strategic oversight for Drug Substance (DS) CMC development activities.
  • Guide preparation, review, and quality of regulatory submissions, including INDs, NDAs, IMPDs, and global registration dossiers.
  • Support development of phase-appropriate control strategies and lifecycle management plans.
  • Provide expertise in regulatory expectations related to process development, validation, impurity management, and manufacturing control.
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing teams to ensure alignment of development and commercialization strategies.

3. TechnologyTransferandCommercialization

  • Advise project teams on commercial route selection, manufacturing readiness, and long-term supply strategies.
  • Support process scale-up, engineering runs, process validation, and commercial launch preparation.
  • Guide technology transfer activities between development and manufacturing organizations across global sites.
  • Promote Quality-by-Design (QbD), risk assessment, and science-based decision-making throughout development.
  • Facilitate collaboration among process chemistry, analytical sciences, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supply organizations.

4. Advanced Impurity & Risk Management Leadership

  • Serve as a scientific resource for mutagenic impurity control strategies and nitrosamine risk assessments.
  • Support internal teams and clients in developing scientifically sound approaches for impurity identification, risk evaluation, mitigation, and regulatory communication.
  • Establish best practices aligned with evolving global regulatory expectations for impurity control and lifecycle management.
  • Contribute to scientific governance related to process safety, product quality, and regulatory compliance.

5. Platform Strategy & Innovation

  • Contribute to the strategic growth and evolution of Asymchem's global small molecule platform.
  • Identify emerging technologies, scientific approaches, and operational capabilities that enhance competitiveness and execution excellence.
  • Support implementation of innovative technologies, including flow chemistry, biocatalysis, automation, digital development tools, advanced process analytics, and manufacturing sciences.
  • Drive harmonization of best practices across development, scale-up, and commercialization activities.

6. Global Technical Integration

  • Promote scientific and operational alignment between U.S., Europeand China development organizations.
  • Establish consistent approaches to process development, technology transfer, technical documentation, and scientific decision-making.
  • Support technical governance and portfolio reviews for strategic programs.
  • Facilitate effective communication and collaboration among global stakeholders.

7. Client-Facing Scientific Leadership

  • Represent Asymchem as a senior scientific leader during client interactions, technical reviews, and strategic discussions.
  • Provide technical assessments related to development feasibility, manufacturing strategy, regulatory risks, and commercialization planning.
  • Partner with Business Development and Project Management teams to strengthen proposals, technical narratives, and differentiated service offerings.
  • Participate in technical due diligence activities and support evaluation of strategic business opportunities.
  • Serve as an executive-level scientific representative during key client meetings and audits.

8. Organizational Development & Mentorship

  • Mentor senior scientists, technical leaders, and project teams across the organization.
  • Contribute to succession planning and capability-building initiatives in process chemistry, CMC, manufacturing sciences, and technology transfer.
  • Support technical training programs and scientific excellence initiatives.
  • Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Technical Expertise

  • Ph.D. in Organic Chemistry, Process Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or related scientific disciplines.
  • 15-20+ years of experience in pharmaceutical or CDMO process development and CMC leadership.
  • Demonstrated an excellenttrack record of advancing small molecule programs from early development through regulatory approval and commercial launch.
  • Expertise in process chemistry, scale-up, impurity control, crystallization, technology transfer, and process validation.
  • Deep understanding of global regulatory requirements supporting IND, NDA, and commercial product lifecycle management.
  • Recognized expertise in mutagenic impurity and nitrosamine risk management is highly desirable.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary development teams supporting global development and manufacturing operations.
  • Ability to operate effectively across global organizations and time zones.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as business needs require (approximately 25–35%).
  • Mandarin proficiency is a plus, but not required.

jobs.title: Salesforce Technical Architect (Poland)
jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFlosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Flosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.

This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem.

We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first.

About Flosum

Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards.

Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match.

We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build.

What You Will Own

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.
  • Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management.
  • Define how Flosum's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary.
  • Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents.

Customer & Market Insight

  • Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management.
  • Translate complex enterprise requirements (SOX, zero-trust, multi-org, regulated industries) into elegant product solutions.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to influence deal strategy, conduct product demos for strategic accounts, and close competitive evaluations.

Execution & Delivery

  • Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You do the work, not just delegate it.
  • Partner with engineering to deliver on aggressive timelines. Own sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release coordination.
  • Define and track product KPIs: adoption, activation, expansion, NPS, competitive win rates.

Requirements

Who You Are

We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary. Someone who takes genuine ownership of outcomes, thinks independently, and is driven by a need to build something that matters, not just advance their career.

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms.
  • Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred.
  • You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable.
  • Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape.
  • Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it.

What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role

  • You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company.
  • You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries.
  • You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics.
  • You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce.
  • You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend.

What We Expect in the First 12 Months

First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose

  • Achieve deep fluency in Flosum's five product lines and their technical architecture.
  • Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points.
  • Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win.
  • Deliver your first product roadmap refresh with clear prioritization rationale.

Months 3-6: Ship and Win

  • Own and deliver at least one major product release that directly addresses a competitive gap or customer-requested capability.
  • Establish a product-led feedback loop between Sales, CS, and Engineering that accelerates deal velocity and reduces churn.
  • Define the next generation of Flosum's AI capabilities and present a detailed execution plan.

Months 6-12: Scale and Lead

  • Drive measurable improvement in competitive win rates against Copado and Gearset.
  • Launch at least one net-new product capability that opens a new revenue stream or market segment.
  • Establish Flosum as a thought leader in AI-driven Salesforce DevOps through content, speaking, and ecosystem engagement.

Benefits

Why Flosum

  • Category-defining opportunity: You will shape the future of how enterprises build on Salesforce. This is not incremental; it is transformational.
  • Direct CEO partnership: You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with a founder who is deeply technical, product-obsessed, and committed to building the best platform in the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Fortune 100 customer base: Your product decisions will directly impact how the world's largest and most complex organizations operate.
  • AI inflection point: Agentforce and autonomous agents are rewriting the rules. Flosum is the first native platform to integrate these capabilities. You will define what comes next.
  • Missionary culture: We hire people who want to make a dent, not pad a resume. If you are looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are heard, this is it.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus
  • Direct access to Salesforce ecosystem events, conferences (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX), and customer engagement

jobs.excerpt: Ready to be a Titan? At ServiceTitan, we're building the operating system for the trades.
jobs.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

At ServiceTitan, we're building the operating system for the trades. As we continue to scale, we're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Data & AI Platform team and own the algorithmic systems that sit underneath dozens of downstream product features and quietly decide what gets prioritized, surfaced, and trusted across ServiceTitan.


This is a senior individual contributor role for a product leader who thinks in statistics, not just user stories. The specific problems you'll own will shift based on what domain teams and our customers need most — today that might mean ranking methodology, deduplication logic, or causal inference; tomorrow it could be a different statistically-driven problem entirely. What stays constant is the kind of thinking: translating ambiguous, statistically messy problems into clear product requirements that engineering and ML can build against with confidence. This is a heavily stats-driven PM role: you'll be evaluating model tradeoffs, defining what "correct" means for a given system, and defending methodology choices to a technical audience as much as you'll be writing a roadmap.


What you'll do:

  • Define and own the roadmap for whichever algorithmic systems — ranking, deduplication, causal inference, or similar — are highest-priority based on domain team and customer need.
  • Translate real customer pain (bad matches, untrustworthy rankings, wrong conclusions drawn from correlated data) into statistically rigorous product requirements.
  • Co-author PRDs for statistically ambiguous problems where the "right answer" isn't obvious — you're defining the evaluation criteria as much as the solution.
  • Partner with ML and engineering to evaluate model tradeoffs (precision/recall, false positive cost, explainability vs. accuracy) and make the product call when there's no clean answer.
  • Set measurable, multi-quarter goals for algorithmic system health and lead cross-functional teams toward them with rigor.
  • Lead discovery with domain product teams and customers to understand where algorithmic errors actually cost time, money, or trust.
  • Proactively identify and resolve disagreements over methodology, ownership, and model quality before they stall multiple teams building on your systems.

What you'll bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, strong track record in enterprise B2B SaaS; experience with at least one of ranking/recommendation systems, entity resolution, or causal inference — this role will likely touch more than one over time.
  • Genuine statistical fluency — comfortable with precision/recall tradeoffs, confounding vs. causation, and model evaluation, regardless of which specific problem you're applied to.
  • Demonstrated ability to define evaluation criteria and "what correct looks like" for a new statistical problem from scratch, rather than working from an existing rubric.
  • Comfort context-switching between different algorithmic domains as customer and business priorities shift.
  • Experience translating customer-reported problems (bad matches, low trust in recommendations, wrong conclusions) into statistically defined product work.
  • Strong communication skills — explaining model tradeoffs to domain PMs, ML engineers, and customers who each need a different level of technical detail.
  • Self-starter who takes initiative and holds themselves accountable to outcomes — "mostly works" isn't good enough when customers are trusting your systems with real decisions.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for site management oversight, clinical monitoring and central monitoring deliverables with a focus on patient safety, protocol/GCP/regulatory compliance and data integrity.
  • Oversees site interactions post activation through site closeout. This may include patient recruitment, investigator payments or other related activities.
  • May be responsible for identification of critical data and process, protocol execution risks and risk mitigations related to completion of the Risk Assessment and Categorization Tool (RACT).
  • Reviews the study scope of work, budget and protocol content and ensures the clinical project team (CRAs/Central Monitors) is aware of the contractual obligations and parameters.
  • Uses prior clinical experience, operational data, metrics and reports to identify risks to clinical trial management deliverables.
  • Escalates to the project manager any risks to clinical trial management deliverables (timeline, quality and budget) and any activities and requests which are out of contracted scope.
  • Employs strategic thinking and problem-solving skills to propose and implement risk mitigations.
  • Participates and presents in key meetings such as Kick Off Meeting.
  • Serves as an escalation point for communications with investigator site staff and may be required to interact on the phone or in person with principal investigators or other site staff members. This may include accompanying CRA team members to sites for observation or conflict resolution.
  • Collaborates with other functional leaders such as Study Start Up, Patient Recruitment and Data Management to coordinate delivery handoffs and meet expected study milestones such as site activation targets, enrollment targets and database lock timelines. Reviews and provides feedback on other functional plans (e.g. Data Management Plan, Communication Plan) as they relate to the clinical trial management activities.
  • Responsible for development and ongoing maintenance of clinical study tools and templates, including the Clinical Monitoring Plan. Ensures CTMS, dashboards and other systems are set up and available for use by the clinical team, including overseeing user acceptance testing (UAT) as needed. Ensures access and audit trail reviews are conducted as required.
  • Coordinates initial and ongoing training to the study team regarding protocol specificities, Case Report Form (CRF) completion, dashboards, Sponsor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), clinical plans and guidelines, data plans and timelines for the study.
  • Oversees resourcing allocations for CRAs and Central Monitors, site assignments and study team members' conduct, and identifies risks to delivery or quality.
  • Ensures quality of the clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management deliverables within a project and maintain proper visibility of its progress by the use of approved systems and / or tracking tools.
  • Reviews the project oversight dashboards and other clinical trial systems (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), Electronic Data Capture (EDC), eDiary, Electronic Patient Reported Outcomes (ePROs),Trial Master File (TMF), IVRS/IWRS, Central Monitoring dashboards), to oversee site and patient activities, study team conduct and to ensure the data has been updated to reflect timely execution of all operational aspects (required visits/calls, duration, and frequency) according to plan.
  • Understands the monitoring strategy required for the study and, where required, participates in the development of the study risk assessment plan. Is accountable for their assigned clinical team members' understanding, ongoing compliance and delivery according to the stated monitoring strategy, CMP/SMP, and risk plans.
  • Reviews the content and quality of site and central monitoring documentation (site monitoring calls, site visit reports, site letters, central monitoring reports and pertinent correspondence), to ensure they represent site management activities and conduct and that they appropriately convey any risks to protocol/GCP compliance, trial conduct, patient safety or data integrity. Document requested revisions and approvals in CTMS. Ensures these deliverables are provided according to company and/or sponsor specifications, including delivery deadlines.
  • Interacts with the client and other functional departments related to clinical monitoring, central monitoring and site management activities and deliverables. Provides status updates on the clinical deliverables and risks to clients, project management and leadership as per departmental or study agreements. Provides solutions for obstacles in protocol execution and site management.
  • Demonstrates understanding of other functions' roles in achieving compliance and delivery according to protocol, SOPs, ICH GCP and country regulations. This may include data management, study start up, patient recruitment, medical monitoring, pharmacovigilance and Quality Assurance (QA). Supports Inspection Readiness for clinical trial management scope.
  • Oversees CRAs and Central Monitors assigned to the study and routinely assesses study-specific process and training compliance, CMP compliance, and identifies emerging risks. May develop and support execution of corrective action plans at site and study level. Supports and completes activities to achieve data cut and lock deadlines.
  • Provides feedback to line managers on staff performance including strengths as well as areas for development. May be assigned to larger,more complex trials.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and align teams in the achievement of project milestones
  • Demonstrated capability of working in an international environment.
  • Demonstrated expertise in site management and monitoring (clinical or central)
  • Preferred experience with risk-based monitoring
  • Demonstrates understanding of clinical trial management financial principles and budget management
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills
  • Good communication, presentation and interpersonal skills among project team and with sites
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Demonstrated ability to apply problem solving techniques to resolve complex issues, and apply a risk management approach to identifying and mitigating potential threats to the successful conduct of a clinical research project.
  • Demonstrates critical thinking to determine the cause and appropriate solution in the identification of issues
  • Moderate travel may be required, approximately 20%

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

AssetWorks builds the fleet and asset management software that cities, counties, and state and federal agencies use to keep their vehicles and equipment running. jobs.description:
das erwartet dich:

Über SecureID

SecureID ist unser eigenes Produkt: eine PKI- und Credential-Wallet, die das Smartphone zur hardwaregestützten digitalen Identität macht. Das private Schlüsselmaterial liegt in Secure Enclave bzw. Android Keystore und verlässt die Hardware nie. Darauf aufbauend liefert SecureID Türzugang per NFC, E-Mail-Signatur, Push-2FA und passwortlose Anmeldung – alles aus einer App. Unternehmen verwalten ihre Nutzer, Karten und Integrationen selbst in SecureID Workspaces.

Die App ist das Kernstück: Sie ersetzt Smartcards und Hardware-Token.

Wie wir mit KI entwickeln

Wir setzen KI konsequent ein, um schneller zu entwickeln: Pläne werden mit Claude Code oder Codex zu Specs und Tickets, Agenten übernehmen Teile der Umsetzung. Das heißt ausdrücklich nicht, dass Code ungesehen durchgeht. Du verstehst, was du mergst, prüfst es kritisch und trägst die Verantwortung für deinen Code – egal, ob du ihn selbst geschrieben oder generiert hast.

Das System, das du weiterentwickelst

  • Mobile Wallet: Flutter-App für iOS und Android mit Riverpod und GoRouter
  • Hardwaregestützte Schlüssel: native Bridges in Swift und Kotlin zu Secure Enclave und Android Keystore – Schlüssel werden auf dem Gerät erzeugt und verlassen die Hardware nie
  • Nahfeld-Kommunikation: NFC/HCE und BLE für Türzugang und Geräte-Kopplung
  • Plattform-Integration: Bereitstellung von Zertifikaten für Drittanwendungen wie Mail, Browser und VPN über die Schlüsselspeicher der Plattformen (iOS CryptoTokenKit, Android KeyChain)
  • Architekturprinzip: Die App ist ein Thin Client – Geschäftslogik liegt im Backend; die App kümmert sich um UX, sichere Schlüsselablage und Gerätefunktionen
  • Build & Release: Codemagic, Signierung und Veröffentlichung im Apple App Store und bei Google Play

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst die SecureID-App für iOS und Android mit Flutter weiter.
  • Du bringst unser neues UX-Design in die App und begleitest die Veröffentlichung im Apple App Store und bei Google Play.
  • Du setzt Enterprise-Funktionen um, etwa den Wechsel zwischen Organisationen und Push-Benachrichtigungen.
  • Du arbeitest an Biometrie, NFC, BLE und sicherer Schlüsselablage – gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen.
  • Du stimmst Schnittstellen mit dem Backend ab, damit die App schlank bleibt.

Job Title: Global Cybersecurity IAM Senior Analyst
Primary Location: Remote or Hybrid Chicagoland - Candidates must reside in United States
Position Type: Contract - W-2, 12 months with strong conversion potential

Overview
TalentFish is casting a line for a Global Cybersecurity IAM Senior Analyst. This is a 12-month W-2 contract role with strong potential to convert to a permanent position. The reason this position exists is to add senior Identity and Access Management capacity to a global cybersecurity team. This person will act as a subject matter expert across identity governance, privileged access, and authentication. They will also lead hands-on Saviynt administration, access reviews, and IAM projects from planning through operational handoff.

What You Bring to the Role

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information security, or a related field

  • 6+ years of Identity and Access Management experience, with in-depth knowledge of IAM concepts, technologies, and frameworks

  • Hands-on experience supporting or implementing an Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform (required). Saviynt Identity Cloud is strongly preferred; SailPoint, Oracle, or a similar enterprise IGA platform will be considered

  • Experience with Access Management tools such as Microsoft Azure, Okta, Oracle, or Ping Identity

  • Knowledge of or experience with Privileged Access Management solutions such as Delinea (Thycotic/Centrify), BeyondTrust, or CyberArk

  • Knowledge of or experience with Multi-Factor Authentication technology such as Azure AD MFA, Duo, or Okta

  • Strong understanding of security principles, access controls, authentication protocols, role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and segregation of duties

  • Expertise in identity lifecycle management, including provisioning, deprovisioning, access requests, entitlement management, and access reviews

  • Knowledge of legal and regulatory requirements, including SOX, HIPAA, PCI DSS, GDPR, and PIPL

  • Knowledge of information security risk management and compliance frameworks, including ISO 27001, SOC 2 Type 2, and NIST 800-30

  • Ability to translate technical and security concepts into clear business language for executives and stakeholders

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across complex IAM, integration, authentication, and access issues

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, project administration, and stakeholder management skills

  • Ability to manage competing priorities in a demanding, deadline-driven environment, both independently and across teams

  • Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)

  • Preferred: Oracle EBS and Oracle Cloud experience, including integrating Oracle applications with an IGA platform and supporting SoD controls

  • A plus: CISSP, CISM, or IAM certifications; experience deploying passwordless authentication; knowledge of Customer IAM (CIAM)

What You'll Do

  • Serve as a subject matter expert for IAM solutions, including IGA, Active Directory, PAM, identity synchronization and provisioning, and public key infrastructure (PKI)

  • Configure and maintain Saviynt connectors and onboard applications such as Microsoft Entra ID, Oracle EBS, and Salesforce, from requirements gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and ongoing support

  • Design, launch, and manage user access review and certification campaigns in Saviynt, including configuration, completion tracking, escalation, and remediation

  • Build and maintain segregation of duties (SoD) rulesets and mitigating controls, and support SoD violation review and remediation

  • Configure Saviynt access request workflows, rules, and approval processes, and use Saviynt analytics and reporting to monitor performance and support audit evidence

  • Troubleshoot IGA workflows, provisioning failures, connector and integration issues, access requests, and identity lifecycle processing

  • Manage day-to-day IAM operations, resolve escalations, and oversee automated identity lifecycle, provisioning, access request, and governance processes

  • Lead IAM projects from planning through implementation, including requirements gathering, resource coordination, timeline management, testing, deployment, and operational transition

  • Support the development, enforcement, and remediation of IAM policies, standards, procedures, and controls aligned with regulatory requirements

  • Participate in audits and access management process walkthroughs, address control deficiencies, and provide accurate, timely audit evidence

  • Identify IAM risks, implement mitigations, and lead the response and resolution of IAM-related security incidents

  • Develop IAM metrics, KPIs, and concise reports for senior leadership on program progress and IAM posture

  • Evaluate IAM tools and technologies, articulate the company's IAM strategy, and recommend solutions that meet business needs

  • Collaborate with cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, audit, and business teams to integrate IAM solutions across the enterprise

  • Perform other duties as assigned

Compensation Information
The expected salary range for this position is $40 - $63 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications. This role also qualifies for comprehensive benefits such as health insurance, 401(k), and paid time off. TalentFish is committed to pay transparency and equal opportunity. The salary range provided is in compliance with applicable state and federal regulations.

This role requires authorization to work in the U.S. without current or future visa sponsorship.

All offers are contingent upon the completion of a background check, which may include but is not limited to reference checks, education verification, employment verification, drug testing, criminal records checks, and any required certifications or compliance requirements based on the end client's background check policies and applicable laws.

TalentFish is an employee-owned company pioneering a new realm in talent acquisition. We are redefining IT staffing by evolving AI, video screening, and our unique platform. TalentFish focuses on providing the best employee, consultant, and client experience possible.
At TalentFish we are an Equal Opportunity Employer; we embrace and encourage diversity!

This is a remote position.
Join one of the Philippines' fastest-growing tech companies! Open to Philippine-based candidates only.
About Us
Full Scale is a fully remote-first company that helps businesses build dedicated teams of skilled software engineers. We make it easier for growing companies to find, onboard, and retain high-performing software talent.
The Role
As a QA Engineer, you will help ensure our client's applications remain fast, stable, and reliable under real-world demand. This is a hands-on, hybrid QA role where you will create and execute load and performance tests across web, mobile, and API applications, analyze results, and work with development and infrastructure teams to identify performance bottlenecks.
Load testing is an important part of this role, but it will not be your only responsibility. Testing activities run in cycles, with some weeks requiring load testing once or twice and major events potentially requiring continuous testing for around three weeks. When load testing is paused, including during periods when NeoLoad credits are unavailable, you will support the team with manual testing and some automation testing.
We're looking for someone with practical load-testing knowledge who is flexible, analytical, and comfortable handling other QA responsibilities between performance testing cycles.
Key Responsibilities
  • Performance Test Scripting: Create, maintain, and execute performance test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications using NeoLoad, JMeter, or similar tools.
  • Test Execution: Plan and run load, stress, and performance tests, monitoring application behavior during execution.
  • Results Analysis: Analyze response times, throughput, and error rates to identify performance bottlenecks and potential causes.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Use monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Azure Monitor, Grafana, or Splunk to help investigate application and infrastructure performance.
  • Reporting and Communication: Prepare clear test reports, document findings, and communicate results to the team.
  • Cross-Team Troubleshooting: Work with development and infrastructure teams to investigate performance issues and support troubleshooting.
  • Manual Testing: Execute manual test cases across web and mobile applications when load testing is not active.
  • Automation Testing: Assist with automation testing as needed between performance testing cycles.
  • Flexible QA Support: Adapt to changing testing priorities and support other QA activities during periods when load testing is paused.

Requirements

  • Ideally, 1–3 years of hands-on experience in load and performance testing. Candidates with 5–6+ years of experience are also welcome.
  • Hands-on experience with NeoLoad is strongly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of load, stress, and performance testing concepts.
  • Experience testing web, mobile, and API applications.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and SQL.
  • Ability to execute performance tests, analyze results, and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Azure Monitor, Grafana, or Splunk.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

jobs.excerpt: The OpportunityFlosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Flosum is looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager who lives and breathes the Salesforce ecosystem and wants to shape the future of how the world's largest enterprises build, secure, and scale on Salesforce.

This is not a maintenance role. You will own the product roadmap for the only 100% Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform trusted by Fortune 100 companies, global brands like Hilton, Cargill, Barry Callebaut, Cushman & Wakefield, and AARP. You will work directly with the CEO and engineering leadership to define and ship products that create entirely new categories within the Salesforce ecosystem.

We are at an inflection point. AI-driven DevOps (powered by Agentforce), agent-aware governance, zero-trust security orchestration, and intelligent data lifecycle management are transforming the Salesforce landscape. We need a product leader who sees around corners, understands where this space is heading, and has the conviction and execution chops to get us there first.

About Flosum

Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and the only native solution certified by Salesforce, we operate within the Salesforce trust boundary, which means zero data exposure, no third-party cloud processing, and full compliance with Salesforce security standards.

Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. We compete against Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, and Salto, and we win because our native architecture delivers security, speed, and extensibility that external tools simply cannot match.

We recently integrated Salesforce Agentforce into our platform, making Flosum the first and only Salesforce-native AI DevOps solution. This is just the beginning of what we plan to build.

What You Will Own

Product Vision & Strategy

  • Define and drive the multi-year product roadmap across Flosum's five product lines: DevOps, Backup & Archive, Trust Center, Data Seeding, and DevOps for Veeva.
  • Identify whitespace opportunities in the Salesforce ecosystem where Flosum can create new categories or capture market share from competitors.
  • Translate deep Salesforce platform knowledge (metadata architecture, deployment models, Agentforce, Data Cloud, multi-org environments) into product capabilities that enterprise customers will pay premium prices for.
  • Stay ahead of Salesforce's own product direction (three releases per year) and position Flosum to capitalize on every platform shift.

AI & Innovation

  • Lead the next wave of AI-powered DevOps capabilities built on Agentforce, including intelligent deployment agents, AI-driven code review, automated security scanning, and predictive release management.
  • Define how Flosum's extensibility platform enables customers to build custom AI-driven workflows within Salesforce's trust boundary.
  • Pioneer agent-aware governance: preparing Salesforce governance frameworks for autonomous systems and AI agents.

Customer & Market Insight

  • Engage directly with Fortune 500 customers and prospects to deeply understand their pain points around Salesforce development, security, compliance, and data management.
  • Translate complex enterprise requirements (SOX, zero-trust, multi-org, regulated industries) into elegant product solutions.
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to influence deal strategy, conduct product demos for strategic accounts, and close competitive evaluations.

Execution & Delivery

  • Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. You do the work, not just delegate it.
  • Partner with engineering to deliver on aggressive timelines. Own sprint planning, backlog prioritization, and release coordination.
  • Define and track product KPIs: adoption, activation, expansion, NPS, competitive win rates.

Requirements

Who You Are

We are looking for a missionary, not a mercenary. Someone who takes genuine ownership of outcomes, thinks independently, and is driven by a need to build something that matters, not just advance their career.

  • 7+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with at least 3 years focused on the Salesforce ecosystem or Salesforce-adjacent platforms.
  • Deep technical understanding of the Salesforce platform: metadata-driven architecture, deployment pipelines, sandboxes, packaging, security models, Apex, Lightning, and the ISV partner ecosystem.
  • Proven track record of shipping products that enterprise customers (Fortune 500, regulated industries) adopted and paid for. Not features; products.
  • Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, or security/compliance tooling is strongly preferred.
  • You understand the competitive landscape: Copado, Gearset, AutoRABIT, Salto, and native Salesforce DX. You know where each is strong and where they are vulnerable.
  • Strong perspective on how AI/ML (especially Salesforce Agentforce, Einstein, Data Cloud) will reshape the Salesforce development and governance landscape.
  • Hands-on executor. You write PRDs, you talk to customers, you review wireframes, you sit in sprint reviews. You do not manage from a distance.
  • Exceptional communication skills. You can present a product vision to a C-suite audience and write a technical specification for an engineering team in the same day.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a bias toward action. When you see a problem, you solve it. When you don't know something, you go learn it.

What Will Make You Exceptional in This Role

  • You have experience building products in the Salesforce AppExchange ecosystem, ideally as an ISV or within a Salesforce-native product company.
  • You have worked at the intersection of DevOps and security/compliance in regulated industries.
  • You have led product-led growth initiatives within an enterprise product, designing self-serve onboarding, in-product conversion, and expansion mechanics.
  • You have a point of view on the future of AI in Salesforce DevOps and can articulate a 3-year vision for how autonomous agents will change how enterprises build on Salesforce.
  • You have experience going head-to-head against well-funded competitors and winning through product superiority rather than just marketing spend.

What We Expect in the First 12 Months

First 90 Days: Learn and Diagnose

  • Achieve deep fluency in Flosum's five product lines and their technical architecture.
  • Conduct 25+ customer and prospect interviews to build a firsthand understanding of enterprise pain points.
  • Complete a competitive audit with specific, actionable recommendations on where Flosum should invest to win.
  • Deliver your first product roadmap refresh with clear prioritization rationale.

Months 3-6: Ship and Win

  • Own and deliver at least one major product release that directly addresses a competitive gap or customer-requested capability.
  • Establish a product-led feedback loop between Sales, CS, and Engineering that accelerates deal velocity and reduces churn.
  • Define the next generation of Flosum's AI capabilities and present a detailed execution plan.

Months 6-12: Scale and Lead

  • Drive measurable improvement in competitive win rates against Copado and Gearset.
  • Launch at least one net-new product capability that opens a new revenue stream or market segment.
  • Establish Flosum as a thought leader in AI-driven Salesforce DevOps through content, speaking, and ecosystem engagement.

Benefits

Why Flosum

  • Category-defining opportunity: You will shape the future of how enterprises build on Salesforce. This is not incremental; it is transformational.
  • Direct CEO partnership: You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with a founder who is deeply technical, product-obsessed, and committed to building the best platform in the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Fortune 100 customer base: Your product decisions will directly impact how the world's largest and most complex organizations operate.
  • AI inflection point: Agentforce and autonomous agents are rewriting the rules. Flosum is the first native platform to integrate these capabilities. You will define what comes next.
  • Missionary culture: We hire people who want to make a dent, not pad a resume. If you are looking for a place where your work matters and your ideas are heard, this is it.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive base salary + performance bonus
  • Direct access to Salesforce ecosystem events, conferences (Dreamforce, TrailblazerDX), and customer engagement

jobs.excerpt: Processo de seleção desenvolvido pela matteria Localização e modo de trabalhoResidência fixa em uma das capitais da Amazônia Legal brasileira - Remoto Quem somosA missão da The Nature Conservancy (TNC) é proteger as terras e as águas das quais toda a vida depende.
jobs.description:
Processo de seleção desenvolvido pela matteria

Localização e modo de trabalho

Residência fixa em uma das capitais da Amazônia Legal brasileira - Remoto

Quem somos

A missão da The Nature Conservancy (TNC) é proteger as terras e as águas das quais toda a vida depende. Como uma organização baseada na ciência, criamos soluções inovadoras e práticas para os desafios mais difíceis do mundo, para que possamos criar um mundo no qual as pessoas e a natureza prosperem. Estamos enraizados em nossa Missão e guiados por nossos Valores, que incluem o Compromisso com a Diversidade e o Respeito às Pessoas, Comunidades e Culturas. Seja desenvolvimento de carreira, horários flexíveis ou uma missão gratificante, há muitas razões para amar a vida na TNC. Quer ter uma visão melhor da TNC? Confira nossa conta no instagram e o Relatório Anual 2024, além da #tncbrasil no LinkedIn.

Nosso objetivo é cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo para que todos os nossos colegas em todo o mundo sintam um sentimento de pertencimento e que suas contribuições únicas para nossa missão sejam valorizadas. Sabemos que só alcançaremos nossa Missão contratando e engajando uma força de trabalho diversificada que reflita as comunidades em que trabalhamos. Além dos requisitos em nossas postagens, reconhecemos que as pessoas vêm com talento e experiências fora do trabalho. A diversidade de experiências e habilidades combinadas com paixão são a chave para a inovação e uma cultura de inclusão! Por favor, inscreva-se - adoraríamos ouvir de você. Para citar o que inúmeros membros da equipe da TNC dizem: “você se juntará por causa da nossa missão e ficará por nossas pessoas”.

Nosso impacto

  • 71 milhões de hectares: impacto positivo almejado até 2030, com foco em conservação e aprimoramento da gestão.

  • 187 mil km de rios: extensão para a qual a TNC Brasil busca promover soluções e políticas públicas de conservação até 2030.

  • 369 milhões de toneladas de CO₂: volume de emissões que a organização pretende capturar ou contribuir para reduzir até 2030.

  • 3,8 milhões de pessoas: público que a TNC Brasil pretende apoiar, com atenção especial a povos tradicionais e comunidades indígenas, ampliando sua participação em espaços decisórios e sua liderança na gestão dos territórios.

Na Amazônia, exemplos recentes ajudam a dimensionar essa atuação: um projeto de Pagamento por Serviços Ambientais na Terra do Meio envolve 14 territórios coletivos, 3 mil pessoas e 10 milhões de hectares sob proteção de uso sustentável.

Propósito do cargo

Liderar a estratégia da TNC na Amazônia Brasileira a partir de uma visão sistêmica do território, conciliando conservação e desenvolvimento socioeconômico. O desafio será conectar diferentes agendas, atores e investimentos para transformar estratégias em resultados concretos e escaláveis, capazes de manter a floresta em pé, promover uma produção responsável e gerar valor para as pessoas e comunidades da Amazônia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Acompanhar e implementar a estratégia e a Teoria da Mudança da TNC para a Amazônia Brasileira, traduzindo a visão institucional em prioridades, iniciativas e resultados mensuráveis.

  • Liderar um portfólio amplo e diverso, conectando agendas de produção agropecuária sustentável, proteção e valorização da floresta em pé, povos indígenas e comunidades tradicionais, clima, mecanismos financeiros e políticas públicas.

  • Assegurar capacidade de implementação e entrega, transformando estratégias em resultados concretos, monitorando avanços e adaptando planos diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Promover uma visão de desenvolvimento socioeconômico da Amazônia, articulando conservação e produção responsável e identificando alavancas econômicas capazes de valorizar a floresta em pé.

  • Identificar oportunidades para ampliar iniciativas bem-sucedidas, superando a lógica de projetos-piloto e promovendo soluções com potencial de transformação sistêmica e atuação em larga escala.

  • Construir e fortalecer relações estratégicas com governos estaduais e federal, setor privado, instituições financeiras, produtores, academia, organizações da sociedade civil, financiadores, povos indígenas, quilombolas, extrativistas e outras comunidades tradicionais.

  • Influenciar políticas públicas, estruturas de governança e processos de tomada de decisão relevantes para o desenvolvimento sustentável da Amazônia.

  • Liderar e apoiar a captação de recursos no Brasil e internacionalmente, mantendo um pipeline consistente de oportunidades e relacionamento estratégico com financiadores.

  • Supervisionar a gestão financeira e orçamentária de um portfólio de grande porte, assegurando uso eficiente dos recursos, sustentabilidade financeira e conformidade institucional.

  • Liderar gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, fortalecendo estruturas, responsabilidades, autonomia, accountability e capacidades técnicas e gerenciais.

  • Estimular integração e sinergia entre diferentes frentes de atuação, evitando silos e promovendo circulação de contexto e informação para qualificar a tomada de decisão.

  • Manter e fortalecer a agenda de diversidade, equidade e inclusão dentro da unidade, incorporando-a à liderança e à gestão da equipe.

  • Representar institucionalmente a TNC em fóruns, negociações e espaços estratégicos nacionais e internacionais.

Requisitos e competências para trabalhar conosco

Educação

  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas à gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, economia ou áreas afins. Pós-graduação em áreas correlatas será considerada desejável.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 10 anos de experiência profissional em posições relacionadas a desenvolvimento socioeconômico, gestão de recursos naturais, políticas públicas, conservação ou áreas correlatas, com trajetória relevante em contextos complexos e de grande escala.

  • Experiência robusta na definição e implementação de estratégias, com responsabilidade por portfólios complexos, priorização de iniciativas, gestão de riscos e entrega de resultados mensuráveis.

  • Experiência comprovada na liderança de gestores e equipes multidisciplinares, incluindo desenvolvimento de talentos, estruturação de equipes e gestão de desempenho.

  • Trajetória de articulação multissetorial, estabelecendo relações e conduzindo negociações complexas com governos, setor privado, organizações da sociedade civil, comunidades, financiadores e outros atores estratégicos.

  • Experiência em relações governamentais e políticas públicas, incluindo capacidade de influenciar agendas, processos decisórios e condições institucionais necessárias para alcançar resultados em escala.

  • Experiência na gestão financeira e orçamentária de programas de grande porte, combinando visão estratégica com capacidade de acompanhamento da execução.

  • Experiência em captação de recursos e relacionamento com financiadores, contribuindo para a construção e manutenção de um pipeline de financiamento no Brasil e/ou internacionalmente.

  • Será especialmente valorizada uma trajetória que demonstre conhecimento e compreensão do contexto amazônico, incluindo suas dinâmicas socioeconômicas, produtivas, ambientais, políticas e territoriais.

  • Será um diferencial experiência com mecanismos financeiros, finanças estruturadas, setor privado ou desenvolvimento econômico, especialmente quando aplicada a desafios socioambientais e/ou territoriais.

    Conhecimento e habilidades

  • Visão sistêmica da Amazônia: capacidade de compreender o território para além de uma única agenda temática, conectando desenvolvimento socioeconômico, conservação, produção agropecuária, floresta, clima, povos e comunidades tradicionais, políticas públicas e investimentos.

  • Pensamento estratégico e de escala: capacidade de identificar as principais alavancas de transformação de um sistema e desenvolver soluções que possam avançar de iniciativas pontuais para resultados de maior escala.

  • Gestão e implementação: capacidade de transformar estratégia em execução, estabelecer prioridades, acompanhar resultados e replanejar recursos e ações diante de mudanças de contexto.

  • Articulação e negociação: habilidade para navegar entre interesses distintos, construir agendas comuns e mobilizar atores públicos, privados e sociais em torno de objetivos compartilhados.

  • Visão econômico-financeira: capacidade de compreender o papel de investimentos, mecanismos financeiros, setor privado e modelos econômicos na construção de soluções sustentáveis para a Amazônia.

  • Captação e mobilização de recursos: habilidade para desenvolver relações com financiadores, identificar oportunidades e contribuir estrategicamente para a sustentabilidade financeira do portfólio.

  • Inglês avançado, oral e escrito, considerando as interações, apresentações e eventos internacionais inerentes à posição. Inglês fluente é desejável e conhecimentos de espanhol serão considerados um diferencial.

Competências

  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento estratégico: conecta diferentes variáveis e agendas, compreende interdependências e mantém uma visão ampla do território sem perder a capacidade de priorização.

  • Orientação à implementação e resultados: transforma estratégia em ação, acompanha a execução e mantém foco consistente nas entregas e no impacto esperado.

  • Liderança adaptativa: lidera com segurança em contextos de incerteza e complexidade, sendo capaz de rever planos, redirecionar prioridades e mobilizar o time diante de mudanças.

  • Influência e construção de consensos: estabelece relações de confiança e consegue aproximar atores com interesses e perspectivas distintas.

  • Liderança de pessoas: desenvolve equipes fortes e tecnicamente qualificadas, compartilha contexto, promove autonomia e evita a formação de silos na tomada de decisão.

  • Colaboração e integração: consegue navegar por um portfólio diverso sem precisar ser especialista em todas as temáticas, conectando conhecimentos, pessoas e iniciativas para gerar sinergias.

  • Proatividade e senso de protagonismo: antecipa necessidades, identifica oportunidades e mobiliza recursos e pessoas para fazer a estratégia avançar.

  • Compromisso com diversidade, equidade e inclusão: incorpora essa agenda à forma de liderar, desenvolver equipes e construir uma cultura organizacional inclusiva.

Perfil de nossa equipe

A The Nature Conservancy é enraizada em nossa missão e guiada por nossos valores. Temos o compromisso de cultivar um ambiente de trabalho inclusivo, onde todos os colegas ao redor do mundo sintam um senso de pertencimento e tenham suas contribuições únicas valorizadas. Nosso objetivo é construir uma força de trabalho diversa que reflita as comunidades em que atuamos, reconhecendo que a diversidade de experiências e habilidades é fundamental para a inovação.

“Você vai se juntar a nós pela nossa missão — e vai ficar pelas nossas pessoas.”

Principais interesses para trabalhar conosco

O candidato ideal será motivado pela oportunidade de causar um impacto direto nos esforços globais de conservação.

Deve ter um forte interesse em sustentabilidade ambiental, proteção da biodiversidade e conservação de ecossistemas críticos no Brasil.

Razões para se juntar à nossa equipe

  • A oportunidade de liderar uma estratégia de alta relevância para um dos biomas mais importantes para a biodiversidade e estabilidade climática global.

  • Atuação sobre desafios complexos que conectam desenvolvimento econômico, produção sustentável, conservação, clima, comunidades e políticas públicas.

  • Liderança de um portfólio diversificado e de uma equipe multidisciplinar em uma organização de alcance global.

  • Possibilidade de articular governos, setor privado, investidores, financiadores, comunidades e sociedade civil em torno de mudanças sistêmicas.

  • Espaço para construir soluções que ultrapassem projetos-piloto e alcancem escala e transformação de sistemas.

Detalhes relevantes antes de se candidatar a esta vaga

A posição exige residência fixa em uma capital da Amazônia Brasileira, em modelo home office. Também requer disponibilidade para viagens nacionais e internacionais e atuação eventual em locais remotos e condições climáticas ou de terreno desafiadoras.

Reporting to the Director, Patient Support Strategy Lead, the Associate Director, Field Reimbursement Strategy will be responsible for establishing the vision, strategy, and governance framework for field reimbursement support for this individualized therapy. This leader will define the FRM operating model, engagement priorities, reimbursement education strategy, training approach, and field support capabilities needed to help treatment sites successfully navigate payer, coverage, reimbursement, and access challenges.

Through close partnership with Market Access, Field Commercial Leadership (COLT), Patient Engagement Center of Excellence, and external partners, the Associate Director will ensure field reimbursement capabilities are aligned with brand objectives, treatment site needs, and the evolving access landscape while generating insights that drive continuous improvement in field support effectiveness and customer experience.

  • Provider Access Education Strategy: Establish the strategy for non-promotional reimbursement and access resources, including discussion guides, reimbursement education materials, prior authorization support tools, denial and appeal resources, and office workflow support materials.

  • Field Engagement Governance: Define brand-specific engagement rules, support priorities, escalation pathways, and business requirements that guide FRM interactions across the patient journey and ensure alignment with patient support objectives.

  • Technology, Data & Innovation Strategy: Partner with Data & Technology teams to define business requirements for CRM capabilities, field visibility tools, reporting solutions, and emerging technologies that enhance field effectiveness and customer engagement.

  • Field Commercial Partnership & Alignment: Partner closely with field commercial leadership (COLT) to define FRM engagement expectations, priorities, and support activities, ensuring reimbursement support strategies are aligned with the needs of treatment sites, the complexities of an individualized therapy, and overall brand objectives.

  • Field Analytics, Insights & Optimization: Leverage field, reimbursement, provider, and operational insights to identify trends, operational gaps, and root causes, translating findings into actionable recommendations that improve field effectiveness, patient access, and provider experience.
