Location and Work Mode

Mexico, Remote

Who we are

Asylum Access works alongside forcibly displaced people as they seek safety, dignity, and the opportunity to shape their own futures.

Through legal empowerment, policy advocacy, and collaboration to improve global systems, we support refugees as they assert their rights—to live in safety, move freely, work legally, and access education. Our work aims to contribute to sustainable, rights-based solutions that respect autonomy and honor refugees’ ability to make decisions about their own lives.

Our work is rooted in partnership. Asylum Access is a global team and a family of locally-led civil society organizations across Asia and Latin America. Our national organizations are primarily staffed and led by people from the communities where we work, and our relationships with clients and partners are grounded in mutual trust, respect, and accountability. Globally, we collaborate with institutions and allies to help strengthen systems and policies so they better uphold the rights of refugees. Through our work on rights and governance, we work to support lasting systemic change that helps shift power toward refugees and their communities.

Our impact

We envision a world where every forcibly displaced person has their dignity and rights respected, their voices lead change, and they have the safety, support, and opportunity to rebuild their lives.

Purpose of the Position

The Accounting and Audit Manager leads the org-wide Accounting Department to achieve its mission in maintaining the integrity of accounting data and production of high-quality financial reports. The Accounting and Audit Manager is responsible for the day-to-day accounting for the headquarters’ financial transactions; developing, implementing and ensuring compliance with financial policies and procedures consistent with Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) and maintaining and continuously improving the system of financial controls; including general accounting, investment accounting, subgranting, grantmaking, tax-exempt compliances, banking, payroll, and benefits. This staff member will work directly with headquarters (HQ), and closely with Asylum Access Mexico (AAMX), Asylum Access Thailand (AAT) and Asylum Access Malaysia (AAM) staff.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the general accounting function for HQ, ensuring accurate and timely financial records and reporting.

  • Supervise accounting activities across Malaysia, Thailand, and Mexico, ensuring consistency and compliance with organizational standards.

  • Develop and prepare accounting and financial reports to support internal monitoring and decision-making.

  • Lead the annual external audit process, coordinating requirements, documentation, and communication with external auditors.

  • Lead tax compliance across the organization, ensuring timely and accurate fulfillment of applicable tax obligations.

  • Plan and conduct internal audits to strengthen financial controls, identify risks, and support compliance across the organization.

Requirements and competences to work with us

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting. CPA certification or equivalent

  • Bilingual in Spanish and English

  • Excel proficiency a must

Experience

  • 5 years related accounting experience in private corporation/public charity settings

  • Experience using a computerized accounting system, specifically Microsoft Dynamics and solid knowledge of MS Office applications

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong time management and organizational skills. Able to prioritize work effectively and adapt to multiple demands

  • Ability to communicate effectively and concisely both verbally and in writing

Competencies

  • Strong initiative and ability to take ownership of projects, management multiple deadlines, and work effectively with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

  • Cultural competence and intelligence, ability to work in a diverse, multicultural workforce

    Comfortable working individually and in concert with positions across the various functions and levels of the organization and with external partners, recognizing and valuing the need to adapt and respect other cultures and languages

  • Approaches work with openness and humility, adapting thoughtfully to changing contexts while remaining grounded in shared values.

  • Prior experience working with refugee-led organizations or involvement in community-led initiatives is an asset

Our team profile

These values guide how we show up, stand alongside communities, and shape a more just world together - informing the way we work, make decisions, and build partnerships:

Respect & Empathy: We treat every person with dignity, listen deeply, and center the experiences of forcibly displaced communities in all we do.

Integrity: We act with honesty, transparency, and consistency - standing by our commitments and holding ourselves accountable to the communities we serve.

Lived & Community-Rooted Leadership: We believe meaningful change is led by those closest to the issues. We support leadership by people with lived and community-rooted experience of displacement and injustice, recognizing their knowledge, insight, and vision as essential to transforming systems.

Curiosity & Courage: We ask bold questions, embrace learning and adaptability, and push for change- even when it’s difficult or uncertain.

Collaboration & Partnership: We build relationships rooted in trust and shared purpose, knowing long-term progress comes from working together.

Justice: Justice drives us to address both the immediate challenges faced by forcibly displaced people and the deeper, long-standing problems that keep injustice in place. Together with forcibly displaced communities, we work to heal harm, restore dignity, and create lasting change.

Key interests for working with us

The following are the goals of the organization for 2026-2030:

  • Goal 1: Refugees have access to rights and protection

  • Goal 2: Refugees are leading in decisions and solutions that affect their lives

  • Goal 3: Aligning how we work with what we stand for by investing in people and leadership, nurturing a culture of care and learning, staying grounded and responsive, building values and aligned systems, sustaining and diversifying our resources.

Reasons to join our team

Multi-cultural team, flexibility working remotely, healthcare stipend, wellness days, end of year break

As our capabilities evolve from traditional conversational automation toward agentic AI, the team builds intelligent services that combine large language models, natural language understanding, enterprise knowledge, business logic, and operational systems.

THE JOB

Ticketmaster is seeking an experienced Lead AI Experience Engineer to provide technical leadership for the design and evolution of agentic AI services within the TM1 Client & Fan Support Engineering team.

This role is responsible for defining how AI agents understand client and fan needs, maintain context, reason through complex scenarios, apply business rules, use available data and tools, and safely complete support tasks. The Lead AI Engineer will establish the methods, reusable patterns, quality expectations, and evaluation practices used by the AI Engineering team.

The position combines agentic AI design, conversational intelligence, Natural Language Understanding, business-process modeling, AI evaluation, and technical leadership. The successful candidate will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Product Managers, AI Engineers, Client and Fan Support Operations, Data Science, and Platform teams to translate business requirements into scalable and trustworthy AI behaviors.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Provide technical leadership for agentic AI across the TM1 Client & Fan Support Engineering team, partnering with the Engineering Manager to define technical direction and strengthen the team’s AI capabilities.
  • Lead the design of intelligent AI experiences that understand client and fan needs, apply business rules, maintain context, use available tools and data, and safely complete support tasks.
  • Translate business processes, service policies, and customer journeys into agent behaviors, decision logic, conversational patterns, and autonomous workflows.
  • Establish reusable patterns and standards for prompts, NLU, context management, guardrails, retrieval, tool use, evaluation, documentation, and human handoff.
  • Conduct design and quality reviews, identify risks, and guide AI Engineers in delivering reliable, maintainable, and production-ready solutions.
  • Define and monitor AI quality measures, including task completion, response quality, grounding, escalation accuracy, containment, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes.
  • Partner across Product, Client and Fan Support Operations, Data Science, Platform, QA, Security, and Knowledge Management to align AI solutions with business, customer, and technical needs.
  • Mentor AI Engineers through technical guidance, feedback, design sessions, and knowledge sharing.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend practical approaches that improve quality, delivery, and operational effectiveness.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Significant experience designing and leading conversational AI, intelligent assistant, Generative AI, or agentic AI solutions.
  • Deep understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, agent behavior, reasoning patterns, context management, memory, tool calling, and workflow orchestration.
  • Strong expertise in NLU, intent and entity modeling, semantic understanding, dialogue management, clarification strategies, and conversational design.
  • Experience translating business rules and operational workflows into AI decision logic and user experiences.
  • Experience designing guardrails, policy controls, escalation paths, failure handling, and responsible AI practices.
  • Experience defining AI evaluation frameworks and using interaction data, testing, and analytics to improve performance.
  • Knowledge of RAG, semantic search, enterprise knowledge systems, grounding, observability, and regression testing.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, cloud services, software architecture, integration patterns, and modern engineering practices.
  • Ability to lead complex initiatives, navigate ambiguity, and balance business value, customer experience, technical constraints, risk, and maintainability.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, systems thinking, and problem-solving skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience operating agentic AI solutions in production.
  • Experience with conversational AI platforms, agent orchestration frameworks, prompt-management tools, or AI evaluation platforms.
  • Experience in customer service, contact center, or high-volume digital support environments.
  • Familiarity with Amelia, Zendesk, Five9, Salesforce, or comparable platforms.
  • Knowledge of AI governance, privacy, security, accessibility, and multilingual support.
  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)

  • You are a trusted technical leader who applies deep expertise to complex AI challenges.
  • You establish standards and reusable practices that improve quality, consistency, and team effectiveness.
  • You coach engineers through clear, constructive feedback and help them build greater technical independence.
  • You build strong partnerships across technical and business teams and communicate complex ideas clearly.
  • You balance strategic thinking with practical execution and make sound decisions in ambiguous environments.
  • You act with ownership, integrity, and accountability while fostering collaboration and continuous improvement.

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork - We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES

We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.

HIRING PRACTICES

The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.

Jouw rol als Adviseur Informatiebeveiliging bij Quality

Hoe ga jij onze klanten helpen om veilige digitale toekomst?

Als Adviseur Informatiebeveiliging bij Quality ben je de strategische spil voor alles wat te maken heeft met informatiebeveiliging bij onze klanten. Jij zorgt ervoor dat organisaties niet alleen voldoen aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving, maar dat ze ook proactief beveiligd zijn tegen potentiële dreigingen. In deze rol combineer je leiderschap met diepgaande technische expertise, en werk je nauw samen met directies, IT-teams en externe auditors om een veilige, compliant omgeving te garanderen.

Een kijkje in jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden

In jouw rol lever je een directe bijdrage aan het succes van onze opdrachtgevers. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Een strategische visie te ontwikkelen voor informatiebeveiliging en de bescherming van digitale activa.

  • Security frameworks, architecturen en policies te ontwerpen en implementeren die aansluiten op de risico’s en behoeften van de organisatie.

  • Security awareness-programma’s te leiden, zodat medewerkers zich bewust blijven van cyberdreigingen en hun rol daarin.

  • Risicoanalyses en security-audits uit te voeren, waarbij je kwetsbaarheden identificeert en strategische beveiligingsmaatregelen adviseert.

  • Compliance-trajecten zoals ISO27001, NIS2 en DORA te begeleiden, zodat organisaties voldoen aan de laatste normen en wetgeving.

  • Samen te werken met directies, auditors en toezichthouders om security-strategieën te vertalen naar concrete en effectieve maatregelen.

Wat wij jou bieden

Je krijgt een vast contract voor minimaal 36 uur per week. Omdat we vertrouwen hebben in jouw expertise als Adviseur Informatiebeveiliging, bieden we je bij een fulltime dienstverband onderstaande aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een goed salaris, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring vanaf de € 6.000.

  • Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarde zoals een premievrije pensioenregeling. Hiermee houd je netto meer over!

  • 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid tot het bijkopen.

  • Voldoende opleidings- en studiemogelijkheden met een jaarlijks studiebudget van €3500,- en 5 studiedagen.

  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, Apple MacBook of Microsoft Surface en een iPhone.

  • Een sportschool bij ons op kantoor en daarnaast nog een bedrijfsfitness-regeling, mocht je toch lekker dicht bij huis willen sporten.

  • Vrijdagmiddag borrels, bedrijfsuitjes, maandelijkse BBQ en gezellige collega’s.

  • Goede ontwikkeling- en doorgroeimogelijkheden maar we helpen ook jouw persoonlijke leerpad te bewandelen.

Waarom Quality jouw volgende stap is

Als kennispartij stellen we hoge eisen aan de kwaliteit van ons team. Security & Privacy is een fantastisch werkveld met verschillende expertisegebieden. Je hebt wellicht kennis en ervaring op een of meerdere expertisegebieden.We zijn ons ervan bewust dat jouw persoonlijke kwaliteiten en bijdrage aan ons team net zo belangrijk zijn.

Requirements

Wat je meebrengt

Jij bent een strategisch denker met een scherpe visie op informatiebeveiliging en de vaardigheden om organisaties te begeleiden in hun security-uitdagingen. Verder beschik je over:

  • Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring als Adviseur Informatiebeveiliging of CISO met HBO/WO werk- en denkniveau en begrijpt zowel strategische als operationele securityvraagstukken.

  • Je bent gecertificeerd (of bereid dit te behalen) in CISSP, CISM, CRISC of CEH en hebt diepgaande kennis van security governance en risicomanagement.

  • Je bent bekend met frameworks zoals ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework en de NCSC-richtlijnen en weet deze effectief toe te passen.

  • Je hebt grondige kennis van regelgeving zoals AVG, NIS2, DORA en andere relevante wetgeving en helpt organisaties compliant te blijven.

  • Je bent communicatief sterk en kunt security-advies helder overbrengen aan directies, auditors en IT-teams.

jobs.description:
Jouw rol als Information Specialist Informatiebeveiliging bij Quality

Hoe ga jij onze opdrachtgevers helpen om hun informatiebeveiliging te optimaliseren?

Als Specialist Informatiebeveiliging help jij onze opdrachtgevers bij het verbeteren en borgen van hun informatiebeveiliging. Je ontwikkelt, implementeert en onderhoudt beleid, procedures en maatregelen die de vertrouwelijkheid, integriteit en beschikbaarheid van informatie beschermen.

Je vertaalt beleid en wet- en regelgeving naar concrete maatregelen binnen de organisatie. Daarbij ben je een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken en verbind je de business, IT en andere betrokken stakeholders.

Een kijkje in jouw dagelijkse werkzaamheden

In jouw rol lever je een directe bijdrage aan het succes van onze opdrachtgevers. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het vertalen van de visie en het informatiebeveiligingsbeleid naar concrete en uitvoerbare maatregelen.

  • Beleid en governance: beveiligingsbeleid, standaarden en richtlijnen opstellen, implementeren en actualiseren.

  • Securityawarenessprogramma’s begeleiden, zodat medewerkers zich bewust blijven van cyberdreigingen en hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid.

  • Compliance-trajecten zoals ISO 27001, NIS2 en DORA begeleiden, zodat organisaties voldoen aan relevante normen en wetgeving.

  • Procedures en borging: praktische procedures invoeren en de naleving daarvan binnen de organisatie borgen.

  • Risicomanagement: periodieke risicobeoordelingen uitvoeren, risico’s vastleggen en passende mitigerende maatregelen plannen.

  • Incidentmanagement: de respons op beveiligingsincidenten coördineren, oorzaken analyseren en maatregelen adviseren om herhaling te voorkomen.

  • Compliance en audits: bijdragen aan het voldoen aan onder andere de AVG en ISO 27001 en audits voorbereiden, begeleiden en opvolgen.

Wat wij jou bieden

Je krijgt een vast contract voor minimaal 36 uur per week. Omdat we vertrouwen hebben in jouw expertise als Specialit informatiebeveiliging, bieden we je bij een fulltime dienstverband onderstaande aanvullende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Een goed salaris, afgestemd op jouw kennis en ervaring tussen de € 4.000 en € 6.000.

  • Een contract voor onbepaalde tijd en 100% premievrije pensioenregeling. Hiermee houd je netto meer over!

  • 25 vakantiedagen, met de mogelijkheid tot het bijkopen.

  • Voldoende opleidings- en studiemogelijkheden met een jaarlijks studiebudget van €3500,- en 5 studiedagen.

  • Leaseauto of mobiliteitsbudget, Apple MacBook of Microsoft Surface en een iPhone.

  • Een sportschool bij ons op kantoor en daarnaast nog een bedrijfsfitness-regeling, mocht je toch lekker dicht bij huis willen sporten.

  • Vrijdagmiddag borrels, bedrijfsuitjes, maandelijkse BBQ en gezellige collega’s.

  • Goede ontwikkeling- en doorgroeimogelijkheden maar we helpen ook jouw persoonlijke leerpad te bewandelen.

Waarom Quality jouw volgende stap is

Als kennispartij stellen we hoge eisen aan de kwaliteit van ons team. Security & Privacy is een fantastisch werkveld met verschillende expertisegebieden. Je hebt wellicht kennis en ervaring op een of meerdere expertisegebieden.

Tegelijkertijd zijn we ons ervan bewust dat jouw persoonlijke kwaliteiten, ambities en bijdrage aan het team minstens zo belangrijk zijn.

Requirements

Wat je meebrengt

Jij bent een gedreven Specialist Informatiebeveiliging die houdt van uitdaging en verantwoordelijkheid. Je weet hoe je complexe informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken analyseert en vertaalt naar praktische oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je klaar voor een volgende stap in jouw ontwikkeling.

Verder beschik je over:

  • Minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als Information Security Officer, Specialist Informatiebeveiliging of in een vergelijkbare senior securityfunctie.

  • Hbo/wo-werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring met zowel tactische als operationele informatiebeveiligingsvraagstukken.

  • Ervaring met het ontwikkelen, implementeren en onderhouden van beveiligingsbeleid en beveiligingsprocedures.

  • Een goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

  • Ervaring met risicobeoordelingen, risicomanagement en incidentmanagement.

  • Grondige kennis van informatiebeveiligingsprincipes.

  • Kennis van één of meerdere informatiebeveiligingsstandaarden en regelgevingskaders, zoals ISO 27001, NIS2 en de Cyber Resilience Act.

  • Een certificering zoals CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSP of CEH, of de bereidheid om een van deze certificeringen te behalen.

  • Kennis van security governance en risicomanagement.

About Us

Revalue is a carbon credit development platform focused on one of the planet’s most critical but complex challenges - seeing nature regenerated at a planetary scale.

Our mission is to design the most cutting-edge and trusted nature credits for our planet.

We are bringing together a world-class team - forestry experts, ecologists, applied AI scientists, software engineers, geospatial analysts, commercial specialists, economists, and more - to create the unique DNA required to reimagine nature credits.

About The Role

We are looking for a Head of Finance to be the architect of our financial system.

We aren't just looking for someone to count the numbers; we are looking for someone to build the engine that helps us understand them. As we scale and grow, we need a "Full-Stack" Finance leader who can ensure our financial foundations are rock solid while designing the roadmap for our next stage of growth.

You will report directly to the COO and work closely with the leadership team - making a lasting impact on our finance strategy.

Who You Are

You understand the duality of modern finance. On one hand, you know that Accounting Integrity is the bedrock - if the books are wrong, the strategy is wrong. On the other hand, you view Systems Design as the lever. You love the puzzle of connecting software (Xero, CRM, Payroll) to automate the manual work so you can focus on the bigger picture.

Why This Role Matters

This isn't just about keeping the lights on. It’s about building a financial nervous system that gives us the confidence to move fast. You will be the bridge between the raw data and the strategic decisions that define our future.

What You'll Build

The Foundation (Accounting Operations & Data Integrity): You will manage the accounting function and take full ownership of our books.

  • Manage the Function: Direct and supervise our external bookkeeping firm. You will review their work, challenge their coding, and hold them accountable for accuracy.

  • Own the Close: Drive a disciplined process to ensure our books are accurate and "audit-ready" by Business Day 10.

  • Statutory Compliance: Manage external tax/accounting partners to ensure seamless filing of Annual Accounts, VAT, R&D tax credits, etc. You own the deadline.

The Machine (Systems Architecture & Spend Governance): You will serve as the architect of our finance stack, optimising how money and data move through the company.

  • Optimise the Stack: Audit and upgrade our toolset (Xero, CRM, Payroll, Banks). Your goal is to automate data entry and streamline processes as much as possible.

  • Design Spend Controls: Architect the company’s expense culture. You will implement tools to ensure clear approval workflows and real-time visibility into burn rate.

  • Scalable Processes: Build the internal SOPs that allow us to scale without the finance function breaking.

The Compass (Financial Reporting & Cash Management): You will provide the visibility we need to navigate.

  • Internal Reporting: Deliver monthly and quarterly financial packages for the Leadership Team (P&L, Balance Sheet, Variance Analysis).

  • Cash Flow: Own the cash flow forecast. You will manage working capital tightly to extend our runway.

  • Board Reporting: Prepare the monthly investor updates and quarterly board decks that tell the strategic story behind the numbers.

The Future (Strategic Planning & Commercial Finance): You will partner with the C-suite and teams to build complex models that unlock growth

  • Series B Readiness: Build and maintain the multi-year financial model required for our next fundraise

  • Project Finance: Partner with operational teams to build robust financial & commercial models and implement processes to ensure project controls.

What You Bring

  • Experience: You’ve got a strong background in Finance and this is not your first rodeo

  • The "Controller" Mindset: You can spot a reconciliation error from a mile away. You take pride in accurate books.

  • The "Architect" Skillset: You don't just use finance software; you configure it. You know how to integrate systems to create a seamless flow of data.

  • The "Modeller" Brain: You can build a multi-year integrated financial model that stands up to VC scrutiny.

  • Qualification: CIMA/ACCA/ACA (or equivalent - fully completed).

What We Offer

  1. The opportunity to shape the future of nature-based climate finance

  2. A mission-driven organisation with shared purpose, culture, and values

  3. A diverse team of colleagues, partners and clients based all around the world

  4. Meaningful equity in an early-stage startup with a growing and trusted brand

  5. Flexible working environment with a team deeply committed to impact

  6. Generously enhanced, gender-neutral parental leave policy

  7. Wellbeing support, including company-funded access to therapy

jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Platform Architect who can set the standard for how we build, ship, and operate reliable cloud platforms at scale.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Platform Architect who can set the standard for how we build, ship, and operate reliable cloud platforms at scale. You sit at the intersection of platform engineering and SRE. You'll own the path from infrastructure design to reliable production services, bringing DevOps rigor to complex systems.

This is not a ticket-processing role, and it's not a research role. You'll tackle hard problems: platform reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, deployment automation, and workload operations. You'll have the scope to solve them properly. Senior professionals here identify problems before they're asked and raise the ceiling on what the platform can do.

What you will work on

  • Build and operate scalable backend and AI infrastructure, supporting real-time and batch workloads with a focus on performance, reliability, and multi-tenant architecture.
  • Design and maintain deployment workflows across services and environments, including versioning, staged rollouts, automated releases, monitoring, and safe rollback strategies.
  • Build and operate LLM and agentic systems in production, integrating model providers, APIs, gateways, tools, and external services while managing rate limits, reliability, guardrails, and graceful degradation.
  • Develop reusable services, APIs, automation, and data pipelines that support AI-powered products and internal platform capabilities.
  • Extend infrastructure-as-code across the platform using Terraform and reusable patterns to provision and manage cloud services consistently across projects and environments.
  • Maintain GitOps-based deployment workflows using tools such as ArgoCD, improving automation and consistency across environments and tenants.
  • Run distributed workloads on Kubernetes (GKE), managing scaling, workload placement, tenant isolation, service reliability, and infrastructure capacity.
  • Improve platform observability and reliability through metrics, logging, tracing, SLOs, alerting, incident response practices, and operational tooling.
  • Identify performance and infrastructure cost improvements across cloud services, compute resources, APIs, and AI workloads.
  • Use agentic coding and AI development tools to accelerate engineering work, including scaffolding services, generating and reviewing infrastructure and application code, debugging, and automating repetitive workflows.

What you won’t find here

A platform team that maintains the status quo. We're actively building: new scale requirements, new architectural domains, and an ML/AI footprint that's growing fast. Senior engineers here shape how the platform evolves, and the tools available to do it are better than they've ever been.

Requirements

Must have

  • 5+ years in platform engineering, SRE, or infrastructure, with meaningful time operating production systems at scale.
  • Strong SRE/DevOps foundation. You've owned reliability for production services, defined and measured SLOs, run post-mortems, and driven measurable improvements.
  • Deep Terraform expertise. You actively manage complex Terraform state, reusable modules, and multi-project configurations in production, with CI-driven plan/apply workflows.
  • Strong GitOps background (ArgoCD or Flux in production). You understand declarative infrastructure management at depth and have opinions on how to do it well.
  • Deep Kubernetes knowledge. You've operated clusters in production, dealt with real failure modes, and understand the system at the control plane level.
  • Strong cloud infrastructure background across at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including networking, compute, IAM, storage, and multi-account or multi-project design.
  • Hands-on experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Cloud Build, GitLab CI, or equivalent).
  • Automation-first thinking at a senior level. You implement systems that eliminate entire categories of manual work.
  • Active user of agentic coding tools. You know how to direct them effectively, review their output critically, and use them to multiply your output.
  • Strong communicator. You can articulate operational decisions, technical trade-offs, and incident summaries clearly to engineers and leadership alike.

Nice to have

  • MLOps experience, including hands-on experience deploying and operating ML or AI workloads in production.
  • Strong GCP experience, including VPC networking, Compute Engine, IAM, Cloud Storage, multi-project or organization design, and GKE (Standard and/or Autopilot).
  • Hands-on experience with GCP data services, especially BigQuery in production: partitioning and clustering, query cost and performance tuning, and dataset-level IAM. Familiarity with at least one of Dataflow, Pub/Sub, or Dataproc.
  • Experience with GPU/accelerator scheduling and node lifecycle management in production (e.g., GKE node auto-provisioning, GPU time-sharing, or equivalent).
  • Experience operating LLM inference at scale, managing provider quotas/throttling (TPS/TUPS), gateways, caching, and guardrails (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini API, or equivalent).

jobs.description:
INDG creates digital twins and CGI content systems for global product brands. In our Automotive vertical, that means turning complex vehicle data into images and animations that can represent a car across configurators, launch campaigns, print, exhibitions, and promotional videos.

We are looking for a Senior 3D Artist who can turn complex automotive data into polished visual output. You will work from high-poly vehicle assets, build materials, render stills and animations, composite final images, and keep quality consistent across large content sets.

Your impact is visible. You will create content that represents premium automotive brands in configurators, campaigns, launch campaigns, retail tools, and large-format experiences. The work must look beautiful, but it also has to survive scale.

What You Will Do

  • Create automotive CGI that holds up at close range
    Build still images and animations from high-poly vehicle models. Texture, shade, light, render, and composite final content for automotive brands with strict visual standards. You will work on exteriors, interiors, detail crops, accessories, colorways, wheels, trims, and motion sequences.

  • Own the render, not just the task
    Evaluate image quality from a senior production perspective. You can see when a render issue comes from lighting, material response, geometry, camera setup, render settings, or compositing. You will refine clearcoat, metallic flakes, glass, rubber, leather, stitching, displays, brushed metal, chrome, and shadow behavior until the image feels physically and visually right.

  • Work inside scalable production pipelines
    Create scenes and outputs that can survive large content sets. You will follow naming, versioning, render-layer, compositing, and scene-organization standards. You will help keep assets clean, reusable, and ready for configurators, campaign derivatives, market adaptations, and automated content workflows.

  • Improve quality while delivering content
    Implement feedback from art directors, leads, clients, and production teams without losing control of the setup. You will spot recurring issues, improve material libraries, refine lighting templates, document useful fixes, and help reduce manual rework across automotive production.

Requirements

You Have

  • Strong experience in automotive CGI and high-end 3D production. You are comfortable working with complex high-poly models, physically based materials, lighting setups, render passes, compositing workflows, and final image polish.

  • You know 3ds Max, V-Ray, Photoshop, and Nuke or After Effects at a professional level. Your portfolio or showreel demonstrates seniority through visual judgment, technical control, and finished output, not just clean modeling or isolated shots.

  • You can communicate clearly in English with artists, leads, producers, and technical teams. You can explain what is wrong in an image, what needs to change, and what tradeoff is being made.

Why Join INDG

INDG has spent more than 20 years building visual production systems for global brands. We are not a traditional creative agency and not a pure software vendor. We build the systems that turn physical products into digital twins, production-grade CGI, and scalable content.

Grip extends that work into AI-assisted content orchestration. For a Senior 3D Artist, that means your craft does not disappear into automation. It defines the quality standard the system must reproduce.

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

Summary:

The Patient Contact Center fulfills FCS’s mission by providing world class consumer care by following it values and service standards. The Patient Contact Center department will support the practices with scheduling all various appointments, from clinic services, internal and external radiology services etc.

Schedule patients via incoming and outbound calls with a focus on customer service under a contact center manager team as assigned. Provides operational support in delivery of patient care in a call setting environment. Responsible for meeting and exceeding standard consumer care metrics such as answering phones in a timely and professional manner, scheduling appointments efficiently and accurately, obtain and input insurance information, maintaining compliance standards and provide a quality consumer experience by meeting consumers’ needs.

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Builds relationships with patients, consumers and co-workers in a virtual setting, typically via the telephone or Microsoft Teams.
  • Handles inbound and outbound calls for multiple clinics from various entities to assist and or route to the appropriate assigned practices/team breakdown.
  • Communicates in a cordial, professional manner with patients via phone.
  • Meets daily, weekly and monthly qualitative and quantitative performance metrics.

  • New patient registration (inputting demographic information, insurance information, etc.). Complete new patient process and schedule accordingly.

  • Fills patient cancellation slots efficiently in keeping schedules booked for the practitioners.
  • Maintains company equipment according to company guidelines and reports equipment concerns to immediate leader.
  • Respond timely to incoming calls and route calls or take message as appropriate.
  • Maintain individual and departmental metrics and KPI’s.
  • Schedule appointments for multiple clinics and physicians as directed by clinic and provider guidelines.
  • If outside testing requires preparation, give the patient the preparation and explain process to patient/family member.
  • Collect patient payments based on standard operating procedure.
  • Document/update EMR with required information based on standard operating procedure. attend meetings and training sessions and report any changes or concerns to the supervisor.
  • Must establish and maintain effective work relationships with new and existing customers through a high degree of professionalism and excellent interpersonal/communication skills.
  • Comply with all Federal, State laws and regulations pertaining to patient care, patients’ rights, safety, billing, human resources and collections. Adhere to all Company and departmental policies and procedures, including IT policies and procedures and Disaster Recovery Plan.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • High School Graduate or Equivalent
  • Previous customer service experience.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ years’ experience in the Health Care preferred.
  • Call center experience preferred.
  • Proven ability to train and audit others.

CORE COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

Individuals must possess these knowledge, skills and abilities and be able to explain and to demonstrate that he/she can perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation, using some other combination of skills and abilities.

  • Proficient with computer programs: Email, PowerPoint, Excel, Word.
  • Demonstrates interpersonal skills by effectively communicating with all levels of management, staff and outside vendors and patients.
  • Strong emphasis on organizational skills and strong attention to detail and ability and willingness to multi task.
  • Ability to deal with data that is of a sensitive and confidential nature.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Displays professional interactions with all levels of internal and external patients’/customers as demonstrated by work history and interview process.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS PREFERRED:

  • Knowledge of EHR.
  • Any combination of education, training or experience that provides the knowledge, skills and abilities required to successfully accomplish the assigned duties and responsibilities of the position.

VALUES:

  • Patient First – Keeping the patient at the center of everything we do.
  • Accountability – Taking responsibility for our actions.
  • Commitment & Care – Upholding FCS vision through every action
  • Team – Working together, one team, one mission.

Expectations for all Employees

Every FCS employee is expected to regularly conduct themselves in a professional and respectful manner, to comply with all labor laws, workplace policy and workplace practices. Employees are expected to bring issues of any forms of workplace harassment, discrimination or other potential improprieties to the attention of their management or the human resources department.

SCREENINGS – Background and drug screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug testing. Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.

jobs.description:
Marcus Evans is a global leader in business intelligence, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. With over four decades of experience and teams of highly experienced professionals across 50+ office locations, we deliver impactful strategic insight and business development guidance across all sectors through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms, performance coaching, and curated corporate event programmes. Based in 30+ countries, we create services that connect decision-makers, spark innovation, and drive real business growth.

ME Perform is the performance improvement consultancy of the Marcus Evans Group. We work differently from most of the training market: we diagnose what is actually holding an organisation's people back, design a programme specifically for them, deliver it over months rather than days, and measure whether behaviour genuinely changed, then hand the client written evidence of what improved. Because the design work is done in-house by our Programme Scientists, our trainers get something rare: a fully built, properly researched session, briefed to them in advance, delivered to a cohort who have already been diagnosed and who are expecting to work rather than watch.

Job Summary

You will deliver live sessions, typically 90 to 150 minutes, mostly online, working from a session design and a written brief prepared for you by the Programme Scientist.

This is a delivery role, and deliberately so. You are not asked to write content, find clients, or sell anything. You are asked to be outstanding in the room. Based on the seniority and ability of the applicant there will also be an opportunity extend this role to a follow-up coach with the same group.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver live sessions to our designed structure, to a consistently high standard.

  • Prepare from the written brief you receive at least five working days before each session — preparation time is paid within the session fee.

  • Run structured practice: our sessions are built around participants doing the thing, not listening to it explained. Expect to spend much of each session facilitating small-group work, giving feedback, and coaching in the moment.

  • Manage the room — including the sceptical senior participant, the quiet group, and the one who wants to debate rather than practise.

  • Submit brief written session notes within 48 hours of every session, so the Programme Scientist can adjust what comes next.

  • Take part in accreditation before your first client session, and stay open to observation and feedback afterwards.

Qualifications

Essential

  • 5-10 years of substantial experience in facilitating live learning or development sessions for professional or managerial audiences in a corporate setting.

  • Genuinely strong online delivery — confident running breakout groups, keeping cameras on and energy up, and handling the mechanics without it disrupting the session.

  • Comfortable delivering material you did not write, to a structure you are asked to keep to. This is the single most important requirement of the role.

  • Skilled at running practice and giving direct, useful feedback to adults — rather than presenting.

  • Reliable on the administrative side: punctual, responsive, and consistent with session notes.

  • Fluent, credible professional English, and comfortable with senior audiences.

Desirable

  • Experience in one or more of: leadership and management development, communication and influence, collaboration, resilience and change, or working across cultures.

  • A coaching qualification, or experience delivering one-to-one as well as group work.

  • Additional languages, or experience delivering to international cohorts working in a second language.

  • Familiarity with evidence-based learning design — you do not need to be a researcher, but you should be interested in why a session is built the way it is.

How the engagement works

  • Paid accreditation first: a methodology induction, then you deliver a full session for our Programme Scientist to observe, paid at half the standard session fee. Accreditation is completed before any client-facing work.

  • You are then briefed and booked per session. Fees are paid per session with preparation included, invoiced on delivery, on 30-day terms.

  • Standard contract terms apply, including confidentiality, intellectual property assignment for anything created in connection with the work, and non-solicitation of our clients. These are shared in full before accreditation.

  • If a client cancels at short notice, you are protected: cancellations inside five working days are paid in full.

Marcus Evans is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Nearfield brings together leading experts in science and engineering to develop a unique, high-throughput Scanning Probe Microscopy (SPM) platform delivering true 3D, sub-nanometer resolution metrology at production scale.

We are looking for a senior semiconductor expert with deep experience in etching, thin-film deposition, atomic layer deposition (ALD), and metallization, gained within a leading-edge fab, research institute, or semiconductor equipment company.

This expert will lead Nearfield Instruments’ application and technology direction for advanced patterning, thin-film formation, conformal deposition, and metal integration. The role will identify the most critical process-control challenges, translate them into clear metrology requirements, and drive the development of new applications, capabilities, and product features that create greater value for customers.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead the identification of unmet metrology needs and critical process-control gaps in etch, deposition, ALD, and metallization.

  • Define the most valuable measurements, specifications, and use cases, including trench and via depth, sidewall profile, recess, footing, bowing, surface roughness, film conformality, step coverage, thickness uniformity, interface topography, and metal dishing or overburden.

  • Set application priorities and translate customer and manufacturing needs into product and technology roadmaps.

  • Lead engagement with customers, process engineers, and equipment partners to validate requirements and accelerate adoption.

  • Drive the development of metrology solutions that improve process control, yield, chamber matching, qualification time, and manufacturing performance.

  • Guide R&D and product teams on measurement performance, workflow integration, sampling strategies, and high-volume manufacturing requirements.

The ideal candidate has:

  • Significant experience in semiconductor process integration, dry or wet etch, CVD, PVD, ALD, electroplating, or metallization.

  • Strong understanding of metrology, inspection, and process control in high-volume manufacturing.

  • Experience working with leading semiconductor fabs, equipment suppliers, or advanced R&D organizations.

  • A proven ability to lead cross-functional teams and convert complex process challenges into differentiated products and applications.

jobs.description:
You'll lead engineering for the Empire Family –Goodgame EmpireandEmpire: Four Kingdoms, the flagship MMO strategy franchise ofGoodgame Studios, a studio with over 200 million registered players and €1B+ in lifetime revenue. Two titles live for over a decade, generating significant revenue, consistently profitable, and a strategic core ofStillfront's portfolio. Millions of players, always-on worlds, real impact when latency slips by 20 ms. This is not a side project. It's a key franchise you own the engineering for as it moves into its next growth phase.

We're looking for a technical leader who ships and owns the whole picture: the architect and reviewer across backend and frontend, who also grows the engineers and the practices around them. You lead by setting direction and raising the bar, not by stepping away from the code. You don't have to be the deepest specialist in every layer, we have strong frontend and backend experts. We need the person who oversees both, connects them, and is accountable for the whole thing landing reliably and on time.

Part of the leverage here is agentic. You and your team operate at many times the throughput of a classical engineering group by orchestrating AI agents, not typing every line. The agents do the volume, you stay the architect and the reviewer, and you set the standard for how that's done responsibly.

YOUR MISSION

  • Lead engineering across backend and frontend: set technical direction, own delivery end-to-end, grow the team through mentoring and reviews that raise the bar.

  • Translate fuzzy business requirements into precise technical solutions that both humans and agents can execute, and deliver them reliably and on time.

  • Design and operate high-throughput, low-latency Java services (JDK 17+) on AWS, K8s, Terraform, ArgoCD, with MySQL and Redis layers handling millions of player rows.

  • Oversee the game frontend (HTML5, Adobe AIR / Unity) built by specialists: guide the architecture, review the work, keep it coherent with the backend.

  • Own CI/CD, observability, and on-call for what your team ships.

  • Define how the org adopts agentic practices: tooling, review standards, and what "done" means when an agent wrote most of the diff.

YOUR PROFILE

Leadership

  • Proven experience leading engineers (engineering lead, tech lead, or similar), accountable for a team's output, not just your own.

  • You grow people, make decisions under ambiguity, and keep a team shipping without becoming the bottleneck. Your standards on architecture, testing, and review set the tone.

  • You oversee backend and frontend without being the top specialist in each: you know enough to guide, review, and unblock.

Technical skills

  • 6+ years backend Java, expert level. Distributed systems, concurrency, GC tuning, and SQL optimisation are second nature.

  • Deep AWS / cloud-native stack (K8s, Docker, Terraform).

  • Enough frontend/game-client fluency to lead it credibly and hold a real architectural conversation with Adobe AIR / Unity engineers.

  • Architectural judgement: you design clean, resilient systems, you don't just accept what the agent produces.

  • Excellent written English.

  • Availability in German time zone (CET/CEST).

AI and agentic engineering

  • At minimum: genuinely excited about AI-assisted engineering and already using it daily.

  • Ideally: you already run a real agentic coding practice and can talk concretely about it (structuring context for long-running tasks, when to let an agent run vs. intervene, MCP / custom tools / skills, reviewing agent code without becoming a bottleneck).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on Adobe AIR and/or Unity experience (built or shipped game-client code yourself).

  • Gaming backend experience (matchmaking, inventories, leaderboards, economy services).

  • Event-driven architectures (Kafka, Kinesis, SQS/SNS); real-time telemetry or anti-cheat.

  • Published work on agentic workflows (blog posts, OSS subagents/skills, internal tooling).

WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

  • AI-first from the top down. We already run agentic workflows in production, leadership builds with Claude Code daily, and you have full autonomy over your AI stack. No mandated tools, no legacy process to fight.

  • You lead, and you build.Not a management role that pulls you off the keyboard.

  • You own the whole stack: backend and frontend, strong specialists on both sides, you connect them into one coherent system.

  • Scale with immediate feedback: systems players touch every minute, where engineering decisions show up in metrics the same day.

HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW

Expect to walk us through the technical, the leadership, and the delivery side.

On the technical side: an agentic workflow you've actually built or used – the specs and context you feed it, how you structure the loop, where it breaks, how you catch it, and what you'd never let an agent do unsupervised. Bring screen-shares, repos, prompts, whatever shows the real thing.

On the leadership side: how you've grown engineers, overseen work outside your own deepest specialty, translated business asks into shipped software, and made hard calls under ambiguity. We're more interested in your judgement and battle scars than in polished slides.

jobs.excerpt: Join Cognizant's Workday Student Practice in Australia and New Zealand and help universities transform how they manage student finances.
jobs.description:
Join Cognizant's Workday Student Practice in Australia and New Zealand and help universities transform how they manage student finances. Working directly with clients on Workday Student deployments, you'll lead design and configuration across tuition and fee assessment, billing, payments, sponsorships, refunds and reconciliation. Your role goes beyond working out how Workday Student can meet a university's needs. You'll help them use it to support their strategic goals, from improving the student experience to strengthening financial sustainability and compliance. This is a real opportunity to grow your career while helping shape how the sector operates.

This role suits someone with a background in student accounts, university finance or student administration who wants to turn their knowledge of student financial regulations and processes, and their commitment to supporting students, into a consulting career. You'll bring higher education and student finance expertise to every engagement, working closely with finance teams, student administration and student services, and making sure your designs align with Student Records, Workday Financial Management and other areas of the Workday platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery and design sessions for tuition and fee assessment, student billing, payments, payment plans, sponsorships, refunds and receivables.
  • Configure Student Financials business processes, rules, charge structures, due dates and accounting related requirements.
  • Design practical handling for waivers, adjustments, reversals, third party arrangements and exceptional cases.
  • Configure student account processes in alignment with institutional policy, financial controls and regulatory requirements.
  • Work with Student Records and finance stakeholders to align the financial impacts of enrolment, changes, withdrawal and completion events.
  • Document requirements, design decisions and configuration.
  • Apply your higher education experience to shape practical future-state processes for student finance and student administration teams.
  • Bring an understanding of how Australian or New Zealand universities manage student fees and finances to design discussions, including Commonwealth supported places, HELP loans, the eCAF process and Commonwealth Assistance Notice, so Workday Student is configured for local fee structures, funding arrangements, terminology and policy settings.
  • Identify data, security, reporting and integration requirements, including payment gateways, banking and finance platforms.
  • Define reconciliation, operational reporting and audit requirements for student financial activity.
  • Prepare and execute unit testing, support end to end testing and assist with defect resolution.
  • Support data conversion validation, opening balance activities, cutover preparation, training and go live readiness.
  • Provide clear advice on Workday leading practices while recognising institutional context and policy obligations.
  • Contribute reusable configuration guidance, test assets and delivery methods to the Cognizant Student Practice.

Experience we are looking for

  • Experience in student accounts, student fees, university finance, receivables or a related higher education finance function.
  • Understanding of tuition and fee assessment, billing, payments, refunds, sponsorships and reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of Commonwealth supported places and HELP loans, including student contribution amounts, HELP eligibility and census date rules, and how they flow through fee assessment, student accounts and government reporting.
  • Familiarity with the regulatory context for student fees and finance in Australia or New Zealand, such as HELP arrangements under the Higher Education Support Act, TCSI reporting and ESOS National Code refund requirements, or Fees Free and StudyLink arrangements.
  • Proven experience guiding business stakeholders through key operational and policy decisions, including presenting options, explaining trade-offs and securing agreement.
  • Experience implementing, supporting or serving as a super-user for student information systems (SIS) or enterprise finance systems.
  • Ability to translate financial policy and operational requirements into structured system design.
  • Experience facilitating workshops, documenting decisions and working across finance, student administration and technology teams preferred.
  • Experience with testing, financial validation, data conversion, training or deployment readiness activities preferred.

About the Cognizant Workday Student Practice

The Cognizant Workday Student Practice is focused exclusively on helping universities across Australia and New Zealand transform the way they support students, faculty and administrators throughout the student lifecycle.

What makes our practice different is the combination of higher education practitioners and Workday specialists working together. Many of our consultants have worked inside universities as academic services professionals before moving into consulting. That experience allows us to bring practical insight into the operational, regulatory and policy considerations that shape solution design.

We work with institutions to design and implement sustainable Workday Student solutions that support local regulatory requirements, align to institutional strategy and remain adaptable as university needs evolve. Our goal is not simply to deploy technology, but to help universities establish a foundation they can continue to own, operate and enhance long after implementation is complete.

Why choose Cognizant:

  • Entrepreneurial environment that welcomes your ideas
  • Opportunity to do great work
  • Outreach programs that support communities and tap into your volunteer spirit
  • Learning opportunities to help current needs and advancement
  • Global operations, with opportunities in North America, Europe and Asia Pacific
  • An abundance of Affinity groups to meet your needs

Cognizant Core Values:

  • Work as One: We think beyond roles, relying on each other’s strengths to win as a team.
  • Raise the Bar: We always aim for excellence in how we work and what we deliver.
  • Dare to Innovate: We push boundaries and take chances to reimagine what’s possible.
  • Do the Right Thing: We all lead with integrity and always make the ethical choice.
  • Own It: We own the outcomes for our company, colleagues, and community.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Embedded Payments
jobs.excerpt: About the opportunityJoin our Embedded Payments team as a DevOps Engineer to make a real impact every day.
jobs.description:
About the opportunity

Join our Embedded Payments team as a DevOps Engineer to make a real impact every day. We say that because we know that every conversation we have, every pipeline we build and every system we automate is another opportunity for us to elevate everyday life experiences for our customers and the people and communities they serve.

Reporting into the DevOps Engineering Manager, you'll help us build and scale the infrastructure behind our cloud-native payment orchestration platform that processes significant transaction volume across multiple Xplor brands. You are passionate about building reliable, secure systems and the automation that keeps them running smoothly while maintaining engineering best practices. You think about infrastructure end-to-end, from CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code down to monitoring, alerting, and incident response. You're comfortable owning the platform that everything runs on and collaborating closely with backend, frontend, QA, and engineering teams to ship and operate high-quality software.

Our Tech Stack

  • Cloud: AWS (ECS, Lambda, RDS/Aurora PostgreSQL, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, Cognito, KMS, VPC)
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform
  • CI/CD: Bitbucket Pipelines
  • Observability: SigNoz, Grafana, CloudWatch
  • Performance & Load Testing: k6
  • Security & Compliance: PCI DSS, AWS-native controls
  • Application stack supported: Node.js services, React frontends

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Design, build, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Terraform, with attention to scalability, cost, and PCI-scoped network segmentation
  • Own and evolve the observability stack — SigNoz for distributed tracing and metrics, Grafana for dashboards, structured logging — so engineers can answer "what's happening in production" without paging you
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines in Bitbucket Pipelines, including deployment guardrails, automated rollback strategies, and environment promotion workflows
  • Design and run performance and load tests with k6 or other custom tools as needed, establish baseline benchmarks, and partner with engineering to address bottlenecks before they reach production
  • Participate in on-call rotations, lead incident response for infrastructure issues, and drive postmortems that produce durable fixes
  • Define and track SLOs, error budgets, and operational KPIs for payment-critical services
  • Improve deployment velocity and safety — faster pipelines, better preview environments, safer migration tooling
  • Partner with security and compliance to maintain PCI DSS posture, support audits (Armanino/Vanta), and codify controls
  • Manage cost and capacity across AWS — right-sizing, reserved capacity strategy, and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Use AI-assisted tools effectively to accelerate infrastructure work without compromising review quality or security posture

What would make me a good candidate?

We are looking for curious and empathetic people. We also love to hear from people who are motivated by meaningful work, resonate with our core values, have a positive outlook, are comfortable with ambiguity and thrive working in an ever-evolving and complex environment. We are inspired by meeting big-picture thinkers and doers, people who can be both tactical and strategic, aim high and put people first in everything they do.

You'll need:

  • 5+ years of professional DevOps, SRE, or Platform Engineering experience, with a Computer Science/Engineering degree or equivalent
  • Strong hands-on AWS experience across compute (ECS, Lambda), networking (VPC, security groups), data (RDS/Aurora), and event-driven services (SQS, EventBridge)
  • Production Terraform experience — module design, state management, drift handling, and multi-environment patterns
  • Experience operating an observability stack in production; familiarity with SigNoz, Grafana, or comparable tools (Datadog, New Relic, Prometheus)
  • Experience designing and running load tests with k6 or comparable tools (JMeter, Gatling, Locust)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar)
  • Strong shell scripting ability or similar in a scripting oriented language (Python, Go, etc...)
  • Ability to read and understand back end and and front end code in order to implement infrastructure more effectively
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals such as sockets, routing, load balancing, SSL/TLS encryption, tunneling, firewalls/security groups, etc...,
  • Understanding of access control and identity management (IAM, OIDC, Cognito, OAUTH in general or similar)
  • Comfort leading incident response and writing postmortems that drive systemic improvement
  • Fluency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, etc.) and an articulate point of view on where they help and where they don't
  • Comfortable working on a 100% remote team and operating independently within an agile group

It would be great if you also have:

  • Experience operating PCI-compliant or otherwise regulated environments
  • Experience with payments infrastructure or other high-availability transactional systems
  • Familiarity with Vanta or comparable compliance automation tooling
  • Experience tuning PostgreSQL for high-throughput workloads
  • Exposure to KMS-based cryptography, secrets management, and key rotation strategies
  • Experience with chaos engineering or game-day exercises

At Xplor, we believe that the best innovation and ideas happen at the intersections of our differences - people of diverse cultures, generations, disciplines, and lived experiences. So even if you think you do not tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Values and Life at Xplor

Our five core values guide us from how we hire and recognise our team members to how we interact with our customers day to day:

  • Find a better way
  • Do the right thing
  • Say it straight
  • Win together
  • Own the outcome

If these values sound like you, and describe people you want to work with, you will thrive at Xplor.

As an Xplorer, you will be part of a global network of talented colleagues who will support your success. We look for commonalities and shared passions and give people the tools they need to deliver great work and grow at speed.

Some of our perks and benefits are:

  • Paid Parental Leave benefit programs
  • #GiveBackDays/Commitment to social impact – 3 extra days off to volunteer and give back to your local community
  • Ongoing dedication to Diversity & Inclusion initiatives such as D&I Council, Global Mentorship Program
  • Access to free mental health support
  • Flexible working arrangements

Ready to apply?

To start your application, please submit your resume, and we will be in touch as soon as we can. Please include the word "moonshot" at the top of your message to the Hiring Manager so that we know you took the time to read our job ad.

Before you apply

To be considered for employment, you must be legally authorised to work in India. This applies to remote roles too, as we can only employ people who reside within India. Xplor does not sponsor visas, either at the time of hire or at any later time. We're also not able to offer contractor arrangements or Employer of Record engagements for this position at this stage.

Please apply through our careers portal or external job boards only. We're unable to upload emailed applications, as our process requires you to answer screening questions directly.

We also invite you to check out our Candidate FAQs for more information about our recruitment process .

Interview Recording and Background Checks

As part of our hiring process, successful candidates will be asked to complete background and identity verification checks. Many of our roles are remote, and to protect both candidates and our business from recruitment fraud, we may record video interviews during the process. We keep any recordings and related data only for as long as the hiring process is active and do not retain them afterwards.

EEO and Artificial Intelligence

We believe in transparent hiring. We use an applicant tracking system with artificial intelligence-enabled features to support our recruitment process, but our recruitment team makes all hiring decisions after human review. We do not rely on artificial intelligence to make final hiring decisions. Find our Candidate AI Usage guidelines here.

Xplor is committed to providing equal opportunities in employment and creating an inclusive work environment. We provide equal opportunities to all our employees and to all eligible applicants for employment in our company. We do not unfairly discriminate on any ground, including race, religion, color, ancestry, marital status, gender, sexual orientation, age, nationality, ethnic origin, disability or any other category protected by applicable law.

We make it a priority to respond to every applicant.

Xplor Technologies powers the experiences at the heart of everyday life. Through modern vertical software, embedded payments, and AI-powered capabilities, we help businesses in fitness, recreation, golf and club, field services, laundry, education, and other membership-based and service-based industries simplify operations, uncover insights, and elevate customer and member experiences.

jobs.excerpt: About RivetRivet is an AI-native accounting firm.
jobs.description:
About Rivet

Rivet is an AI-native accounting firm. In less than 3 years, we've built a T500 firm in the US, combining corporate and personal income tax, sales tax, R&D credits, and bookkeeping into a single, all-inclusive experience that eliminates the worst parts of tax season for real businesses and the people who run them.

Our platform is designed to feel invisible: it guides clients through their tax to-dos, automates the drudgery for preparers, and gets out of the way when it's not needed. We measure success in time saved and returns completed, not vanity usage metrics. We run Rivet (the firm) on Rivet (the platform) because owning the stack makes it possible to deeply embed AI into every step of our workflows, far more than our competition will ever be able to relying on third-party/off-the-shelf tooling.

Our team of 75 supports more than 1,300 clients, including some of the most innovative companies in the US — Cursor, Cognition, and ModRetro — and their executives, investors, and employees.

And while we may have just gotten started a little over two years ago, this isn't our first rodeo:

  • Nick Abouzeid (cofounder & CEO) comes from Ramp, where he ran three of their Growth teams from $100M → $600M in ARR

  • Kyle Christenson (cofounder & Head of Tax) comes from the IRS, where he spent six years as an auditor before leaving to start his own firm over a decade ago

We're well-funded, growing quickly, and sustainable. We've raised over $7M to date, from investors like XYZ Ventures, Susa Ventures, Haystack Ventures, and 40+ executives from Ramp, Anduril, Physical Intelligence, & more.

Why this role is different

At six engineers, features don't stop at an API boundary. The person who designs the schema is the person who ships the screen and the person who hears about it when a preparer can't find the button.

  • Ownership from first commit to production. Engineers design, build, ship, and maintain their work — no handoffs, no middle-management mazes.

  • Decisions happen at the edge. Engineers talk to clients and tax preparers directly. We optimize for speed and context, not committee consensus.

  • Clear is kind. We surface problems early, talk about tradeoffs openly, and don't sugarcoat. We're kind by being honest, not by being vague.

  • Pragmatic stacks. We pick tools that solve real problems. If it doesn't help us ship faster, safer, or better, we don't use it.

  • Skin in the game. We ship things we'd be proud to put our name on — and if something breaks, we own it and fix it fast.

Our stack

Six engineers today, five languages. You'd work across the first two:

  • Platform: Go, as a modular monolith — Connect RPC over protobuf, Go Fx for wiring, sqlc and goose against Postgres, River Pro for background jobs, Watermill for pub-sub over RabbitMQ.

  • Frontend: React and TanStack, deployed to Cloudflare Workers.

  • AI and eval: Python, in their own repos — ModelBridge (a gRPC service for AI building blocks) and TaxBench, our internal eval suite.

  • Legacy integration: a C# Windows agent that drives Drake, one of the tax platforms our industry never built APIs for.

  • Infrastructure: AWS — ECS Fargate, Amazon MQ, AMP, Loki, Tempo — provisioned by Pulumi, itself written in Go.

  • Around the edges: Buildkite for CI, OpenTelemetry throughout, Doppler for secrets, Linear for tracking.

What you'll do

  • Ship features end to end — Postgres schema, Go service, protobuf contract, React screen, and the alert that pages you when it breaks.

  • Move where the quarter needs you. Client portal in the fall, preparer workspace before January, platform work when filing season quiets down. This role is for someone who finds that energizing rather than scattered.

  • Take AI from prototype to product. Plenty of things demo well here. Deciding what graduates into a workflow preparers depend on, and hardening it so it can be, is the job.

  • Talk to accountants and clients directly, then go build the thing they actually needed.

  • Leave the codebase better than you found it. We have five languages and six engineers. Some of that is deliberate; some of it isn't, and we want opinions about which is which.

We're fully distributed — but if you want an office, we'll help you find one through our investor network.

What makes you a fit

  • 5+ years shipping full-stack web applications, with production experience in both Go and React

  • Have owned features end to end on a small team, where there was nobody to hand the other half to

  • Comfortable choosing where the complexity should live — in the schema, the service, or the UI — and defending the call

  • Know how to prototype fast and then decide, honestly, what it takes to make it real

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-changing, early-stage environment

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Nice to haves

  • Were the first or second engineer on a product that made it to real users

  • Connect RPC, gRPC, or protobuf-first API design, and generated typed clients

  • TanStack in production, or edge deployment on Cloudflare Workers

  • Shipped LLM systems into production paths and evaluated them properly, not as prototypes

  • Built tax-adjacent software — fund administration, payroll, accounting platforms, filing systems

  • Started a company yourself, however small

What we offer

  • Benefits and meaningful equity

  • A fully remote team, plus twice-yearly company offsites

  • A well-funded, fast-moving environment with minimal layers of management

  • A world-class client base that values your time and pays for the premium experience

  • The chance to build production-grade software your teammates use and love every day

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box.

MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB

The Partner Engagement Management Team is responsible for measuring, monitoring, and optimizing performance of suppliers within a particular set of languages. Performance includes, but is not limited to, on-time delivery, adherence to all client and project specific requirements, and defect-free deliverables. This Team is responsible for understanding customer capacity requirements as communicated by the Program Squads and liaising with Talent Procurement to ensure such capacity requirements can be met.
