jobs.title: Coordinateur Gouvernance des Données (Employed or freelance)
jobs.excerpt: ObjectifVous rejoignez une ou plusieurs équipes Data en charge des développements liés à la digitalisation, ainsi que de la maintenance des solutions existantes.
jobs.description:
Objectif

Vous rejoignez une ou plusieurs équipes Data en charge des développements liés à la digitalisation, ainsi que de la maintenance des solutions existantes.

Responsabilités

3.1 Faire fonctionner la gouvernance au quotidien

Le Coordinateur Data pilote le flux opérationnel des activités de gouvernance et veille à ce que les demandes, problèmes, décisions et actions soient identifiés, attribués, suivis et clôturés.

  • Identifier et qualifier les sujets à traiter.
  • Attribuer les sujets aux responsables concernés et suivre leur avancement.
  • Organiser les escalades et préparer les arbitrages lorsque le niveau opérationnel ne suffit pas.
  • Assurer la traçabilité des décisions et vérifier leur mise en œuvre.

3.2 Coacher et faire monter en compétence les Référents Data

Cette mission constitue une composante importante du rôle. Les Référents Data présentent des niveaux de maturité, de connaissance et d'expérience variés, ce qui implique un accompagnement adapté à leurs besoins.

  • Expliquer les concepts et pratiques de gouvernance dans un langage accessible.
  • Créer et faire produire des supports de formation sur les méthodes et pratiques de gouvernance data.
  • Montrer de manière concrète l'utilisation des méthodes et des outils sur des cas réels.
  • Revoir et challenger les analyses ou propositions formulées par les Référents Data.
  • Apporter une méthode de travail lorsqu'un problème n'est pas encore structuré.
  • Transférer progressivement les compétences afin de rendre les Référents Data autonomes.

3.3 Accompagner la définition et la gestion des termes métier

Le Coordinateur Data maîtrise les pratiques de gestion d'un glossaire métier et accompagne les Référents Data dans la définition, la validation et le cycle de vie des termes métier.

  • Aider à distinguer une définition métier d'une description technique.
  • Challenger les définitions vagues, ambiguës, circulaires ou trop locales.
  • Identifier les parties prenantes nécessaires à la définition et faciliter la recherche d'un consensus.
  • Repérer les synonymes, les concepts associés et les conflits de définition.
  • Organiser l'escalade en cas de désaccord persistant.
  • Assurer la publication et la gestion du cycle de vie des termes dans le catalogue de données.

3.4 Accompagner la gestion de la qualité des données

Le Coordinateur Data dispose d'une expérience pratique en Data Quality et accompagne les Référents Data sur l'ensemble du cycle de traitement d'un problème de qualité.

  • Aider à formuler et objectiver correctement un problème de qualité.
  • Analyser les données afin d'identifier les symptômes, les causes possibles et les populations impactées.
  • Évaluer les impacts métier et distinguer correction ponctuelle, mitigation et résolution durable.
  • Formuler ou challenger les actions correctives et préventives.
  • Définir avec les parties concernées des règles, contrôles, seuils et indicateurs de qualité.
  • Suivre la remédiation et vérifier l'efficacité des actions mises en œuvre.
  • Déterminer quand un problème doit être escaladé au Data Owner.

3.5 Administrer et faire évoluer les outils de gouvernance

Le Coordinateur Data agit comme référent fonctionnel des outils de gouvernance. Il ou elle est en mesure de les configurer, d'en assurer l'administration fonctionnelle et de les faire évoluer selon les besoins.

  • Administrer fonctionnellement le catalogue de données et faire évoluer les modèles de métadonnées.
  • Configurer les objets, rôles, workflows, règles de publication et de validation nécessaires.
  • Structurer et maintenir le glossaire métier ainsi que la gouvernance des produits Data.
  • Administrer fonctionnellement l'outil de Data Quality lorsqu'il sera déployé.
  • Configurer, ou faire configurer, les règles de qualité, contrôles, seuils, indicateurs et workflows de traitement.
  • Améliorer en continu l'expérience d'utilisation des outils de gouvernance, notamment dans des environnements tels que ZEENEA, F64 Fabric, Talend et Confluence lorsque ces solutions font partie du périmètre.

3.6 Maintenir et améliorer les processus de gouvernance

Le Coordinateur Data transforme les principes de gouvernance en processus simples, opérationnels et applicables au quotidien.

  • Documenter, mettre en œuvre et faire évoluer les processus de catalogage, de gestion des termes métier, de qualité, de traitement des problèmes Data, de certification éventuelle et de gouvernance des produits Data.
  • Veiller à la cohérence entre les processus et leur implémentation dans les outils.
  • Intégrer les retours d'expérience et simplifier les pratiques lorsqu'elles deviennent trop lourdes.
  • Contribuer à la modélisation des processus en BPMN lorsque cela est nécessaire.

3.7 Coordonner les sujets transversaux

Lorsqu'une problématique concerne plusieurs Référents, directions ou ensembles de données, le Coordinateur structure le traitement collectif du sujet.

  • Identifier les acteurs concernés et clarifier le périmètre du problème.
  • Organiser et faciliter le travail collectif.
  • Documenter les décisions et les points nécessitant arbitrage.
  • Assurer le suivi des actions jusqu'à leur clôture.

3.8 Préparer et faciliter les organes de gouvernance

Le Coordinateur Data prépare et facilite les travaux des instances de gouvernance Data.

  • Rassembler les faits et éléments nécessaires à la décision.
  • Structurer les sujets et recommandations à soumettre.
  • Faciliter les échanges pendant les séances.
  • Documenter les décisions et suivre leur mise en œuvre.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience confirmée en gouvernance des données, idéalement dans une grande organisation et dans un environnement de secteur public.

  • Maîtrise de l'administration fonctionnelle d'outils Data et de gouvernance.
  • Solide expérience en gestion de glossaires métier, métadonnées et Data Quality.
  • Bonne pratique des méthodes Agile et SCRUM.
  • Capacité à modéliser des processus, notamment en BPMN.
  • Utilisation courante de Confluence et contribution aux activités de testing.
  • Connaissance de BCSS/eHealth.
  • Une expérience avec ZEENEA, F64 Fabric et Talend constitue un atout pertinent.
  • Capacité à accompagner des référents métier, à challenger des analyses et à faire progresser les pratiques de gouvernance.
  • Français requis.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

(Freelance est également possible)

jobs.title: Staff Infrastructure Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Electricity grids are undergoing the most significant transformation in a century.
jobs.description:
Electricity grids are undergoing the most significant transformation in a century. The shift to renewables, the proliferation of rooftop solar, batteries and EVs, and the increasing complexity of distribution networks are forcing utilities to operate their grids in fundamentally new ways. Gridsight's software platform uses data, ML and AI to help grid operators modernise their operations and unlock transformational new capabilities. We deliver visibility into the grid edge, faster renewable connections, and real-time orchestration of distributed energy. The opportunity is enormous ($1B+ ARR).

We're embedded with over 50% of Australia's distribution networks, more than 30% in New Zealand, and have 1 of the top 5 utilities in the US as our lighthouse. Airtree led our Series A, Insight lead our Series B, we grew ARR 3.4x in the past 6 months, and we're on the path to build the first truly generational utility software company.

We hold an exceptionally high talent bar, but if you’re talented, hungry and ambitious, come join us on our mission.

Purpose

Make it faster and safer for every Gridsight product team to ship, by solving shared infrastructure, reliability and developer experience problems once instead of in every team.

Gridsight builds grid analytics software for electricity utilities in Australia, New Zealand and the US. Our customers run critical infrastructure, so the platform under our product has to be secure, observable and dependable. This role builds that platform.

Where the role sits

You'll be the first staff engineer (and first IC) on Gridsight's new Infrastructure Platform team. You'll collaborate with a Head of Platform (open role) to help set the team's technical direction, with support from engineering leadership. To start with you'll be a band of one: owning problems end to end across teams and functions, while we build the team out around you.

  • The Infrastructure Platform team is a true platform team in Team Topologies terms: it builds and runs internal products that other teams self-serve. Your customers are our product teams (Grid Visibility, Flex, Connections, Grid Modelling Tooling) and our pillar teams (Data Platform and Grid Modelling Engine).
  • It sits alongside our Experience Platform and Agentic Platform teams. Together these three own the shared foundations that product teams build on.
  • Infrastructure Platform builds the substrate and building blocks for self serve: cloud infrastructure, compute, IAM, CI/CD, environments and observability.
  • IT Ops owns our corporate IT and its compliance controls. You'll partner with them on SOC 2 and customer security reviews: they cover corporate controls, you cover production infrastructure, and together you make compliance evidence come straight from the platform.
  • You'll join the on-call rotation and help shape how we run incidents as our incident management practice matures.

Key accountabilities

  • Observability. Build and run our metrics, tracing, logging and alerting platform, and set the patterns that let each team own its own observability over time.
  • Delivery and environments. Evolve and consolidate our deployment pipelines, release management and infrastructure-as-code. Own environment management and test infrastructure, with the goal of shorter lead times and faster CI feedback.
  • Secure, multi-region infrastructure. Design infrastructure that is secure by default, cost-effective and ready for multi-tenant, multi-region delivery across Australia, New Zealand and the US. Work with IT Ops to build SOC 2 controls and evidence into the platform, so teams meet compliance by default rather than by manual effort.
  • Reliability practice. Help define SLOs and error budgets, improve how we respond to and learn from incidents, and take a turn on call.
  • Developer experience. Treat internal engineers as customers. Seek out their friction, measure their satisfaction, and build tools and abstractions they choose to adopt.
  • AI-assisted delivery. Leverage AI-assisted development tooling to accelerate delivery and raise the bar on what a small team can ship.
  • Raising the bar. Mentor engineers across teams and shift how the organisation thinks about reliability, operability and developer experience. Run the platform as a product, with clear interfaces, docs and support, so teams self-serve rather than queue for help.

What makes this a Staff role

This is not a senior engineer with a bigger backlog. At Staff level we expect you to (in collaboration with engineering leadership):

  • Help set technical direction for platform work across every team, and own a platform roadmap that runs over multiple quarters.
  • Shape decisions you don't own, by writing clear proposals and bringing other teams with you.
  • Find the highest-leverage problems yourself, rather than waiting for them to be handed to you.
  • Define the systems and practices others work within, not just work within them well.
  • Help shape the Infrastructure Platform team from day one, including its early roadmap and how it engages with product teams.

How we'll know it's working

  • Lead time, deployment frequency, change failure rate and time to restore are measured and improving.
  • CI feedback is fast and reliable enough that engineers stop working around it.
  • Product teams own their own dashboards and alerts, and on-call engineers find problems before customers do.
  • Developer satisfaction with the platform is measured regularly and trending up.
  • SOC 2 evidence comes straight from the platform, with no manual collection before an audit.
  • Our infrastructure-as-code matches what's actually running, and the legacy estate is retired.
  • Out-of-hours pages are measured per system and falling.

What you'll bring

  • ~8 or more years in software engineering, with recent work at Staff level (or clearly operating at it) in platform, infrastructure or SRE.
  • Deep experience running cloud infrastructure in production, including compute, networking, storage, IAM and cost management, with strong infrastructure-as-code skills (AWS and Terraform preferred).
  • A track record of building and operating observability platforms that teams actually rely on.
  • Hands-on SRE practice: SLOs, error budgets, incident response and runbooks.
  • Experience on a platform team in a product engineering organisation, running the platform as a product that teams adopt willingly.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals and a habit of setting direction and driving outcomes without close supervision.
  • Fluency in the use of AI-assisted development tools - you're already using agentic coding tools, LLM-assisted workflows, or similar to accelerate your work.

Nice to have

  • Scaling observability at high data volumes.
  • Building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling with a strong developer experience focus.
  • Familiarity working with data intensive systems and environments
  • Authentication and identity in multi-tenant SaaS (Auth0, Azure AD, SAML/SSO, OIDC).
  • Security and compliance work such as SOC 2, or in highly regulated environments.
  • Resilience practices such as chaos engineering or game days.
  • Energy, utilities or other critical infrastructure domains.
  • Open-source contributions, conference talks or technical writing.

Technical knowledge

  • Cloud architecture on AWS: networking, compute, storage, security and cost optimisation.
  • Infrastructure-as-code design and lifecycle, ideally Terraform.
  • Containers and orchestration (we use ECS), and the deployment patterns around them.
  • CI/CD pipeline design and release strategies such as blue-green, canary and progressive delivery.
  • Observability systems: metrics, distributed tracing, log aggregation and alerting.
  • Security fundamentals: IAM, network segmentation and secrets management.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS infrastructure patterns.

Learn more

  • Brendan Banfield (CEO at Gridsight) in conversation with James Cameron (Partner at Airtree)
  • Gridsight's work with Endeavour Energy to deliver flexible exports
  • The problem space we're tackling

You’ll keep work flowing through the pathway: supporting families to complete their onboarding questionnaires and paperwork, answering their questions, coordinating their appointments, and linking them with their dedicated Care Navigator clinician.

Your primary responsibility will be to make sure every family has a positive, predictable and respectful experience of the clinical pathway – from their first contact with us through to their final ‘Moving Forward’ conversation – and of how the pathway connects with our Integrated Therapeutic Service (ITS) and our neurodevelopmental (ND) teams. The Needs-Led Pathway supports children and young people from early years up to 18, based on what they need rather than whether they have, or are waiting for, a diagnosis.

Working in a neuro-affirmative way

Many of the children, young people and parents you’ll speak to are neurodivergent. We work in a neuro-affirmative way: we see autism, ADHD and other neurodevelopmental differences as part of who someone is rather than problems to be fixed, and we adapt how we work instead of expecting families to adapt to us. You don’t need to be an expert on day one – we’ll train and support you – but you’ll need to share these values. In this role, they show up in small, practical ways every day:

  • Telling families clearly what will happen next, when, and how long it will take – for many people, predictability is an access need rather than a preference
  • Writing in plain, direct language, and following up phone or video conversations in writing so families have something to refer back to
  • Asking families how they would like to be contacted, and respecting it – unexpected phone calls can be hard for some people
  • Using the language families use about themselves and their children (for example “autistic” or “has autism”) and not correcting them
  • Remembering that a parent or carer may be neurodivergent too, and that forms, deadlines and phone calls are harder for some families than others
  • Not reading a missed deadline, a short reply or a difficult call as a lack of interest – and understanding distressed behaviour as communication
  • Noticing and passing on what is going well for a child, not only what is difficult

What you’ll be doing

Coordinating the pathway

  • Managing the flow of work through the pathway and its service lines, so that referrals from Sirona move promptly and no family gets stuck
  • Booking and coordinating appointments, including Care Navigation Meetings, Core Needs Assessments, Single Session Consultations, four-weekly check-ins and Moving Forward appointments
  • Linking families with their dedicated Care Navigator clinician, and passing on what families have already told us so they don’t have to repeat their story
  • Sending questionnaires and reminders at the right points in the journey, including the onboarding questionnaires and the closing questionnaire ahead of a family’s Moving Forward appointment
  • Supporting families who want to come back to the service after their episode of care, using the agreed re-entry route

Supporting families

  • Supporting families and young people to complete onboarding questionnaires and paperwork, including talking it through by phone or video where a form doesn’t work for them
  • Arranging alternative formats, interpreters and reasonable adjustments, and recording them so every member of the team knows
  • Helping families get set up on, and find their way around, our Healios Connect resource library, including logins and digital access
  • Responding to questions from families and young people by email, telephone and message – clearly, warmly and promptly
  • Recognising when something a family says may signal a safety or safeguarding concern, and passing it to the duty or Care Navigator clinician straight away, following Healios safeguarding procedures. You won’t make clinical decisions, but you will know how and when to escalate

Records, information and quality

  • Keeping accurate, timely records in our clinical record system, and checking the record before asking a family for information we already hold
  • Liaising with Sirona, schools and other professionals to gather referral and background information, within data-sharing agreements and information governance rules
  • Supporting monthly operational reporting, such as appointment capacity, questionnaire completion and family feedback
  • General administration and coordination duties that support the Sirona pathway, clinical and operations teams
  • Sharing what you hear from families, so we can keep improving the pathway

What you need to have

If you feel you could be a good fit for the role but do not meet all of the criteria, please do make an application and we will be happy to consider your application.

  • Administrative and organisational experience, ideally in a healthcare, education or customer-facing setting
  • Good time management, and the ability to switch between tasks without losing track of the detail
  • Experience of resolving queries and concerns, and troubleshooting problems
  • Experience using MS Word, Excel, Outlook and/or Google Docs, Sheets, Calendar, and confidence learning new systems
  • Clear, warm and professional communication, particularly by email and telephone, and the flexibility to adapt how you communicate to the person in front of you
  • An understanding of, or genuine interest in, neurodiversity and neuro-affirmative practice, and a willingness to keep learning
  • Keeping families and young people at the heart of everything you do
  • Good judgement about when to ask for help, and the confidence to escalate concerns promptly
  • An understanding of confidentiality and data protection when handling sensitive personal information
  • A professional home working environment with a minimum WIFI connection of 2 Mbps up and download speed
  • Flexibility to support our mission of bringing healthcare to anyone, anytime, anywhere
  • A commitment to ethical practice and adherence to the highest standards of safeguarding of adults and children

It would be great if you also have

  • Experience in NHS, children’s, SEND or neurodevelopmental services
  • Experience using a clinical record or case management system
  • Knowledge of services and support available to families across BNSSG
  • Experience supporting families of younger children, including under-5s
  • Autism, ADHD or neuro-affirmative training
  • Lived experience of neurodivergence, yourself or in your family – we welcome and value this

What’s in it for you

  • 33 days holiday (including Bank Holidays)
  • Paid Christmas closure (between Christmas and New Year)
  • Birthday Leave - paid day off on your birthday
  • Life Leave" - 2 days of extra leave to take when things you can't plan for happen
  • Enhanced family friendly policies including a phased return to work and receive full pay
  • Paid company sick pay scheme
  • Contributory Pension Scheme (6% matched)
  • Employee Discount to access a private assessment (for ADHD, Autism or a combined assessment) through our Melios service for your child
  • Fully personalised flexible benefits package including; Health Cash Plan, Life Assurance, EAP Service, Will Writing, Critical Illness Cover, employee discount and savings portal, Cycle to Work Scheme, Tech Scheme and Wine Club!
  • Work from anywhere policy
  • Access to NHS and Perks at Work discounts, including the Blue Light Card
  • Free access to co-working spaces
  • CPD/Growth day per year, plus personal development allowance to invest in your growth Bespoke Healios Training and on demand learning including schedule of monthly CPD for clinicians
  • Bespoke Healios Training and on demand learning including schedule of monthly CPD for clinicians

ACCOMMODATIONSWe’re glad to accommodate candidates who need adjustments throughout the hiring process and we're always learning about different accessibility needs to ensure our hiring process is accessible for all candidates. We encourage you to be open about the adjustments you need so we can adapt our interview process. You can read more about Healios being an Inclusive Employer on our Notion page

We are a Disability Confident Employer and operate a Guaranteed Interview Scheme (GIS). This means we are committed to interviewing all disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. If you wish to be considered under this scheme, please indicate this when asked about disability on the application form.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

“Do the right thing” is one of our core Healios values. And building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels supported is absolutely the right thing to do. Whether we’re developing a new service line or enhancing one of our products, we need people with different skills, backgrounds, identities and perspectives to ensure our innovations will work for the children and young people we are here to serve. By embracing diversity, we can deliver better care experiences and outcomes, while tackling the inequalities in healthcare provision that exist today.

SAFER RECRUITMENT & PRE- EMPLOYMENT CHECKS

Healios ensures that supporting people to be safe is at the heart of our work and a key priority across all areas of the organisation, We will do our absolute best to keep the people that we support, safe from harm. This starts with our recruitment processes.

As part of our pre-employment checks, all employees of Healios will be asked to have a Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check. Dependent on your role within the business, this will either be an Enhanced or Basic. A Protecting Vulnerable Groups (PVG) check will be required. You will also be asked to provide two professional references as a minimum.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Account Manager (Strategic Alliances)
jobs.excerpt: At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

As a Senior Technical Account Manager (Senior TAM, L6) at Affirm, you will own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, delivering against SLAs, fielding technical inquiries, and performing investigations and analysis, while also driving technical initiatives that translate merchant business objectives into technical strategies and product optimizations. Senior TAMs are part of the Engineering team and collaborate closely with Affirm's Product, Engineering, Operations, Customer Success, and Frontline Technical Support teams.

This is an operations-heavy role to start. Expect the majority of your early focus to be on keeping merchant integrations healthy—monitoring, triage, troubleshooting, and SLA delivery—while you progressively take on more custom solutioning and cross-functional initiatives. Over your first 6–12 months, as you build operational mastery, you will grow into owning your own book of accounts and carrying it through to end-to-end account ownership.

A Senior TAM independently owns operational health across the strategic alliance portfolio, designs custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations, drives cross-team collaboration on initiatives, acts as a technical lead on team projects, and mentors less-experienced members of the team.

What You'll Do

  • Own the operational aspect of technical account management across Affirm's strategic alliance portfolio—alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and fielding technical inquiries—so integrations stay healthy and issues are resolved quickly.

  • Deliver against SLAs, proactively surfacing technical risks before they become customer-impacting and responding with urgency to merchant issues.

  • Perform in-depth investigations and root-cause analysis across logs, queries, and integration data, owning resolution end to end and escalating to cross-functional partners or executives when needed.

  • Drive technical initiatives and partner with internal and merchant stakeholders on launch initiatives—expansions, promotions, new product adoption, and integration optimizations—that grow the value of the accounts after launch.

  • Design and deliver high-scope, often-custom integration solutions grounded in Affirm's standard integrations—combining, extending, and tailoring them to complex, open-ended problems while balancing speed, quality, maintainability, reliability, and scalability.

  • Act as a technical lead for internal projects, defining and delivering well-scoped milestones and executing the project roadmap.

  • Operationalize best practices by creating and updating playbooks, runbooks, alerting, and UAT certification plans across the strategic alliance portfolio and continuously reduce keep-the-lights-on (KTLO) work.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering leads to identify, plan, and prioritize projects based on team goals and resources, acting as the voice of the merchant to influence the roadmap.

  • Mentor and level up less-experienced TAMs, share learnings from your integrations and investigations, and contribute to interviewing and team development.

  • Over your first 6–12 months, grow into owning a dedicated book of strategic alliance accounts—carrying operational ownership through to end-to-end account ownership.

What We Look For

  • Professional Background: at least six years in a technical, external-facing role such as Technical Account Management, Solutions/Partner Engineering, or Solutions Architecture—ideally within FinTech, payments, or SaaS—with a demonstrated track record of owning the operational health of technical accounts and delivering against SLAs.

  • Operational Ownership: proven ability to run alerting, monitoring, troubleshooting, and technical inquiries across a set of accounts, balancing reactive operational work with proactive initiatives.

  • Ownership & Autonomy: proven ability to independently scope and deliver complex, open-ended technical work, and to partner with stakeholders on launch initiatives, with strong project management and follow-through.

  • API Expertise: deep understanding of RESTful APIs, webhooks, and the HTTP protocol, with hands-on experience using tools like Postman to debug and validate integrations.

  • Architecture Fluency: Experience in API integrations and the ability to design custom solutions on top of them to solve complex merchant challenges.

  • Coding & Code Fluency: ability to read and understand production-level code (HTML, JavaScript, SQL, and ideally one server-side language such as Python) and to author new, novel queries to diagnose merchant or system issues.

  • Troubleshooting Acumen: ability to diagnose issues using browser developer consoles, log analysis and observability platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Chronosphere), and ticketing systems (e.g., Jira, Notion).

  • Technical Communication: excellent verbal and written communication; able to tailor explanations to both non-technical leaders and technical teams, read a room and adjust in real time, and synthesize technical challenges back to internal teams.

  • Relationship Management: ability to discover and develop relationships with technical decision-makers, secure written consensus on integration milestones, and drive cross-team collaboration.

  • Leadership & Mentorship: demonstrated ability to mentor teammates, set best practices, and lead technical initiatives; a growth mindset with self-awareness and a habit of seeking and acting on feedback.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with the payments ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with web/mobile application architecture.

  • Experience implementing or customizing e-commerce platforms, payment gateways, or in-store point-of-sale systems.

  • Experience acting as a technical lead on cross-functional projects and influencing product roadmaps.

Pay Grade - L

Equity Grade - 4

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $133,000 - $183,000

Location - Remote CanadaThis remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.description:
Role : Telecaller

Location: Work from home

Department: Eaze

Employment Type: Contractual

About Lokal

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online. This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

    • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
    • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
    • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
    • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
    • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
    • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
    • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
    • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

About the Role

You live and breathe frontier AI. You’re testing new releases, pushing agents beyond their obvious uses, and discovering possibilities you can’t wait to show other people. This is how you spend your time because you love it. You’ve already brought others along through a community, channel, blog, or the conversations where people turn to you for ideas and advice.

Sia Experience’s Marketing Advisory is providing consulting to one of the world’s leading technology companies on go-to-market strategy to grow adoption of its next-generation consumer AI agent, and we’re looking for an AI Product Evangelist to help drive that growth. In this role, you’ll immerse yourself in the product, uncover unexpected applications, and show people how to get more from its capabilities. You’ll connect with other enthusiastic users, build on their discoveries, and turn individual experiments into ideas and resources that inspire broader adoption.

You’ll bring firsthand knowledge of what users are building, what they’re discussing, and where the product could go next. Your insights should introduce the team to possibilities they haven’t explored and help translate emerging user behavior into meaningful product opportunities.

Your background might be in product, engineering, creative technology, education, content, community, or another discipline. What matters most is your demonstrated ability to explore AI deeply, share what you discover, and get others involved.

What You’ll Do

Bring the exploration, discoveries, and connections you’re already making into a direct partnership with the team building the product. You may already be a power user of this product, or bring deep experience with another frontier AI agent and the curiosity to quickly become one. This role gives you the opportunity to expand that work, involve the internal team, and help more people discover what’s possible.

Discover and Demonstrate What’s Possible

  • Build on your existing product knowledge and experiments, exploring new features, integrations, and agent capabilities as they emerge.
  • Expand the practical, creative, and unexpected use cases you’re already discovering, bringing the team into what you’re testing and learning.
  • Push beyond established examples to uncover new workflows and applications, collaborating with Product and Engineering to explore their potential.
  • Turn the discoveries you already share into compelling demos, tutorials, posts, and reusable resources that reach more people.

  • Bring inventive users and compelling projects to the team’s attention, connecting people who could learn from or collaborate with one another.
  • Build on the ways you already get others involved through shared experiments, demonstrations, challenges, and collaborative activities.
  • Several years of being the product geek who tests every release, finds the unexpected use case, and gets everyone else saying, “Wait, how did you do that?” Your experience with frontier AI may be more recent, but your instinct to explore runs deep.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience with AI agents or advanced AI platforms, including building tools, executing complex workflows, or automating tasks beyond conversational prompting.
  • A portfolio of projects, demos, tutorials, workflows, or public contributions that demonstrates product fluency and inventive applications.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage enthusiast communities authentically and collaborate effectively with Product, Engineering, and Marketing.

  • Own and develop a Central enterprise account territory, build a robust, self-sourced pipeline through strategic outbound prospecting, executive referrals, industry events, and leveraging our channel partner ecosystem.

  • Demonstrated success in building a new business motion and selling into enterprise accounts with deal sizes of $100k+ ARR, including experience navigating procurement, legal, and IT approval processes.

  • Results-oriented, self-starter mentality, holding yourself accountable to a number and doing what it takes to hit it.
  • Experience at a startup or in a fast-moving, high-growth environment — comfortable building process alongside executing.
  • Working proficiency with Salesforce, Gong, ZoomInfo, Clay, and Dialpad.

  • Experience in physical security, IoT, SaaS infrastructure, or adjacent enterprise technology markets preferred.

Location

This is a remote position open to candidates based in the U.S.
Candidates located in the Central part of the U.S. are preferred.

Travel

Candidates must be available for up to 50% travel to partner and customer sites across North America / Central as required.

Compensation

Estimated OTE (base salary + commission): $180,000-230,000
Additional forms of compensation, depending on the role, include uncapped commission, sales incentives, discretionary bonuses, and equity in the company. Individual pay is determined based on the candidate's primary work/hiring location and additional factors, such as skills and experience, and relevant education, certifications, or training. Customers Come First: We're obsessed with improving our users' lives and constantly question how we can improve upon what already exists.
One Team: Innovating in the physical security industry can't be accomplished by just a single person, which is why we collaborate with exceptional individuals who inspire us to be our best.

jobs.description:
Zimperium® is the world leader in mobile security, purpose-built to protect the modern mobile enterprise. Trusted by leading organizations and governments, our AI-driven platform delivers real-time, on-device protection for mobile applications and devices. We help organizations stay ahead with proactive defense against evolving threats—including mobile-targeted phishing (mishing), malware, app vulnerabilities, and zero-day exploits. Our mission is to empower organizations to operate securely and confidently in today’s dynamic digital environment.

We are seeking a highly skilled and inquisitive security engineer with deep technical expertise in mobile threat detection and operating system internals. This role focuses on conducting forensics analysis of potentially compromised devices to research, develop, and improve our detection capabilities against advanced mobile threats. Experience in analyzing data from iOS backups and diagnose is at the core of the role. The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with an open and adaptive research mindset, maintaining versatility across diverse security challenges. A strong ability to code for the iOS environment, alongside conducting and reviewing high-quality technical work, is essential for success in this position.

Location: Europe

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, prototype, and implement new detection techniques and algorithms for the iOS platform based on forensics data coming both from the runtime environment and the offline iOS sysdiagnose and backup files.
  • Lead and participate in structured brainstorming sessions to generate novel detection ideas against advanced mobile threats.
  • Analyze, document and make use of iOS internals features in an attempt to improve the runtime and offline detection capabilities.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve internal tooling and automation to accelerate analysis, triage, and detection development.
  • Review and interpret forensic data provided by customers, produce clear technical reports, and provide actionable guidance and remediation support.
  • Write and publish technical blog posts to raise awareness of emerging security risks and share insights with customers and the wider security community.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment, including forming and leading focused sub-groups to deliver specific project features or research objectives.
  • Strong knowledge of iOS operating system internals (e.g., diagnose, encrypted backup, daemons/services, sandboxing, code-signing), with a particular focus on the capability to use the data provided by the operating system to detect a compromised device.
  • Good previous experience in data analysis methods applied to forensics investigations.
  • Proficiency in reverse engineering using tools such as IDA Pro, Ghidra, Hopper, or equivalent, including experience writing scripts, leveraging their SDKs, and isolating and reporting technical issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to think both offensively and defensively, approaching analysis tasks with the mindset of both an attacker and a defender.
  • Solid programming experience in C, Python, Objective-C and Swift, with the ability to produce efficient, maintainable, and secure code.
  • Capability to reverse engineer proprietary protocols and interprocess communication mechanisms (e.g., XPC, mach messages, IOKit) is considered a plus.
  • Practical knowledge of jailbreak methods and iOS exploit classes (e.g., kernel exploits, sandbox escapes, code-signing bypasses), ideally experience in analyzing such exploits or exploit chains is a big plus.

jobs.excerpt: Notre mission est d’offrir une expérience de financement hypothécaire positive, et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.
jobs.description:
Notre mission est d’offrir une expérience de financement hypothécaire positive, et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin. Notre équipe se compose d'experts en technologie qualifiés, de spécialistes en prêts hypothécaires attentionnés et d'une équipe de marketing diversifiée, travaillant tous ensemble pour mener le changement dans l'industrie hypothécaire.

Chez nesto, nous sommes fiers de

  • Nos clients apprécient notre expérience positive, transparente et simplifiée en matière de financement hypothécaire.
  • Nos avis 4,5 étoiles sur Google parlent d'eux-mêmes !
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023 et 2024, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.
  • Nous sommes une organisation certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement à avoir un impact positif sur notre société et notre planète.
  • Notre équipe hautement qualifiée, diversifiée et collaborative, qui rend tout possible.
  • Notre plateforme Mortgage Cloud qui offre aux institutions financières un accès complet à la technologie exclusive de nesto, améliorant ainsi l’expérience du client, du début à la fin.

À propos du rôle

Nous sommes une équipe interdisciplinaire et dynamique qui travaille simultanément sur de multiples projets technologiques. Notre équipe est diversifiée et travaille sur différents produits, et chez nesto, nous reconnaissons qu'ils sont interconnectés.

Nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(euse) en sécurité cloud pour rejoindre notre équipe dynamique. Dans ce rôle, vous jouerez un rôle essentiel dans la conception, l'implémentation et la maintenance de solutions de sécurité cloud pour protéger nos systèmes et applications basés sur le cloud. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de développement et d'opérations pour assurer la sécurité et l'intégrité de notre infrastructure cloud.

Nous valorisons une diversité de perspectives et d'expériences. Nous ne cherchons pas quelqu'un qui coche toutes les cases ; nous recherchons des apprenants passionnés et des personnes qui peuvent nous enrichir par leurs expériences uniques.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Mettre en œuvre et maintenir des contrôles de sécurité robustes pour protéger notre infrastructure et nos applications cloud.
  • Découvrir, corriger et valider les problèmes de sécurité à travers l'infrastructure cloud.
  • Effectuer des revues d'architecture et de conception sous l'angle de la sécurité et fournir des exigences et des recommandations opportunes et exploitables.
  • Collaborer avec la direction de la sécurité, les équipes de conformité et d'ingénierie pour exécuter les stratégies de sécurité.
  • Construire, déployer et gérer des outils de sécurité tels que WAF, IDS/IPS, protection des charges de travail, GCP Security Command Center, Azure Security Center, etc.
  • Proposer et contribuer aux améliorations de sécurité et de conformité pour les pipelines CI/CD et les processus de déploiement de nesto.
  • Automatiser les processus de provisionnement et de déploiement d'infrastructure en utilisant des outils d'Infrastructure as Code (IaC) comme Terraform ou Pulumi.
  • Concevoir et opérer des processus évolutifs pour provisionner l'accès au cloud et maintenir le principe du moindre privilège.
  • Participer et soutenir le processus de détection et de réponse aux incidents en améliorant l'observabilité et les alertes, et en aidant l'équipe de réponse aux incidents.
  • S'auto-organiser et prioriser les activités de manière autonome.
  • Soutenir les audits et les questionnaires de sécurité de première partie.
  • Mener et superviser les évaluations de sécurité et les exercices de modélisation des menaces.
  • Implémenter des contrôles de sécurité au sein de Kubernetes.
  • Construire des outils/intégrations DevSecOps.

Qui nous recherchons

  • 5+ années d'expérience au sein d'une équipe axée sur l'infrastructure et/ou la sécurité.
  • 5+ années d'expérience en développement (idéalement GoLang, TypeScript/JS).
  • Connaissance des vulnérabilités courantes des applications web et du cadre OWASP Top 10.
  • Capacité à analyser et à agir sur les résultats des outils DAST et SAST (ex: Tenable, Snyk).
  • Maîtrise des principes DevSecOps et familiarité avec les pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Argo CD, Azure DevOps) pour effectuer des tests de sécurité automatisés.
  • Expérience dans le déploiement et la personnalisation d'outils de sécurité pour faire face aux menaces et réduire les risques, y compris les scanners de vulnérabilités, les analyseurs statiques, les pare-feu d'applications web (WAF), les systèmes de détection/prévention d'intrusion (IDS/IPS) et la surveillance de la sécurité des terminaux.
  • Une compréhension approfondie de la sécurité cloud et réseau, incluant une connaissance approfondie de Kubernetes.
  • Expérience avec GCP, spécifiquement avec un ou plusieurs des services suivants : Security Command Center, GKE, Cloud IDS, Cloud Armor et Secrets Manager.
  • Expérience avec Azure, spécifiquement avec un ou plusieurs des services suivants : Security Center, Azure PaaS App Services, VMs, Azure SQL, Front Door et Key Vault.
  • Expérience dans l'écriture d'infrastructure-as-code en utilisant des outils tels que Terraform, Pulumi et Helm.
  • Connaissance des cadres et des benchmarks de sécurité courants comme CIS, NIST et MITRE ATT&CK.
  • Une compréhension des principes de gestion des identités et des accès (IAM) et des solutions IAM cloud-natives.
  • Passionné par l'apprentissage continu et le partage des connaissances.
  • Bilingue (anglais et français).

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.
  • Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).
  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.
  • Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

Job Description:

DataRobot delivers AI that maximizes impact and minimizes business risk. Our platform and applications integrate into core business processes so teams can develop, deliver, and govern AI at scale. DataRobot empowers practitioners to deliver predictive and generative AI, and enables leaders to secure their AI assets. Organizations worldwide rely on DataRobot for AI that makes sense for their business — today and in the future.

DataRobot’s Fleet team is the engine behind how our platform runs across all customer environments—multi-tenant SaaS, single-tenant SaaS, VPC, and on-prem deployments. We build and operate the foundational Kubernetes infrastructure that powers everything from CI/CD to service orchestration and deployment at scale.

We support a wide variety of deployment models—from SaaS to on-prem - using a Kubernetes-native approach and modern toolset. Our mission is to unify how we build, deploy, and operate the platform across environments while improving resilience, maintainability, and developer velocity.

The next 1–2 years will be transformative for the Fleet team. We’re laying the groundwork to enable unified deployment experiences, zero-downtime upgrades, and intelligent platform automation—while lowering Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and boosting developer velocity. That’s where you come in.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll be responsible for technical leadership and vision. You’ll lead by example—rolling up your sleeves as a technical contributor to solve complex problems, shaping architecture, and mentoring engineers to do their best work and advance their careers. You’ll work across our control plane systems, influence cross-team roadmaps, and bring pragmatic engineering practices into how we build, test, and operate infrastructure software.

This is not a “stay in your swim lane” role. You’ll question assumptions, challenge complexity, and help drive a high-performance culture. You’ll be trusted to bring clarity where there’s ambiguity, and momentum where there’s inertia.

This role includes participation in an on-call rotation—we believe in shared ownership of our platform and aim to build systems that are resilient, observable, and require minimal intervention.

What You’ll Do:

  • Architect and implement scalable, secure Kubernetes-based infrastructure for multi-cloud and hybrid environments.

  • Lead technical direction for core Fleet initiatives—control plane services, tenancy models, deployment pipelines, observability layers, and more.

  • Mentor engineers across the team, fostering a strong engineering culture of ownership, curiosity, and excellence.

  • Drive modernization efforts—introducing patterns like GitOps, Policy-as-Code (Kyverno), Cilium networking, autoscaling, and better resource efficiency.

  • Collaborate deeply with SRE, Platform, and Application teams to align infrastructure capabilities with real-world product demands.

  • Champion best practices in CI/CD, reliability, container lifecycle management, and dev experience.

  • Be a thought partner to engineering leadership and help shape how Fleet scales its impact across the company.

What We’re Looking For:

  • 7-10+ years of engineering experience, with at least 5+ in infrastructure, platform, or backend systems roles.

  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes internals and operations, including networking, scheduling, scaling, and controller patterns.

  • Proven ability to design and build systems from scratch, making pragmatic tradeoffs along the way.

  • Strong proficiency in modern programming languages such as Python or Go. Experience building production-quality, reliable, and observable systems that are used across engineering organizations.

  • A growth-oriented mindset—driven to teach, learn, and improve systems as well as people.

  • Experience operating across multiple cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure) and/or hybrid environments.

  • Strong experience with Helm, container orchestration patterns, and CI/CD automation.

  • Comfortable working with IaC (Terraform, Pulumi) and GitOps workflows.

  • Ability to influence without authority and align diverse stakeholders around technical decisions.

  • Familiarity with Cilium, Kyverno, KEDA, Gateway API, OPA, or similar technologies.

  • Experience building and running multi-tenant SaaS platforms.

  • Exposure to on-prem delivery models or regulated environments.

  • Experience with performance tuning for large-scale data or compute workloads.

  • Past success driving infrastructure transformation or decomposing legacy systems.

  • Experience working with GPU infrastructure for training and inference.

Why Join the Fleet Management team?:

This is your chance to shape the platform that powers every DataRobot product. You’ll be surrounded by passionate engineers and leaders who care about doing the right thing—for the business, for the customer, and for each other. You’ll grow fast, challenge the status quo, and leave a legacy that enables hundreds of engineers to ship faster, safer, and smarter.

The talent and dedication of our employees are at the core of DataRobot’s journey to be an iconic company. We strive to attract and retain the best talent by providing competitive pay and benefits with our employees’ well-being at the core. Here’s what your benefits package may include depending on your location and local legal requirements: Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance, Flexible Time Off Program, Paid Holidays, Paid Parental Leave, Global Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and more!

Specifically, the Manager will be responsible for:

  • Advance the profile and interests of the profession through regional advocacy and relationship management, including:

  • Assist in the coordination and delivery of regional educational events

  • Assist CAMRT leadership with the management of CAMRT-ATL, including operational planning, budgeting, etc.

Requirements

KNOWLEDGE, EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

  • MRT Certification

  • CAMRT membership and a good understanding of the MRT profession and the issues faced by professionals within Atlantic Canada

  • Ability to prioritize, multi-task and manage projects

  • A high degree of computer literacy in the use of various computer applications, including relational databases, word processing, spreadsheets and web content management and social media platforms such as Facebook and Instagram, Zoom and Teams

Job Description: Sales Manager – Plant Protein (Remote)

Position: Sales Manager – Plant Protein

Location: Remote (North America)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Department: Commercial / Business Development

Reports To: Global Business Head, Functional Ingredients

Role Summary

We are seeking an experienced, commercially driven Sales Manager – Plant Protein to expand our footprint and accelerate ingredient sales across North America. In this remote position, you will lead B2B business development, technical sales, and account management for our portfolio of plant protein isolates, concentrates, and functional fractions (e.g., pea, soy, fava, lentils or specialty proteins).

You will bridge commercial execution with technical solution selling, engaging directly with R&D teams, food scientists, procurement executives, and contract manufacturers. The ideal candidate brings deep familiarity with plant protein functionality i.e solubility, flavor neutrality, mouthfeel, and texture optimization and a proven ability to move accounts from bench-scale sampling to recurring full-truckload commercial supply agreements.

Key Responsibilities

Commercial Growth & Volume Scaling

  • Lead regional revenue growth and tonnage targets for plant-protein isolates, concentrates, and custom blends.

  • Identify, qualify, and secure high-value B2B accounts across key end-use categories (e.g., meat and dairy alternatives, ready-to-mix powders, protein bars, functional beverages, and sports nutrition).

  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial contact, technical discovery, and R&D sample evaluations through factory trial runs and multi-year supply contracts.

Technical & Solution Selling

  • Work alongside client product development, R&D, and food science teams to match protein specifications (solubility, viscosity, gelation, water/oil binding, and emulsification) to target formulations.

  • Address organoleptic and formulation challenges (masking off-notes, improving mouthfeel, optimizing PDCAAS scores) with tailored ingredient recommendations.

  • Facilitate bench-scale trial samples, pilot plant scale-ups, and commercial production runs in close coordination with technical service labs.

Key Account & Commercial Contract Management

  • Build and nurture strategic, multi-touchpoint relationships across Procurement, QA, R&D, and Supply Chain within brand owners and co-manufacturers.

  • Lead complex commercial negotiations, including annual volume commitments, tiered volume pricing, FTL/container logistics, and long-term price risk management.

  • Partner with quality and regulatory teams to deliver essential compliance documentation (COAs, allergen controls, Non-GMO, Organic, Kosher/Halal, FSSC 22000, and Prop 65 compliance).

Market & Pipeline Intelligence

  • Track supply-demand dynamics, report market price movement and competitors’ activities on regular basis.

  • Maintain pipeline integrity, volume forecasts, and client interaction records within the corporate CRM i.e. Salesforce.

  • Represent the brand at major ingredient trade shows and industry expos (e.g., SupplySide Gobal, Natural Products Expo West, IFT FIRST, Plant Based World Expo).

Qualifications & Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of B2B technical sales experience in food ingredients, with a minimum of 3 years strictly focused on plant-based proteins (pea, fava, rice, etc.).

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Human Nutrition, Chemical Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.

  • Functional Expertise: Strong technical understanding of plant protein extraction, functionality (solubility, mouthfeel, texture, extrusion), and formulation in clean-label applications.

  • Commercial Track Record: Demonstrated success securing and growing high-volume commercial supply agreements (FTL and multi-container contracts) with CPG brands and contract manufacturers.

  • Regulatory & Quality Knowledge: Familiarity with FDA/Health Canada food safety standards, GFSI certifications, GRAS, and allergen management.

  • Remote Capability: Self-directed and highly organized, with the discipline to manage a home office and drive commercial execution independently.

  • Travel: Willingness to travel 30–40% across North America for client visits, plant trials, and industry events.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Sales Volume / Revenue, Gross Profit: Annual regional volume (metric tons) and revenue growth across plant protein product lines.

  • Conversion Rate: Speed and success rate of converting technical R&D sampling into commercial FTL production orders.

  • Account Retention & Margin: Gross margin performance and contract retention rate across key commercial accounts.

  • Pipeline Velocity: Quality and movement of target accounts through the commercial sales funnel

What We Offer

  • Compensation: Competitive base salary accompanied by sales incentive/bonus structure tied to volume and revenue goals.

  • Work Setup: 100% remote flexibility with home office stipend.

  • Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance coverage, 401(k)/retirement match, and generous PTO.

  • Growth: High-visibility role in an expanding, high-growth sector of the food ingredient industry.

Product Line Manager - Fiber Optics

Infinite Electronics powers a global portfolio of specialized connectivity companies delivering reliable engineered solutions worldwide. Built as a unified platform for speed, scale, and reliability, the company combines shared infrastructure, best-in-class logistics, and deep engineering expertise to support mission-critical connectivity needs. Through scalable global operations and rapid development capabilities, Infinite helps customers accelerate innovation and bring new ideas to market. Our companies offer strong value-added solutions across several areas, including power distribution, surge protection, EMP, RF, cables, fiber optic solutions, connectors, sensors, and antennas. This broad product portfolio is supported by robust engineering capabilities and vertically integrated global manufacturing operations. Infinite Electronics is the first choice for customers across various markets, including telecommunications, industrial, military, energy, medical, transportation, and data centers.

Integra Optics, part of Infinite Electronics’ Advanced Connectivity Solutions business unit, is recognized as the leader in optical transceivers, fiber cable assemblies, and connectivity solutions for telecom, data centers, and other high-speed networks. As one of the first to pioneer third-party coded transceivers, Integra enables customers to code optics across multiple OEM platforms, helping data center operators, internet providers, and carriers expand and maintain reliable fiber infrastructure where network uptime is paramount. The business’ key differentiators are technical expertise, product breadth, and speed to market.

Position Description:

The Product Line Manager serves as the business owner for the Integra Optics product portfolio and is responsible for defining product strategy, developing and managing the roadmap, leading supplier engagement, and driving portfolio growth. This role requires strong technical knowledge of fiber optics and transceiver technologies, sound commercial judgment, a deep understanding of market trends, and the ability to partner effectively across sales, engineering, marketing, operations, and supply chain. The successful candidate will translate customer needs and market insights into product decisions that support revenue growth, margin improvement, and market share gains, and drive innovation. They will represent Integra Optics with customers, suppliers, and internal leadership, and will play a central role in shaping product direction, prioritizing investments, and delivering customer value through disciplined execution.

General Duties and Responsibilities:

Product Strategy and Roadmap

  • Own the product strategy for the Integra Optics portfolio, with primary emphasis on data center, medical, enterprise, government, and telecommunications.
  • Build deep understanding of customer needs, current and future, to ensure product portfolio supports focus on customer partnership to drive success.
  • Identify market gaps, customer needs, competitive opportunities, and develop business cases supported by market analysis, pricing strategy, and revenue projections.
  • Define and maintain a near-term product roadmap that prioritizes high-impact opportunities across transceivers, fiber-optic cabling, and related connectivity solutions. Build a long-term roadmap focused on innovation, value, and driving patents.
  • Drive quick-turn product initiatives with suppliers and internal partners to reduce time to market. Identify, qualify, and develop supplier relationships that support portfolio growth and supply continuity.
  • Develop product requirements and supporting documentation that clearly articulate value, technical needs, and ROI.
  • Lead the end-to-end NPI process, including requirements definition, supplier qualification, sample validation, pricing, collateral development, and launch execution.
  • Maintain a healthy NPI pipeline and track progress against launch commitments using a disciplined stage-gate approach.
  • Monitor industry trends, customer applications, and emerging technologies through direct market engagement, research, and participation in relevant industry events.
  • Partner with sales teams to support opportunity development, deliver product training, and strengthen market positioning.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with suppliers, customers, the product team, and internal stakeholders across the organization.

Pricing and Profitability

  • Develop, implement, and monitor market-based pricing strategies that support direct and distribution pricing strategies.
  • Build and maintain financial models to support pricing decisions, NPI business cases, and large RFPs.
  • Partner with suppliers and internal teams to improve margin performance, cost competitiveness, and overall portfolio profitability while increasing margins.

Market Intelligence and Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the market expert for fiber optic transceivers and connectivity solutions, monitoring technology trends such as 400G, 800G, and 1.6T migration, silicon photonics, coherent pluggables, and evolving customer requirements.
  • Engage directly with customers, channel partners, and industry participants to understand application needs, buying behavior, market drivers, and forecasted trends.
  • Represent Integra Optics and the ACS Business Unit at customer meetings, trade shows, media opportunities, and industry events as needed.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with sales and business development teams to support strategic opportunities, shape win strategies and provide product and solutions expertise.
  • Collaborate with marketing to develop effective product and solutions messaging, datasheets, application content, and campaign assets.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for the product line by providing guidance and training to channel partners, customers, collaborating with engineering, developing marketing content, and supporting media relations opportunities.
  • Partner with operations, procurement, marketing, and sales to ensure launch readiness, supply continuity, and fulfillment performance.
  • Work collaboratively with other product line leaders to develop integrated, system-level solutions across the broader Infinite Electronics portfolio.

Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred.
  • 15+ years of experience in product management, with earlier responsibilities in business development, sales, or applications engineering for fiber optic products across multiple markets and applications.
  • Established relationships with key industry leaders, governing agencies, and industry organizations in the market.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing product strategies, roadmaps, and new product launches.
  • Proven ability to develop and present complex business cases to internal and external stakeholders to gain alignment.
  • Track record of commercial success in both portfolio growth and new product introduction.
  • Ability to translate complex technical knowledge into digestible information to support sales and marketing.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, sound business judgment, a customer-focused mindset, and a proven track record of delivering revenue growth.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly and professionally in English.
  • Strong proficiency and working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Ex, Excel, Word, & PowerPoint), CRM, and ERP.
  • Experience working successfully in a fast-paced environment with evolving priorities.

Performance Goals

  • Launch 4 to 6 new products annually to generate more than $5 million in annual revenue through innovative, differentiated, value-driven solutions.
  • First 30 Days
  • Develop an understanding of the current product portfolio, customer base, and target markets within the business unit. Gain familiarity with the business unit’s capabilities, solutions, and cross-functional resources.
  • Develop an initial product roadmap aligned to growth markets, applications, and customer demand.
  • Identify the partners, suppliers, and engineering resources needed to support roadmap execution.
  • First 60 Days
  • Complete at least three voice-of-customer discussions to validate product priorities and roadmap direction.
  • Finalize a 6-month product roadmap with timelines and execution priorities for presentation to leadership.
  • First 90 Days
  • Engage key telecom and data center customers to gather voice-of-customer insights, understand current network architectures, and identify future solution opportunities.
  • Finalize a 12-month product roadmap with timelines and execution priorities for presentation to leadership.

Preferred Leadership and Professional Attributes

  • Successful candidates are solution-oriented, collaborative, and accountable for results while exhibiting ownership and urgency.
  • Dependable, accountable, and consistent in follow-through.
  • Highly organized with strong time management and prioritization skills.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, reliability, and sound judgment.
  • Detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Able to perform effectively under deadlines and changing business needs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across technical and commercial teams.
  • Maintains a professional presence and represents the organization effectively in internal and external settings.
  • Demonstrates ownership, urgency, collaboration, accountability, and a solutions-oriented approach.

Physical/Environmental Requirements

  • Frequently remains in a stationary position and occasionally moves about the office or worksite to access files, supplies, or attend meetings.

This is a senior leadership opportunity to shape the next stage of Core States Group’s regional civil engineering platform. The Senior Director of Civil Engineering - Regional Practice Leader,is responsible for growing, strengthening, and leading Core States Group's regional civil engineering practices across the West Region.
