jobs.title: Patient Services Representative — Patient Experience & Feedback
jobs.excerpt: About the RoleWe are looking for a Patient Services Representative based in the Philippines to join our patient experience team.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Patient Services Representative based in the Philippines to join our patient experience team.

This role is focused on one thing: listening to our patients and understanding their experience.

You will contact existing patients after their appointments to ask how their experience went, whether they have any feedback, and if there is anything they would like our team to know. You are not expected to solve every problem or provide clinical guidance. Your primary responsibility is to seek to understand, listen carefully, document accurately, and communicate what you learn.

This is an excellent position for someone with experience in phone-based customer service, reception, concierge services, sales, hospitality, or patient/customer support who is naturally curious, empathetic, organized, and comfortable speaking with people over the phone.

What You'll Do

  • Make outbound calls to existing patients following their appointments

  • Ask patients about their appointment and overall experience

  • Use open-ended questions to encourage honest feedback

  • Listen carefully and allow the patient to fully explain their experience

  • Identify themes, concerns, compliments, suggestions, and opportunities for improvement

  • Take clear and accurate notes during each conversation

  • Document the outcome of every call in our database/CRM

  • Accurately categorize and record patient feedback

  • Escalate information to the appropriate internal team when something requires follow-up

  • Maintain a professional, warm, and conversational tone throughout every interaction

  • Complete call and documentation requirements consistently and accurately

  • Protect patient privacy and follow all company policies and procedures

What This Role Is NOT

This is not a heavy problem-solving or troubleshooting position.

You are not expected to have an answer for every patient concern. In fact, one of the most important skills for this role is knowing when not to jump into solution mode.

Your job is to:

Listen → Understand → Document → Escalate When Appropriate

The goal is to collect honest, useful information from our patients so our team can understand what is happening across the patient experience and identify areas where we can improve.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Fluent spoken and written English, minimal accent

  • Excellent English comprehension

  • Strong phone communication skills

  • Previous experience in phone-based customer service, sales, reception, concierge, hospitality, or a similar customer-facing role

  • Comfortable making outbound calls

  • Excellent listening skills

  • Strong note-taking and documentation abilities

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented

  • Able to accurately enter information into a database or CRM

  • Strong computer and typing skills

  • Professional and friendly phone presence

  • Ability to remain calm and professional when speaking with frustrated or unhappy customers

  • Reliable internet connection and a professional remote-work environment

The Ideal Candidate

You are someone who:

  • Genuinely enjoys talking to people

  • Knows how to make someone feel heard

  • Asks good follow-up questions without interrogating the patient

  • Can distinguish between what a patient said and what you assume they meant

  • Takes thorough but concise notes

  • Is comfortable having conversations that don't follow a script exactly

  • Doesn't become defensive when receiving negative feedback

  • Is naturally curious and wants to understand the "why" behind someone's experience

  • Can recognize when something should be escalated rather than attempting to solve it independently

  • Is highly consistent with documentation and follow-through

  • Understands that accurate data collection is just as important as the conversation itself

Example of the Approach We Want

Instead of:

"I'm sorry you had a bad experience. Let me see if I can fix that for you."

We want someone who can say:

"I'm sorry to hear that. I'd really like to understand what happened. Can you tell me a little more about your experience?"

Then listen, ask appropriate follow-up questions, document the details, and make sure the information gets to the right person.

Experience That Translates Well

Candidates with backgrounds such as the following may be especially successful in this position:

  • Call center/customer service

  • Medical or healthcare reception

  • Patient services

  • Concierge services

  • Hospitality

  • Hotel front desk

  • Sales or inside sales

  • Account management

  • Customer success

  • Appointment scheduling

  • Client relations

  • BPO/customer experience

  • Administrative support

Healthcare experience is helpful but not required.

Performance Expectations

Success in this role will be measured by:

  • Quality and accuracy of patient notes

  • Completion of assigned outbound calls

  • Professionalism and communication quality

  • Accuracy of information entered into the database

  • Ability to effectively capture patient sentiment and feedback

  • Appropriate identification and escalation of issues

  • Reliability and consistency

  • Ability to follow established workflows and documentation standards

Schedule

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines

Specific working hours will be discussed during the interview process and may be aligned with Eastern Standard Time U.S. business hours.

Why Join Us?

This role provides an opportunity to directly influence how we understand and improve the patient experience. The information you collect will help our team identify patterns, recognize what we're doing well, and understand where patients may be experiencing friction.

If you are a great listener, excellent communicator, organized note-taker, and genuinely interested in people, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to join our Patient Services team.

The Vice President, Channels will build and execute Allvia's partner-led growth strategy — establishing a repeatable channel motion that generates qualified referrals and pipeline for the Allvia operating companies to convert into new clients, market share, and revenue.

This is a player-coach role. In the first phase, this leader will personally prospect, pitch, and close partnership agreements with decision makers at target firms while designing the operating model — partner segmentation, value proposition, agreement structure, referral process, enablement materials, and reporting. As the motion proves out, this individual is expected to build and lead a channel team over the next 6–12 months.

Channel Strategy & Partner Development

Pipeline Generation & Operating Company Alignment

Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership

  • Work with marketing to develop partner co-marketing, campaigns, events, and demand generation programs that drive referral volume.
  • Coordinate with operations and service delivery to ensure partner-referred clients receive an onboarding experience that protects the partner relationship.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.excerpt: Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry.
jobs.description:
Digible is a privately owned and operated digital marketing company founded in 2017 with a mission to bring cutting-edge solutions to the multifamily industry. We offer a full suite of digital services, alongside Fiona, our predictive analytics platform—the first of its kind.

At Digible, we take pride in our collaborative, transparent, and authentic culture. Since 2021, we've been recognized as a Top Workplace in Colorado and secured the #8 spot in the Best Places to Work Multifamily rankings. From our hiring process to our All Hands meetings and Town Halls, our values are at the core of everything we do.

We believe diversity fuels innovation, and we strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work. If you're ready to do the best work of your career, we'd love to have you on the team!

Core Values

  • Authenticity — The commitment to be steadfast and genuine with our actions and communication toward everyone we touch.
  • Curiosity — The belief that a deep and fundamental curiosity (the "why") in our work is vital to company innovation and evolution.
  • Focus — The collective will to remain completely devoted and ultimately accountable to our deliverables.
  • Humility — The recognition and daily practice that "we" is always greater than "I".
  • Happiness — The decision to prioritize passion and love for what we do above everything else.

The Role

Digible is hiring a Senior Product Manager to found a brand-new pod at the center of our 2026 strategy: productizing Digible's agency operations and customer data, and serving as the connective tissue that turns a collection of services and tools into one coherent experience for our agency team and ultimately our customers.

You'll define the pod's charter and roadmap from scratch, partnering deeply with our agency operations leaders (your day-one allies and internal customers) to decide what gets solved by people, product, or automation. You'll ship experiences that make Digible dramatically more efficient internally and noticeably better to buy from and work with externally.

This is also our most technical PM seat: you'll work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization — and you should be excited by exactly that kind of work. As a senior member of the team, you'll help lead AI transformation across product, design, and engineering. This is a role for someone who loves hands-on IC work. For the right person, it can also open a path into product management leadership as our org scales. You'll report to the VP of Product.

We're a small product org inside a profitable, bootstrapped company — nine years successful before the recent AI wave, and now in the middle of an AI transformation, reinventing how an established company operates and thrives in the AI era. Profitability and bootstrapping mean you'll work on real customer and business problems, not a search for product/market fit, with a direct line to an accessible leadership team. You'll use AI throughout your workflow to move faster and more effectively than a team our size normally could.

You'll Love This Job If You Love:

Products with…

  • 🧵 Connective Tissue: unifying fragmented tools and services into one coherent customer experience
  • 🏢 Internal Customers: internal agency teams as primary users today — evolving toward serving customers directly over time
  • ✨ AI: deciding what gets solved by people, product, or automation — and using AI to shift that line

Roles with…

  • 🌱 0→1 Building: founding a brand-new pod with a blank roadmap and a clear mandate
  • 🧭 A Leadership Path: loving senior IC work for the long haul, with potential to grow into player/coach leadership as the org scales

Organizations with…

  • 🚀 Small Teams: working with small teams that trade scale for agility & autonomy
  • 🏗️ Early Foundations: crafting the systems, rituals, and mindsets of a relatively new product org

Cultures with…

  • 📅 4-day Workweek: we work Mon–Thu, so every weekend is a long weekend
  • ⚖️ Modeled Balance: we know work is a part of life — boundaries are modeled by leadership

Businesses with…

  • 📈 Fast Growth: this isn't a turnaround — 371% three-year growth per the 2025 Inc. 5000 (No. 1,165)
  • 🥾 Bootstrapped Profitability: we control our own destiny, with no investor or burn pressure

What You'll Do:

  • 💡 Customer Insight: understand our customers, agency operations, and business deeply enough to see the unifying product beneath them — and keep making time for customer conversations even when the roadmap is loud
  • 🧭 Pod Strategy & Roadmap: build your pod's strategy from the VP-level product vision and strategy (and influence both), then own the roadmap and execution for a brand-new pod from scratch
  • 🛠️ 0→1 Execution: lead discovery and delivery of foundational platform experiences — integrations, customer data architecture, and workflow productization
  • 🤝 Ops Partnership: treat agency ops leaders as customers and partners, not requesters — decide together what gets solved by people, product, or automation
  • 🏁 End-to-End Delivery: ship the full experience, including internal enablement and change management
  • 📏 Measure Impact: instrument a brand-new domain so success is measurable from day one — inventing creative or technical ways to get data that doesn't exist yet
  • 🌱 Emerging Leadership: mentor PMs and agency team members, shape team rituals, and grow deliberately toward player/coach people leadership over time
  • 🧠 Product Taste: make the right calls consistently in our most ambiguous domain — problem-first, creative yet analytical, with a high bar for what deserves to ship
  • 📡 Industry Trends: stay ahead of AI and product trends — and educate the team and stakeholders on what matters

How Success Will Be Measured:

Business Metrics

  • $ Operational Efficiency: measurably reduce manual effort by productizing services and automating workflows
  • $ Revenue Retention & Expansion: customer experiences that make clients stay and grow

Product Metrics

  • Time-to-Value: customers reach value faster on what you ship
  • Adoption: internal teams and customers actually run on what you ship
  • CSAT: internal and external customers trust and prefer what you ship

What You Should Have:

Must Have

  • 5+ years of product management experience
  • 2+ years of AI product experience
  • Technical depth to work on integrations, customer data architecture, core platform, and workflow productization — and genuine excitement for that type of work
  • Proven 0→1 ownership: took an ambiguous, mission-critical product area from nothing to shipped and adopted — with the product taste to know what deserved to exist
  • Cross-functional leadership without authority — you treat stakeholders as customers and partners, and have aligned ops, eng, and business teams around one strategy
  • Genuine desire to grow into product management leadership — this seat is our future people-leader bench

Preferred

  • Small start-up (<150 people) experience
  • Experience productizing internal operations or building workflow/integration products
  • Tech-enabled services or hybrid product-service business experience

Bonus

  • First-PM-in-domain experience
  • Digital marketing domain knowledge (strategy, metrics, and technology)
  • Real estate domain knowledge (ex: rentals, multifamily, single family, etc.)

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times

Pay, Perks and More!

  • $150,000 - $180,000 annually
  • 4-Day Work Week (32 Hour Work Week)
  • WFA (Work From Anywhere)
  • Profit Sharing Bonus
  • We offer 3 weeks of PTO as well as Sick leave, and Bereavement.
  • We offer 11 paid holidays!
  • 401(k) + Match
  • 75% Employer Paid Health Benefits (Medical, Dental, and Vision)
  • Mental and Physical Wellness Reimbursement Benefit
  • $1000/year travel fund for employees who have been with Digible 3+ years
  • Financial wellness coaching for all team members!
  • Dog-Friendly Office
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Monthly Social Events
  • Weekly lunches and snacks for in office employees!
HEADS UP! We believe in transparency throughout our hiring process. To help us ensure a great fit, we'll ask you to share a few professional references during the hiring process who can speak to your experience and skills. It’s all part of our commitment to open, honest communication and our core values: Focus, Authenticity, Humility, Curiosity, and Happiness.

ABOUT: Cardiovascular Services of America (CVAUSA) is the largest private and independent cardiology network in the United States. Our inclusive and diverse network brings together top cardiovascular specialists and thought leaders who offer regional perspectives and a broad strategic vision for the future of patient care.
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:
Headquartered in Orlando area, Cardiovascular Associates of America aims to bring the best cardiovascular physicians in one network with the common mission of saving lives, reducing costs, and improving patient care through clinical innovation. Through CVAUSA’s physician-centered practice management model, physicians drive clinical care and their practice culture, while benefiting from the business expertise and shared resources available through CVAUSA for better patient outcomes.
JOB OVERVIEW:
The Senior Director of Marketing drives marketing strategy for our corporate brand while serving as a strategic marketing partner to our network of affiliated cardiology practices. This leader builds, scales, and executes localized marketing playbooks to help the company and practices to increase patient volume and local market share. The ideal candidate balances high-level corporate brand strategy with a "client-service" mindset, treating affiliated practices as internal clients to accelerate their growth.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES (included but not limited to):
Practice Support & Internal Agency Management
  • Act as an internal marketing consultant to affiliated practice leaders, assessing local market needs and delivering tailored growth plans.
  • Oversee marketing vendors (Strategy Collective and other local groups) with the management and coordination of marketing strategies ensuring approval and satisfaction of practice groups.
  • Design and scale a standardized "Marketing Playbook" that newly acquired or affiliated practices can rapidly deploy to increase patient volume.
  • Lead local patient campaigns for clinics, focusing on core cardiology services, vein/vascular care, and diagnostic imaging.
  • Manage local reputation and footprint, overseeing SEO, Google Business Profiles, and patient review generation for individual doctors and clinics.
MSO Strategy & Business Development
  • Strengthen the corporate brand to position our company as the premier MSO partner of choice for independent cardiologists and medical groups.
  • Support the business development team by creating high-impact case studies, presentations, and data driven collateral that prove how our marketing support grows practice revenue.
  • Develop physician-to-physician referral programs to boost patient transfers from primary care providers into our affiliated cardiology practices.
  • Build compelling B2B marketing assets (e.g., case studies, data sheets) that demonstrate how corporate marketing support drives patient volume and revenue growth for affiliates.
Operations, Compliance & Analytics
  • Manage a centralized marketing budget, efficiently allocating resources between corporate-level initiatives and practice-specific campaigns.
  • Ensure strict healthcare compliance across all corporate and practice marketing assets, strictly adhering to HIPAA, Stark Law, and medical advertising regulations.
  • Track and report performance KPIs to both corporate executives and practice stakeholders, demonstrating marketing ROI, cost per lead, and patient volume growth.
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS, KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, and ABILITIES
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Healthcare Administration, or related field (MBA preferred).
  • Experience: 8–10+ years of marketing experience, with at least 4 years in a multi-site healthcare environment, MSO, or healthcare marketing agency.
  • Cardiology Knowledge: Familiarity with cardiovascular service lines, patient demographics, and referral patterns is highly preferred.
  • Relationship Management: Proven ability to influence and collaborate with independent physicians, practice managers, and corporate executives.
  • Technical Skills: Experience with multi-location SEO/PPC management, healthcare CRMs, and HIPAA-compliant marketing automation tools.
Position Overview
  • Benefits: Full benefits package active on day one
  • Type: Full-time, 100% Remote
  • Travel: Approximately 40%

jobs.title: AI-Native Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Our Mission at AMPECO is to enable the EV charging providers of tomorrow through innovative technology, and the vision we share is to build the platform of choice for large-scale EV charging providers globally.
jobs.description:
Our Mission at AMPECO is to enable the EV charging providers of tomorrow through innovative technology, and the vision we share is to build the platform of choice for large-scale EV charging providers globally.
At AMPECO, we empower businesses with innovative software solutions in e-mobility and energy. Our SaaS product, used by companies to manage their EV charging infrastructure, processes, and efficient energy use, is already making a difference across the UK, continental Europe, South and North America, Australia, and Asia.

Why will you enjoy this new opportunity?

    You love building software that genuinely matters — software that changes how an entire industry operates. You’re energized by hard problems, by clean architecture, and by the fact that the technologies you work with keep evolving, because that evolution is exactly what makes the work interesting. You’re excited rather than threatened by AI changing how software gets built, and you want to be on the leading edge of that shift — not watching it from the sidelines. You want to build software that real businesses depend on, not software that sits on a shelf.

    This role sits at the core of AMPECO, where our mission is to enable the EV charging providers of tomorrow through innovative technology. Our platform manages 300,000+ charge ports across 70 markets — critical infrastructure with 24/7 SLAs, used by charging businesses across the UK, continental Europe, the Americas, Australia, and Asia.

    We rebuilt our entire engineering process around our CoOperator Dev Agent (CODA): today it delivers 7× the features with the same team, with ~80% fewer bugs per feature. Engineers direct the work and own the quality bar by holding the final approval.

What type of work will you be doing?

    As a Software Engineer at AMPECO, you will:

    • Own the architecture and system design — set the technical direction our AI agents build within, and judge whether what they produce fits it. The platform is a global SaaS: a PHP/Laravel core, Node.js + TypeScript and Go microservices, and a React Native + TypeScript mobile app.
    • Groom stories side by side with product owners — this is the highest-leverage human step in our process. You’ll sharpen requirements into specs crisp enough to hand to the factory, and increasingly define and request features yourself, not just receive them.
    • Direct AI agents rather than type code: align on the what and the why up front, then validate the result — reviewing not just the final code but every artifact along the way: the implementation plan, the acceptance-test plan, the test evidence, and the agent’s proof of work.
    • Hold the final approval that closes every story — the human gate that keeps “frictionless” from becoming “uncontrolled” — and become a trusted voice in raising the quality bar for everyone.
    • Make every correction permanent: feedback you give in review gets codified into the system — skills, rules, and checklists — so the same mistake never has to be corrected twice. Our best engineers are the ones whose expertise the whole factory now runs on.
    • Contribute to CODA itself — refining agent instructions, strengthening automated quality guardrails, extending workflows with project-specific steps, and helping push the system further toward autonomous, zero-touch delivery.

What does a typical day look like?

    You wake up to a review stack: the stories you queued yesterday were implemented, tested, and pushed through CI overnight. Your morning is judgment work — reviewing plans and diffs, approving what’s proven, sending back what isn’t (your comments don’t just fix this story; they get mined to improve the factory). Midday you groom the next stories with your product owner — the one handoff we deliberately kept. You end the day by queueing the next batch so the factory runs while you sleep. Bugs flow through the factory just like stories — investigation, root cause, and fix are automated, and the review is yours. You choose when to review them, so bugs never break your flow.

What are we looking for?

    • Strong software engineering fundamentals — system design, API and data modeling, and the code-reading depth to review work you could have built yourself. You can’t direct what you couldn’t do.
    • Writing as a first-class skill: your specs and review feedback are your work product now.
    • Taste and judgment for quality — you notice what’s missing, not just what’s wrong.
    • Curiosity about the tooling itself: the engineers who thrive here treat the factory as a product they co-own, not a service they consume.
    • Experience with our stack is a plus — PHP/Laravel above all, and any of Node.js/TypeScript, Go, or React Native — but we care more about engineering depth than framework history.

Structure and culture of the team and leadership of the role

    You’ll join exceptional engineers whose best knowledge isn’t just in their heads — it’s encoded in the skills and rules the factory runs on. You learn from both; in time, your expertise joins the library. We run a flat structure with minimal hierarchy: decisions are made close to the work, ideas are judged on their merit rather than the title behind them, and every team member — whatever their level or discipline — is expected to take a leading role in how the team performs. You’ll have direct access to the people shaping the platform’s direction. We focus on iterative improvement, both of the software we build and the practices we use to build it.

    That flat structure comes with real product ownership. You won’t just be handed tickets — you’ll help define the “what” and the “why” alongside product owners, take features from intent through to production, and own the quality and outcome of what you ship. Responsibility here isn’t diffused across handoffs; it’s concentrated with the engineer who sees the work through.

    This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to give, learn, and grow alongside amazing, highly experienced people — and to put their mark on a fast-growing company on the path to becoming a global industry leader.

Where is this role located?

    This role is remote, with the option to work from one of our Sofia-based offices whenever you like. We offer flexible work hours, and our interview process is entirely remote.

Benefits and perks of working at AMPECO

    • The opportunity to join a fast-growing company on the path to becoming a global industry leader, working with amazing, highly experienced people.
    • Remote work with the option to work from one of our Sofia-based offices, plus flexible work hours.
    • A bonus day off to celebrate your birthday, and 5 additional vacation days per year after your first year with the company.
    • Social events and awesome team buildings.
    • Medical insurance for you and your family, with great coverage.
    • Monthly shared mobility allowance (covers Spark and GOeGO).
    • EV week — you get a company electric car for yourself for a week every 1–2 months.
Our team at AMPECO is deeply committed to our mission and we're looking for like-minded individuals eager to give, learn and grow with us. If you're passionate about innovative technology and want to make a real impact in the e-mobility sector, we want to hear from you. Join AMPECO in building the future of EV charging!
Our interview process is entirely remote. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

jobs.excerpt: Join the Rest RevolutionThe world is wired and tired.
jobs.description:
Join the Rest Revolution

The world is wired and tired. It's plagued by screens, notifications, and the sense that you should always be doing ... something. But hey, you're reading this job application right now, so you probably know exactly what we're talking about.

So here's a bit of good news amidst all the noise: Hatch is a sleep wellness company that's betting on rest in a culture obsessed with optimization. While most technology is designed to keep you engaged, our devices use the science of habit formation to help people unplug, unwind, and recharge. Through genuinely enjoyable routines, habit building, and gentle guidance (no sleep scores or wearables here), we help people build healthier sleep habits and feel the difference in everyday life.

Ten years ago, we started with a mission to help parents navigate the complexities of newborn sleep. Today, we're helping more than 5 million people (and counting) take care of themselves and the people they love through the power of rest.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a Director of Growth Strategy — a senior IC role designed to be the strategic nerve center of the growth organization. This person synthesizes signals across marketing channels, sales channels, product, and customer data to surface the highest-impact growth opportunities and threats before they become obvious. They operate without execution ownership, without channel bias, and with direct access to the executive team. Their primary deliverable is insight and recommendation that drives leadership decisions.

This is not a channel ownership role. Not a brand strategy role. Not a data analytics role. It sits at the intersection of all three — and exists because no single function can see the full picture alone.

This role reports to the VP of Growth Marketing and partners closely with channel owners, Creative, Analytics, Product, and Finance.

We’re open to candidates across the U.S. and Canada. However, please note that Hatch is based in California, so we just ask that you're available during PST/PDT hours.

What You’ll Do

In Your First 45 Days

  • Get up to speed on Hatch's business: channel mix, unit economics, customer segments, subscription dynamics, and key performance drivers across DTC and retail.
  • Build a clear view of current growth performance across marketing, retail, and DTC — identifying the most critical gaps and highest-potential opportunities.
  • Partner with Analytics, channel owners, and Finance to understand how data is structured and where the key blind spots are.
  • Surface 3–4 high-impact opportunities or risks with clear hypotheses and initial recommendations to guide near-term focus.

By 90 days

  • Regularly synthesize inputs across paid media, retail, DTC, market signals, and customer behavior to identify the most important growth opportunities and risks.
  • Translate complex or incomplete data into clear narratives that help leadership make fast, confident decisions.
  • Challenge assumptions across the growth organization — bringing an outside-in perspective that no single channel owner can provide.
  • Establish a consistent cadence of insight sharing that keeps the executive team focused on what matters most.

After Your First Year

  • Play a central role in shaping Hatch's growth strategy, contributing to annual planning and long-term investment decisions.
  • Identify step-change opportunities across channels, customer segments, geographies, and new growth levers.
  • Serve as a trusted thought partner to the executive team — the person leadership turns to when the most important and ambiguous growth questions need a clear answer.
  • Expand scope as Hatch grows: international expansion, new product categories, new audience strategies, and new revenue models all come through this function.

What You’ll Bring

  • 8–12 years of experience in growth strategy, marketing strategy, or business strategy with significant consumer brand exposure.
  • Meaningful experience at a DTC consumer brand — consulting background is a complement, not a substitute.
  • Proven track record of independently structuring and delivering analyses that drove major business decisions — not just supported them.
  • Experience presenting strategic recommendations directly to C-suite or board-level leadership and earning their trust.
  • Genuine fluency in how consumer growth channels work — not as a practitioner, but enough to know what the signals mean: paid social, search, influencer, retail, Amazon, DTC, and subscription economics.
  • Strong commercial instincts: you think naturally in CAC, LTV, payback period, contribution margin, and channel ROI.
  • IC analytical self-sufficiency — you can build your own analysis from raw data when needed, not just direct others to do it.
  • Executive communication — you can take a complex, multi-variable picture and land a clear point of view with a CEO in 10 minutes.
  • Comfort with SQL, Excel/Sheets, and BI platforms, with a focus on interpretation and synthesis over reporting.
  • High curiosity, strong business judgment, and the ability to identify what matters most in a fast-moving environment.
  • Experience scaling a consumer business from early growth stage through significant revenue scale, ideally $15–200M+ run rate.

Why You’ll Love Working at Hatch

💛 We’re a certified Great Place to Work! 94% of our employees say Hatch is a great place to work.

💡 You’ll work with an amazing leadership team that truly values employees and leads with our company values every day.

🌙 We help people sleep better! Our products make a meaningful impact on people’s lives.

🎉 Our team is collaborative, fun, and full of brilliant minds.

🚀 We’re backed by world-class investors and growing fast!

🏡 We support flexibility with a remote-friendly work environment.

The Perks & Benefits That Matter

✨ 100% paid medical, dental, and vision insurance for employees (80% for dependents, including domestic partners)

💰 Meaningful equity—you’re an owner here

📈 401(k) match (no vesting schedule!)

👶 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

💜 Financial support for family planning

🏡 Remote office + monthly internet reimbursement

🛍️ Friends & family discounts on Hatch products

🎟️ Exclusive discounts on travel, entertainment, and top retail brands

💫 And so many more spontaneous perks!

About Hatch

Designed by experts and loved by parents, our Rest family—including Rest, Rest+, and Rest Go—helps little ones (and their grown-ups) build healthy sleep routines. For adults, Hatch Restore is a fully customizable smart sleep clock and sunrise alarm designed to help you unwind nightly, sleep deeply, and wake gently.

Founded in 2014 by parent entrepreneurs Ann Crady Weiss and Dave Weiss and featured on Shark Tank, Hatch is headquartered in Menlo Park, California.

jobs.excerpt: Digital Marketing ManagerCompany OverviewForce Factor is on a mission to disrupt the global health and wellness industry by creating innovative health products that help consumers Unleash their Potential.
jobs.description:
Digital Marketing Manager

Company Overview

Force Factor is on a mission to disrupt the global health and wellness industry by creating innovative health products that help consumers Unleash their Potential. Our vitamins, supplements, and better-for-you foods are scientifically formulated to help create healthier and happier lives for people of all kinds.

Our award-winning products are sold in thousands of retail and e-Commerce stores nationwide, including Walmart, Amazon, Walgreens, Target, CVS, The Vitamin Shoppe, Sam’s Club and iHerb. Currently, more than 35,000 people buy our products daily, and that number is growing every month. You have the potential to make a real impact on people’s lives by working at Force Factor to create products that Unleash Potential!

Culturally, think of us as an intense, meritocratic, and exciting high-growth startup that has survived and thrived through its first decade of rapid evolution and is now thinking about how to scale up and conquer the next decade’s challenges and opportunities. We’ve accomplished a lot in our first 16+ years, but fundamentally know that we’re just at the beginning of our journey, and that’s where you come in! We need the smartest, highest energy people with real integrity who are looking to join an ambitious, hard-working team.

Force Factor is based in Boston’s innovative Seaport District. Our team is filled with passionate, dedicated, and inspiring people operating with an ownership mindset (which is easy because we are entirely privately held and plan to stay that way). If you love a challenge, enjoy acting with urgency, and prefer to opt into a high-performance culture, when you join us, you’ll feel like you’ve finally come home. Our private ownership structure is designed for the long term to enable huge opportunities for key team members to learn a ton, work with other A players and generate significant wealth, and we hope you’ll choose to help us build an enduring and successful business for decades to come. There are two reasons we’re included on Bain’s Insurgent Brands list of high-achieving CPG brands outperforming market growth: our people and our culture.

The Role

We are hiring a Digital Marketing Manager to act as the digital business owner for a defined portfolio of Force Factor sub-brands, with accountability for driving their growth and overall performance across our eCommerce and retail ecosystem. This role sits inside our Digital Marketing team and reports to the SVP of Digital Marketing.

You will combine performance marketing, retail media, analytics, forecasting, consumer and competitive insights, and rigorous experimentation to understand what is driving the business and determine what we should do next. You will manage significant media investment across Amazon, Walmart, Meta, STV, and other retail and digital channels, but your responsibility extends far beyond media efficiency: you will identify opportunities to accelerate demand, improve paid and organic visibility, acquire new consumers, grow sales, and maximize the profitable long-term growth of your portfolio. You will work closely with Creative, Sales, and eCommerce to make sure every dollar we invest has a clear job to do—and that we are constantly finding better ways to turn that investment into profitable growth.

This is a hands-on seat with real ownership over your slice of the portfolio. You are in the platforms every day for your sub-brands, running the tests, reading the numbers, and moving fast on what they tell you. You will be expected to spot changes in performance early, dig until you understand what is driving them, and turn those findings into clear actions. If you want a role where someone else calls the shots and you execute a plan handed to you, this is not the seat. If you want to own the business performance of a defined portfolio, develop the strategy to grow it, and be accountable for the results, this is exactly the seat.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the growth strategy and digital business performance for assigned product portfolios, with accountability for POS growth, customer acquisition, media productivity, paid and organic visibility, and profitable long-term growth across eCommerce and key retail channels.
  • Own media strategy, investment, and performance across Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Meta, STV, and other priority retail and digital channels, ensuring channel decisions ladder up to broader portfolio and business goals.
  • Develop, execute, and analyze upper-funnel demand generation across STV, paid social (Meta, Instagram, YouTube), display, and emerging channels to expand reach, build brand consideration, acquire new consumers, and understand the downstream impact on retail demand and portfolio growth.
  • Continuously diagnose portfolio performance across sales, traffic, conversion, media, distribution, pricing, promotion, paid and organic search visibility, and competitive activity; identify the true drivers behind changes in performance and turn those findings into clear, actionable growth strategies and new business opportunities.
  • Evaluate media through a total-business and incrementality lens, distinguishing paid from organic contribution, assessing new-to-brand acquisition, and determining when reported channel performance does or does not reflect the true value of the investment.
  • Design and evaluate rigorous tests across media, bidding, audiences, creative, promotional support, and channel mix; separate signal from noise, document learnings, and rapidly scale what works across the portfolio.
  • Use performance data, consumer insights, and structured testing to identify creative opportunities, develop clear briefs and hypotheses, and partner with Creative to continuously improve messaging and asset performance across channels.
  • Translate complex datasets and analyses into concise, decision-ready recommendations for Creative, Sales, eCommerce, and senior leadership, clearly articulating what happened, why it matters, and what we should do next.
  • Own retail media partner relationships, ensuring partners remain aligned to Force Factor’s performance goals and strategic priorities while maintaining internal ownership of strategy and investment decisions.
  • Own portfolio forecasts for POS consumption and media spend; identify variances to plan early, diagnose the drivers, and recommend actions to close performance gaps or accelerate upside.
  • Stay ahead of changes in advertising platforms, retail media capabilities, measurement, attribution, privacy, and consumer behavior, and proactively adapt strategy as things evolve.

Ideal Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Marketing, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related discipline.
  • 4 to 6 years of hands-on performance marketing and retail media experience, including meaningful ownership of multimillion-dollar budgets and business outcomes, not simply campaign execution under someone else's strategy.
  • Experience in CPG, wellness, supplements, or another high-velocity consumer category is strongly preferred.
  • Deep, current fluency across Amazon Ads, Walmart Connect, Meta Ads Manager, STV/CTV, including advanced bidding strategies, audience structures, and performance optimization. Experience with Amazon DSP, AMC, and additional retail media networks is a strong plus.
  • Strong commercial instincts. Evaluates decisions against the health of the overall business, not just CAC, or ROAS, and understands when an apparently “inefficient” investment may still be the right investment to drive incremental and long-term growth
  • Exceptional analytical skills and Excel proficiency. Analytically self-sufficient: comfortable pulling, manipulating, reconciling, and analyzing large or messy datasets, identifying anomalies, pressure-testing conclusions, and building analyses from scratch.
  • Strong understanding of incrementality, attribution, paid versus organic contribution, new-to-brand acquisition, and the limitations of platform-reported performance metrics.
  • Naturally investigative and intellectually curious. When performance changes, you do not simply report what happened, you keep digging until you understand why it happened and what should change as a result.
  • Direct, concise, and confident communicator. You can translate complex analyses into a clear recommendation, explain the business implications to non-marketers and senior leaders, and defend your reasoning without hiding behind jargon.
  • High degree of ownership and autonomy. You identify problems and opportunities without waiting to be assigned them, develop a point of view, and bring solutions and recommendations rather than open-ended questions.
  • A bias for speed and comfort with ambiguity. You test, learn, make decisions with imperfect information, and move again without waiting for a committee, while maintaining a high bar for accuracy and quality.
  • Genuine curiosity about the category and competitive landscape. You know who the important competitors are, pay attention to what they are doing, and form a point of view on where they are winning, where they are vulnerable, and what Force Factor should do differently.
  • Passion for analytics, performance marketing, and continuous learning, with a desire to stay current on emerging advertising capabilities, measurement approaches, retail media trends, and best practices.
  • Well-organized, methodical thinker who can handle competing priorities and make decisions under pressure while delivering accurate, on-time, high-quality work.
  • Detail-oriented, driven, and organized high performer with an insatiable desire to win.

About the Team

The Partners Team plays a critical role in extending that impact. We build and scale mutually beneficial relationships with leading LMSs, LXPs, HR platforms, and technology partners that distribute, bundle, or refer to OpenSesame's enterprise learning solutions globally. Our mandate is to create a scalable, tiered partner ecosystem that fuels indirect revenue, amplifies partner-led go-to-market motions, and delivers a world-class partner experience.

As Director of Strategic Partnerships, you will act as the architect and leader of this ecosystem, connecting strategy to execution, partners to product, and opportunity to revenue. You are a hands-on, player/coach leader who builds systems, drives outcomes, and leads by example.

You will define and evolve OpenSesame’s partner strategy, lead a global team of Strategic Partner Managers, own the programmatic maturity of the partner ecosystem, and serve as an executive-level partner to both internal leaders and external stakeholders.

Performance Objectives

Establish Strategic Clarity & Ecosystem Understanding (0–60 Days)

  • Build deep working knowledge of OpenSesame’s partner ecosystem by meeting with the top 30 partners to understand their business models, goals, performance metrics, and integration requirements.
  • Review existing partner processes, systems, reporting, and playbooks to identify scalability gaps and execution friction.
  • Develop strong relationships with Strategic Partner Managers by observing partner touchpoints, including QBRs, enablement sessions, and joint planning meetings.
  • Gain fluency in OpenSesame’s value proposition, competitive positioning, and integration approaches — including tradeoffs across different partner requirements.

Drive Program Insight & Early Impact (60–90 Days)

  • Conduct and present a comprehensive SWOT analysis of the partner program, identifying growth blockers, operational inefficiencies, risks, and expansion opportunities.
  • Define the critical path for ecosystem growth aligned to OpenSesame’s 30%+ annual revenue targets.
  • Begin contributing individually to high-impact partner engagements, including QBRs and strategic planning sessions.
  • Review and evaluate partner tiering, incentives, joint value propositions, and performance metrics to assess alignment with long-term strategy.
  • Lead executive-level partner meetings, onsite visits, and strategic presentations.
  • Establish clear expectations, goals, and communication cadences with your global team.
  • Demonstrate early improvements in partner contribution metrics, including sourced revenue, influenced revenue, partner satisfaction, and depth of collaboration.
  • Act as a trusted contributor to the Senior Management Team, helping refine OKRs, inform strategy, and represent the partner ecosystem across the business.

Scale the Partner Operating System (90–180 Days)

  • Deliver a comprehensive three-year partner ecosystem strategy, outlining revenue milestones, GTM alignment, resourcing needs, operational improvements, and partner experience enhancements.
  • Present cross-functional recommendations to Sales, Marketing, Product, and Operations to unlock partner-led growth.
  • Launch key initiatives to evolve the partner program, such as improved onboarding workflows, refined partner tiers, enhanced enablement, and optimized operating processes.
  • Establish a scalable partner governance model covering roadmap visibility, escalation paths, joint planning, and communication cadences.
  • Build and launch internal and external partner reporting systems that track performance, pipeline, onboarding, enablement, and strategic outcomes.
  • Optimize and operationalize the Partner Playbook to document best practices for forecasting, escalations, enablement, and partner management.
  • Demonstrate measurable improvements in indirect pipeline contribution, funnel conversion, and partner engagement.
  • Collaborate with Partner Operations to define scoring rubrics and threshold criteria for future partner tiers.

Deliver Sustained Ecosystem Growth (12+ Months)

  • Serve as the executive owner for OpenSesame’s most strategic partners, leading roadmap alignment, joint business planning, and high-impact GTM initiatives.
  • Drive ecosystem-led revenue growth through mature partnership models, strong executive relationships, and repeatable partner motions.
  • Demonstrate sustained improvements in partner satisfaction, revenue contribution, and long-term collaboration depth.
  • Lead complex partnership opportunities end-to-end, including structuring partnership models, executive negotiations, onsite engagements, and strategic presentations.
  • Continue evolving the partner ecosystem to support OpenSesame’s global scale, product strategy, and long-term growth.

What Success Looks Like

  • Partners consistently generate meaningful sourced and influenced revenue.
  • The partner ecosystem operates with clarity, repeatability, and strong executive trust.
  • Strategic partners see OpenSesame as a core, long-term growth partner.
  • Internal teams experience strong alignment and confidence in partner-led GTM motions.
  • The partner program scales with structure, accountability, and measurable impact.

You might notice we don’t list a traditional set of requirements or buzzwords here. That’s intentional. We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can build systems, lead teams, scale ecosystems, and drive results.

When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame stronger, faster, and more scalable because of the partner organization you built and led.

The Partnerships team builds and scales OpenSesame's global partner ecosystem. We work across technology, channel, referral, reseller, marketplace, and strategic alliances to expand reach of our joint solutions and deliver exceptional experiences for our partners and their customers.

The Strategic Partner Manager (SPM) is the relationship owner responsible for driving revenue growth, partner activation, and strategic alignment with assigned partners. SPMs operate within a system designed for partner success—they maintain consistent cadences, deliver quick wins, build trust, and drive pipeline behavior. Through partner planning, enablement, and execution, SPMs translate company strategy into partner-led revenue.

About the Role

OpenSesame is seeking an entrepreneurial, relationship-focused Strategic Partner Manager to own a portfolio of strategic partners, drive sourced and influenced revenue, and deliver consistent partner value.

As an SPM, you will manage a book of partner relationships, each with its own business model, sales structure, and growth opportunity. You'll partner with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Operations to activate partners, create joint go-to-market motions, and drive pipeline. This is a blend of relationship management, commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and execution—combining partner business planning with day-to-day touchpoints that keep partners engaged and accountable.

What You'll Do

Know & Own Your Partner Portfolio

You are the primary expert and relationship owner on/for your assigned partners. You segment and prioritize partners based on strategic potential, current performance, partner health, and market opportunity and identify when a partnership should be accelerated, remediated, restructured, or deprioritized. You maintain consistent touchpoints (weekly/bi-weekly), drive quarterly business reviews (QBRs), align on joint strategies, and keep partners accountable to their OpenSesame revenue targets. You build trust through reliability and genuine enthusiasm for partner success.

Drive Pipeline & Revenue

You own sourced and influenced pipeline and booking targets for your partner portfolio. You work with partners to identify co-sell opportunities, activate referral channels, and expand OEM relationships. You maintain pipeline visibility, align with Sales on shared opportunities, and work with partners to move deals forward.

Plan & Execute Partner Growth

You identify opportunities to expand the scope and value of your partnerships by understanding each partner’s strategy, customer base, sales motion, product roadmap, and economics. You evaluate new routes to market, commercial models, integrations, and joint offerings, then align stakeholders and drive the highest-potential opportunities from idea through execution. You develop partner business plans that outline quarterly targets, go-to-market motions, campaign priorities, and success metrics. You coordinate with Partner Marketing to execute co-marketing campaigns, sales plays, and enablement activities. You use planning frameworks and tools (Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, Gong) to drive accountability and measure progress.

Enable & Activate Partners

You ensure partners have the content, messaging, demos, training, and certifications they need to effectively sell and support OpenSesame. You equip partners to understand OpenSesame’s value proposition, confidently position our solutions, and generate pipeline in alignment with OpenSesame sales teams and GTM priorities. Using Highspot and other enablement tools, you coordinate partner onboarding, training, and ongoing enablement while reinforcing best practices that improve partner effectiveness, sales alignment, and operational efficiency.

Be a Strategic Partner Internally

You represent your partners internally. You escalate integration requests, coordinate with Product and Support for critical issues, align Sales on shared accounts, and surface insights that help OpenSesame serve partners better. You maintain visibility into partner technical contacts and ensure proper escalation paths during critical issues.

Performance Objectives

First 30 Days: Learn & Align

Build a strong understanding of OpenSesame's partner ecosystem, your assigned partner portfolio, and how you'll succeed in this role.

Success looks like:

  • Complete OpenSesame onboarding, partner playbook training, and system access (Salesforce, Highspot, Crossbeam, Euler, Gong)
  • Introduce yourself to each partner in your portfolio and schedule recurring touchpoints
  • Understand each partner's business model, OpenSesame integrations, current pipeline, key contacts, and the relevant technology and SaaS context needed to effectively manage the portfolio.
  • Meet with your SPM team, manager, and cross-functional stakeholders (Marketing, Sales, Product, Operations)
  • Align with leadership on expectations, goals, and your plan for the first 90 days

Days 30–90: Build Relationships & Demonstrate Impact

Establish yourself as a trusted partner by delivering quick wins, maintaining consistency, and driving early revenue momentum.

Success looks like:

  • Develop a business plan for each partner, including quarterly targets, key initiatives, and success metrics
  • Schedule and conduct first QBRs with each partner, establishing alignment and cadence
  • Maintain weekly/bi-weekly touchpoints and respond quickly to partner requests
  • Coordinate one partner marketing campaign or enablement initiative
  • Present an assessment of your partner portfolio, including early wins and challenges

Days 90–120: Drive Pipeline & Optimize Execution

Demonstrate consistent progress toward quarterly targets while identifying opportunities to improve partner execution and OpenSesame alignment.

Success looks like:

  • Maintain pipeline visibility and pacing toward quarterly revenue targets
  • Keep partners engaged through consistent communication, quick wins, and clear next steps
  • Identify operational or program friction points and surface recommendations for improvement
  • Build relationships with key technical and commercial contacts at strategic partners

Months 4–12: Mature Partnerships & Drive Sustained Growth

Lead mature, predictable partnerships that consistently generate sourced and influenced revenue while exploring opportunities for deeper strategic collaboration.

Success looks like:

  • Consistently meet or exceed quarterly targets (sourced and influenced)
  • Maintain partner health through regular QBRs, strategic planning, and alignment on joint goals
  • Proactively identify and solve partner challenges before they impact trust or revenue
  • Lead strategic initiatives that deepen partner relationships (e.g., joint roadmap planning, co-marketing)
  • Be recognized as a trusted partner across OpenSesame (Sales, Marketing, Product, Operations)

What Success Looks Like

  • Partners consistently generate meaningful sourced and influenced revenue.
  • Your partners are engaged, responsive, and aligned on OpenSesame's positioning and value.
  • You maintain pipeline visibility and demonstrate pacing toward targets.
  • Cadence matters—your partners expect consistent touchpoints and know what to expect from you.
  • Relationships run deep—key partner contacts trust you, advocate for you, and come to you with opportunities.
  • You're a trusted partner internally—Sales, Marketing, and Product come to you for partner insights.

Travel Requirement: This role may require up to 20% travel based on business needs, including company meetings, partner engagements, and other activities.

Location: This position can be located anywhere in the U.S. In addition to position-specific travel requirements, all positions will require up to 15 days of travel per year for company-wide events (typically January, May, September).

Performance Driven: We’re looking for self-starters with a track record of follow-through, curiosity, and results. We don’t hire based on a checklist — we hire for potential, drive, and evidence of performance. If you’re motivated to learn, comfortable with experimentation, and excited about how technology can make sales more human, you’ll fit right in.

Compensation: The base salary for this position typically ranges from $120,000 to $145,000 USD annually, depending on experience and level. This role is also eligible for up to a 30% bonus. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.

Benefits: Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.

We use AI. For real. Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.

Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

At Reddit, machine learning sits at the heart of how millions of people discover, connect, and engage with the world’s largest collection of human conversations. From powering personalized recommendations and search to optimizing advertising systems and marketplace dynamics, our ML engineers tackle some of the most interesting and impactful problems in large-scale applied machine learning.

We hire Machine Learning Engineers across both our Consumer and Ads organizations, giving you the opportunity to work on a wide range of high-impact problems across the Reddit ecosystem.

We are looking for Machine Learning Engineers who are excited to build systems end-to-end, from research and modeling to production deployment, — and who want to help shape the future of discovery, relevance, and monetization at Reddit.

If you love working on complex, real-world ML problems at massive scale, this role is for you.

What You’ll Work On

As a Machine Learning Engineer at Reddit, you will design and build production ML systems that power core experiences across the platform, including:

  • Personalized recommendations, search, and ranking systems that help users discover the most relevant content and communities
  • Intelligent advertising systems including ranking, bidding, measurement, and optimization
  • Content, Advertisers, and User understanding, from building foundational content/user representations to deriving insightful signals
  • Large-scale machine learning pipelines, model serving infrastructure, and real-time decision systems
  • Applied AI and LLM-driven experiences that improve relevance, discovery, and user engagement

You’ll work on high-impact systems that operate at internet scale and directly influence user experience, advertiser value, and business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build, and deploy production-grade machine learning models and systems at scale
  • Own the full ML lifecycle: from problem definition and feature engineering to training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring
  • Build scalable data and model pipelines with strong reliability, observability, and automated retraining
  • Work with large-scale datasets to improve ranking, recommendations, search relevance, prediction, content/user understanding, and optimization systems.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, and Engineering teams to translate complex problems into ML solutions
  • Improve system performance across latency, throughput, and model quality metrics
  • Research and apply state-of-the-art machine learning and AI techniques, including deep learning, graph & transformers based, and LLM evaluation/alignment
  • Contribute to technical strategy, architecture, and long-term ML roadmap

Basic Qualifications

  • 3-5+ years of experience building, deploying, and operating machine learning systems in production
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, Go, or similar languages, with solid software engineering fundamentals
  • ML Fundamentals: a strong grasp of algorithms, from classic statistical learning (XGBoost, Random Forests, regressions) to DL architectures (Transformers, CNNs, GNNs)
  • Hands-on experience with modern ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Experience designing scalable ML pipelines, data processing systems, and model serving infrastructure
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and translate ambiguous product or business problems into technical solutions
  • Experience improving measurable metrics through applied machine learning

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with recommender systems, search/ranking systems, advertising/auction systems, large-scale representation learning, or multimodal embedding systems
  • Familiarity with distributed systems and large-scale data processing (Spark, Kafka, Ray, Airflow, BigQuery, Redis, etc.)
  • Experience working with real-time systems and low-latency production environments
  • Background in feature engineering, model optimization, and production monitoring
  • Experience with LLM/Gen AI techniques, including but not limited to LLM evaluation, alignment, fine-tuning, knowledge distillation, RAG/agentic systems and productionizing LLM-powered products at scale
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or related quantitative field

With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

Location: At Reddit we continue to grow our teams with the best talent. We're completely remote friendly.

Team Description:

The Marketing Science team at Reddit leverages data to maximize the impact of Reddit’s own marketing investments. We serve as the engine behind our growth, using advanced experimentation, causal inference, and econometrics to understand what drives users to Reddit and what brings advertisers to our platform. We work at the intersection of brand building and performance marketing, ensuring every dollar spent is an investment in the long-term health of our ecosystem.

Role Description:

Reddit is looking for a highly experienced Staff Data Scientist to lead the strategy and technical execution of our Marketing Intelligence efforts. In this role, you will be the primary architect of how we measure and optimize Reddit’s marketing spend. You will focus on two critical flywheels: B2B Marketing (acquiring and retaining advertisers) and B2C Growth (acquiring and engaging new Redditors).

This is a high-autonomy, high-impact role where you will set the long-term strategic goals for Reddit’s marketing measurement, influencing senior leadership and defining how we value our brand and performance efforts.

Responsibilities:

  • Set Long-Term Marketing Strategy: Define the 2–3 year technical roadmap for marketing measurement. Establish the "North Star" metrics and frameworks that determine how Reddit allocates hundreds of millions in marketing budget.
  • Optimize Marketing ROI: Build and refine Media Mix Models (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) systems to mathematically quantify the incremental impact of marketing spend.
  • Bridge B2B & B2C Growth: Design unified frameworks to optimize marketing aimed at both new advertisers (driving revenue) and new users (driving engagement), identifying synergies where brand awareness for one fuels growth for the other.
  • Advance Causal Inference & Experimentation: Lead the design of complex "always-on" incrementality testing and geo-holdout experiments. Develop methodologies to measure the long-term "halo effect" of brand marketing on organic growth.
  • Lead Through Influence: Collaborate deeply with Marketing, Growth, and Finance to translate complex data insights into actionable budget shifts.
  • Be the Technical Guide for the Team: Mentor junior scientists and set the technical bar for code quality and statistical rigor across the Marketing organization.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Advanced degree (Master’s or Ph.D.) in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • Experience:
    • For M.S. holders: 10+ years of industry experience in marketing science, growth data science, or econometrics.
    • For Ph.D. holders: 6+ years of industry experience.
  • Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of the marketing ecosystem, including hands-on experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), Incrementality Testing, and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) prediction.
  • Technical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Python or R and SQL. Experience building production-grade data pipelines and using machine learning for predictive modeling (e.g., churn prediction, lead scoring).
  • Strategic Communication: Proven track record of influencing C-suite stakeholders and "translating" complex statistical concepts into business strategy.
  • Adaptability: Experience working in fast-paced environments where you must navigate ambiguity and build frameworks from the ground up.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Bayesian structural time series or causal inference libraries.
  • Previous experience in a high-growth marketplace or social media platform.
  • A passion for the Reddit community and an understanding of our unique "Ads-as-Content" philosophy.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA • Travel is encouraged approximately once every 6 months to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required.
jobs.description:
Location: Remote, New York City, or Oakland, CA

  • Travel is encouraged approximately once every 6 months to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.

Role Type: Full-time

Compensation: $97,000

Visa sponsorship: Not available

Hires remotely in: United States

Experience: 2+ years of full-time, professional work experience

Recidiviz is thrilled to be hiring a Data Analyst to join our team! We’re a small, fast-moving group that works with complex criminal justice data from our state partners and develops analyses and tools that target the drivers of incarceration. That’s where you come in. We’re looking for someone who has attention to detail to improve our analysis, creativity and inquisitiveness to identify and solve open-ended problems, clarity to think through complex and variable data, flexibility to adjust in a rapidly evolving environment, and above all else, a collaborative, kind nature to add to our culture.

About us

Recidiviz is creating safer, healthier communities by improving outcomes for people in the criminal justice system. We build technology to reduce the number of people in prison and to help criminal justice leaders embrace data-driven decision-making.

Using software tools and thoughtful product design, we’ve been able to safely and permanently reduce incarceration and improve outcomes. We work side-by-side with leaders of the criminal justice system, people in prison and on supervision, and ecosystem partners to build a better path forward. In addition to the revenue we earn from state partners, some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations support our work.

People who succeed at Recidiviz lead with kindness and humility, assume good intent, learn from failure, and fix problems when they see them. They are excited to work arm in arm with government leadership and staff to improve outcomes. They are great listeners. They build deep relationships with and empathy for the people we work with and the people who our mission serves, even when those two groups feel at odds.

About the role

This role collaborates across several teams to guide work that targets the drivers of incarceration. Our Data Analysts work with diverse data – criminal justice data both raw and processed from across the country, reports and policy documents from government agencies, and much more – to develop our understanding of the criminal justice system and to motivate change. They perform analyses, contribute to tooling that improve our data and how we work with it, and help drive product launches by ensuring each product in each state has the analytical data required to drive the impact we seek. Our Data Analysts also play a key role in contextualizing and presenting their analyses to key stakeholders, both internal and external.

Travel is encouraged approximately once every 6 months to state partners within the continental USA, and occasionally required. We expect these trips to include visits to prisons and parole offices.

Core responsibilities

  • Exploring our datasets to find new insights about American criminal justice systems
  • Contextualizing and communicating key findings to internal and external stakeholders
  • Collaborating with our State Engagement and Implementation Engineering teams to design and execute on targeted roadmaps that drive impact in the states where we work
  • Collaborating with our Product Management, Data Science, and Software Engineering teams to bring analyses and data modeling into production software
  • Analyzing trends and changes in areas related to our own work to understand how our products function

Wild success

A year from now:

  • You’ve driven impact. Your work has led to several launches of our products across the country and has helped quantify the impact those tools are having on the outcomes of the justice system.

  • You’ve leveled up our analytical team. Your contributions to our tooling and processes, as well as your support for your teammates, has helped set our team up to achieve more impact sooner.

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, to help nurture a knowledgeable, data-oriented culture
  • Enthusiasm for working with internal and external partners from diverse backgrounds and worldviews, such as government staff, researchers, journalists, technical staff, and practitioners in criminal justice reform
  • Ability to inspect source data, reason about data models, examine results closely, and prepare data and analyses that are usable for various applications
  • 2 or more years of practical experience exploring, analyzing, and processing complex datasets
  • Professional work experience using SQL to work with large datasets, including high proficiency writing efficient queries for more complex data extraction and transformation tasks
  • High familiarity with Python, specifically Pandas package, for tasks such as statistical analysis and data visualization

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience working in a cross-functional organization that designs, builds, and launches products for users
  • Experience working with large datasets from the public sector, especially related to criminal justice
  • Familiarity with our data stack, which includes Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Looker, Jupyter notebooks, and Python/Pandas

Compensation

Compensation is standardized based on roles and responsibilities. This ensures equitable compensation and responsible stewardship of our resources. As such, we do not negotiate compensation offers.

The annual compensation for this role is: $97,000.

What we offer

  • Effective, extremely thoughtful colleagues, working together on a mission that matters
  • 90% medical, dental, and vision insurance coverage for you and your dependents
  • Flexible time off, including 20 days of PTO, 3 days of paid volunteering time, and 13 paid holidays
  • 12 weeks of paid parental leave
  • 401(k) retirement plan with 5% company match and no vesting period
  • Complimentary One Medical membership (depending on location)
  • Partnership with Carrot to provide employees with inclusive fertility and family-forming benefits, as well as a small but growing number of hormonal health and gender-affirming care benefits
  • Monthly ClassPass credit for personal wellness
  • Free mental health support via Talkspace
  • Well-located offices in Oakland and Manhattan, with the flexibility to work remotely or go into either office as you choose
  • An annual company offsite each spring and other ad-hoc gatherings
  • All the exhilarating challenges and stretch opportunities of a tech startup, combined with the mission-driven heart of a nonprofit

More about Recidiviz

Recidiviz was an all-volunteer effort until early 2019, when Clementine, Andrew, and Joshua founded the organization. Since then, we’ve built an A-team of software engineers, designers, product managers and domain experts, from companies like Google, Apple, Dropbox, Opower, and Sidewalk Labs. Recidiviz was part of Y-Combinator’s 2019 class and has received support from some of the most respected philanthropists and foundations, including Ford Foundation, Mackenzie Scott, Schmidt Futures, Arnold Ventures, Chan Zuckerberg Initiative, and the Mozilla Foundation.

Today, Recidiviz works with (and earns revenue from) over 18 state partners – big and small, red and blue – and covers more than 40% of the US incarcerated population. We have helped to get tens of thousands of people out of the criminal justice system, safely and equitably, and saved states nearly $1 billion. In the next five years, Recidiviz plans to partner with 40 states and help 250,000 people who are stuck in the system to get out and stay out. In addition to partnering with state Departments of Corrections, Recidiviz collaborates with and learns from partners – from organizations like the Correctional Leaders Association (CLA) to community based organizations and justice-impacted individuals, whose perspectives guide our work.

To learn more about how we do what we do, check out our 2024 Year in Review, read some press coverage, or watch our TED Talk. And if you’re really keen to see our work, you can dive into our Github :).

An important note

Lasting change is always built on diversity. Recidiviz recruits, employs, trains, compensates and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, disability, age, veteran status, ancestry, citizenship, marital status, gender identity and all protected status as required by applicable law. We consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know in your application. Even if you don't think you meet all the criteria above, drop your resume, and we'll take a look – you might be great for another role or another time!
