Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Help us build a thoughtful, high-velocity talent acquisition engine, one that makes it easier for great people to discover us, have an exceptional candidate experience, and ultimately become part of the team.

As a Talent Acquisition Intern, you’ll work closely with the recruiting team across the full hiring process. You’ll get hands-on exposure to managing candidate pipelines, interview coordination, recruiting operations, and the systems and processes that enable a growing team to hire well.

You’ll have the opportunity to understand how a recruiting function works end-to-end, identify what can be better, and help build the systems and workflows that make hiring more effective.

Where you'll leave your mark?

    • Build and manage candidate pipelines: Keep candidate pipelines organized, up to date, and moving across our ATS system.
    • Create a great candidate experience: Coordinate interviews, manage scheduling, and ensure candidates receive timely, thoughtful, and clear communication throughout the process.
    • Keep the hiring engine moving: Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to track candidates, follow up on next steps, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.
    • Make recruiting workflows better: Identify bottlenecks and repetitive processes, and help improve recruitment workflows, systems, and operating rhythms.
    • Bring structure to the process: Maintain accurate candidate data, recruiting documentation, and reporting so the team has visibility into the hiring funnel.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • You communicate clearly, thoughtfully, and with empathy — especially when interacting with candidates.
  • You take ownership: if you see something that needs to get done, you don’t wait for someone else to notice it.
  • You’re detail-oriented and understand that small things can have a big impact on the candidate experience.
  • You’re curious about how systems work and enjoy learning new tools and processes.
  • You have a bias toward action and are comfortable figuring things out as you go.
  • You naturally spot things that are broken, inefficient, or unnecessarily manual — and want to fix them.
  • You are available to join us immediately.
  • Prior experience in recruiting, HR, operations, or an ATS is a plus — but curiosity, ownership, and learning velocity matter more.

Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

About Utorg

Founded in 2019, Utorg builds the infrastructure behind stablecoin payments: on/off-ramps, self-custodial wallets, and crypto cards. Over 2 million users across 130+ countries already buy, hold, and spend crypto through our app. On the B2B side, the same rails power 2,100+ platforms, with $2.4B+ moved to date.

Fully MiCA-authorized across the EEA. PCI DSS Level 2 certified. Backed by Dragonfly, TA Ventures, and Hypra.

We are an international team of young and ambitious professionals united by a passion for innovation and a belief in the decentralized world. And now, we are looking for a Head of Crypto Vertical who will strengthen our team and contribute to the success of our products and the bright future of Web3.

Mission:

Build and scale the crypto business line (crypto card, non-custodial wallet, trading) into an autonomous, high-growth vertical. Own the P&L and drive revenue, profitability, and sustainable, regulation-aware growth.

What you will do:

  • P&L ownership for the crypto vertical: budgeting, forecasting, pricing, margin management.

  • Partnerships & BD: identify, negotiate, and close strategic deals (issuers/processors, liquidity, payroll/HR SaaS, neobanks, exchanges, aggregators, merchants).

  • Market & regulation: track competitors, user behavior, and rules (KYC/AML/MiCA, card schemes, on/off-ramps) and turn insights into action.

  • Team: own the hiring plan and build a lean business team from zero (growth/performance, BD/partnerships, ops/support). Set clear responsibilities and KPIs, coach for performance, and make tough calls when someone doesn’t deliver.

  • Cross-functional leadership: align Product, Legal/Compliance, Ops, Data, and Marketing around clear commercial targets and SLAs.

  • Reporting: present plans, numbers, and decisions to founders/execs.

First 3–6 months (hands-on):

  1. You’ll run ops yourself, set up the initial processes (pipelines, SLAs, weekly KPIs, monthly P&L), and hire the core business team (growth, BD, ops).

  2. You’ll launch acquisition channels (target LTV/CAC ≥ 3 in one priority segment) along with the CMO and close the first 2–3 strategic B2B/B2B2C deals.

  3. Once ops are stable, you shift even more time to scaling and strategy.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in fintech/crypto/payments/banking with GM / Head of BizDev / Head of Business-type ownership.

  • Proven P&L delivery on revenue, profit, margin, and volume targets.

  • Hands-on launching/scaling crypto payments/wallets/cards/trading (B2C and B2B/B2B2C).

  • Strong command of unit economics (CAC, LTV, ARPU, margin, payback), pricing, and portfolio prioritization.

  • Deep partnerships/BD track record: sourcing, negotiating, contracting, integrating, and making deals perform.

  • Solid grasp of KYC/AML/MiCA, card-scheme, and on/off-ramp constraints; productive work with Legal/Compliance.

  • Strong analytical skills (SQL/BI a plus) and clear executive communication in English.

What this role is not:

  • This is not a classic product manager or chief product officer role.

What we offer:

  • Established yet dynamic environment: We’re a well-rooted fintech company with several profitable products and structured business units. Historically strong in B2B2C across Europe, we’re now doubling down on building and scaling a consumer-facing crypto vertical

  • Real traction, not just vision: Our non-custodial wallet and crypto card are already live with confirmed product-market fit in multiple segments (with strong revenue and 6-month retention metrics). Crypto IBAN is in development, and trading is at the concept stage. There's still untapped potential in segments we haven’t entered yet.

  • Ownership and autonomy: This role is essentially a mini-CEO position. You’ll have full P&L ownership, a direct line to the founders, and the mandate to build a standalone business unit with a 2+ year strategic horizon. You'll shape product offerings, growth strategy, and go-to-market channels.

  • Hands-on early stage, high leverage long-term: In the first 3–6 months, you’ll build the business team (growth/BD/ops), establish processes (pipeline, SLA, KPI, P&L), and drive predictable growth via performance marketing, brand, sales, and strategic partnerships. From there, it’s all about scale and long-term impact.

  • Resources and support where it matters: You’ll get the budget and resources aligned with your roadmap, autonomy in decision-making, and influence over a broader fintech product portfolio (wallet, card, IBAN, trading) in one of the most promising markets: crypto in the EU.

dein profil

  • Fachliche Führung und Kommunikation: Du kannst Kollegen technisch weiterentwickeln, Standards setzen und Arbeitsweisen verbessern. Gutes Deutsch, gutes Englisch für Kunden, Dokumentation und Herstellerkommunikation.
Plus, wenn du es hast: Tiefe Proxmox-/Ceph-Spezialisierung · IaC/Ansible · Firewall-/VPN-/WAF-Erfahrung (z. B. WireGuard, OpenVPN, iptables/nftables) · komplexe Migrationsprojekte · Monitoring-/Observability-Tiefe (z. B. checkmk, Prometheus)

warum wir?

jobs.title: Creative Copywriter
jobs.excerpt: This is not a prompt-writing role. RGX is hiring a Creative Copywriter with the range and nerve to take the half-formed idea and turn it into copy that knows exactly what it came to say.
jobs.description:
This is not a prompt-writing role.

RGX is hiring a Creative Copywriter with the range and nerve to take the half-formed idea and turn it into copy that knows exactly what it came to say.

You’ll be expected to think before you write. To question the brief. To find what the client is trying to say before they know how to say it.

AI can help with speed, starting points, and blank pages that need to stop being blank. But the job is not to make more copy.

The job is to make the right copy survive.

Who is RGX

RGX is a digital marketing agency built for home service businesses: HVAC, pest control, plumbing, electrical, and the trades that keep homes running.

Our clients are not hobby businesses. They’re doing $1.5M+ in annual revenue, investing in growth, and tired of marketing that sounds like everyone else’s.

We help serious service businesses get clearer about what they offer, sharper about who they serve, and more direct about why a customer should choose them.

This category is crowded with recycled promises, bloated landing pages, weak ads, and copy that mistakes noise for confidence. We’re here to cut through that. Strategy first. Story second. Every sentence accountable to the business it serves.

The role

As our Creative Copywriter, you’ll write for the agency and 3 to 6 clients across digital channels. You’ll need to move between brands without flattening them into the same voice.

This is a senior role for someone who wants ownership, not just assignments. Someone who wants to leave their mark, not sit behind the work and wait to be told what the brand sounds like.

You’ll team up with the Creative Director, clients, and other stakeholders to shape strategy, sharpen messaging, and decide what the copy needs to do before the first line gets written.

Expect pushback. Expect edits. Expect to defend the line when it matters and cut it when it doesn’t. You should always be ready to speak your mind when the work is too safe to matter.

Requirements

What you’ll do

  • Write copy across emails, paid ads, landing pages, websites, blogs, content offers, campaign concepts, scripts, direct mail, and the odd assignment that does not fit neatly into a box.
  • Build hooks, headlines, messaging angles, and concepts that give the work a stronger starting point.
  • Turn client notes, strategy, and rough ideas into copy with a clear job to do.
  • Adapt your voice across different brands, audiences, and service categories without losing precision.
  • Work with creative, strategy, design, and account teams to make the work stronger before it goes out.
  • Use AI when it helps you move faster. Know when it starts making the work flatter.
  • Find the pressure point. Cut the filler. Make the sentence earn its place.

Who we’re looking for

  • You have 3+ years of professional copywriting experience across digital channels, with the judgment expected from a senior creative role.
  • You have strong English fluency, grammar, and command of language. Native or near-native level.
  • You can show a portfolio with range: ads, emails, landing pages, websites, campaigns, scripts, blogs, or other work that proves you can think across formats.
  • You can manage multiple clients and projects without turning every brand into the same voice.
  • You take feedback without getting precious. You also know when a line deserves to be defended.
  • You can work at agency pace without using speed as an excuse for lazy thinking.
  • You’re willing to learn the home services category and write for business owners who care about leads, revenue, trust, and reputation.
  • Experience with HVAC, pest control, plumbing, electrical, or other home service categories is a plus. It is not required.

You’ll probably thrive here if

  • You care about the craft, but you do not hide behind it.
  • You read a brief and start looking for what is missing. You know how to help build the direction before the writing starts.
  • You can write the plain version before the clever one.
  • You know a headline is not good because it sounds nice. It is good because it does the job.
  • You like creative standards. You want pushback. You want to work with people who challenge the first draft because they believe the stronger one is still in there.
  • You can find the pressure point in a landing page, a paid ad, a client email, or a campaign line. Not every assignment will feel glamorous. The standard stays the same.
  • You want to leave a mark, not disappear into the production line.

Benefits

Perks and details

Position Overview

We are looking for an experienced Sales Development Representative (SDR) to join a growing US-based commercial furniture business. This is a full-time remote opportunity focused on B2B outbound sales, lead nurturing, prospect qualification and business development.

The successful candidate will work with company-provided, enriched lead lists and engage US-based decision makers across the hospitality, events, education, religious and municipal sectors.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and work through company-provided B2B lead lists to generate qualified sales opportunities.
  • Conduct outbound prospecting through cold calling, email, LinkedIn and SMS.
  • Nurture longer sales-cycle opportunities until prospects are genuinely sales-ready.

    • General Managers
    • Facility Directors
    • Purchasing and Procurement Officers
    • Parks and Recreation Directors
    • School Administrators
    • Church Administrators
    • Event and Venue Managers

  • Identify qualified opportunities and hand them over to Territory Sales Representatives.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed CRM records for all prospect interactions and opportunities.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects and manage multiple opportunities through different stages of the sales cycle.
  • Use sales intelligence and prospecting tools to research accounts and personalise outreach.
  • Use AI tools to support prospect research, personalisation, summarisation and productivity.
  • Provide regular reporting on activity, pipeline progression, qualified opportunities and follow-up requirements.
  • Work independently and proactively without requiring constant supervision or prompting.
  • Potentially support opportunities further through the sales process, with closing ability considered a strong advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

Success will not be measured purely by call or appointment volume.

The primary focus will be on:

  • Number and quality of qualified opportunities generated.
  • Opportunities accepted by the Territory Sales Representatives.
  • Quality and accuracy of qualification.
  • Consistent pipeline development and lead nurturing.
  • CRM accuracy and documentation.
  • Follow-up discipline.
  • Self-managed reporting and communication.
  • Ability to maintain a consistent outbound activity level.
  • Contribution to revenue-generating opportunities.

Requirements

Experience

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in B2B outbound sales, SDR, BDR, lead generation, lead nurturing or inside sales.
  • Proven experience generating qualified opportunities for an outside or field sales team.
  • Experience selling into the US market is highly advantageous.
  • Experience working with longer B2B sales cycles is preferred.
  • Experience within SaaS, BPO, commercial services, furniture, hospitality, events or other B2B environments is advantageous.
  • Previous fully remote experience is strongly preferred.

Communication

  • Fluent, professional spoken English is essential.
  • Must have clear, neutral and easily understood English suitable for speaking with US-based decision makers.
  • Strong telephone presence and confidence communicating without relying heavily on scripts.
  • Excellent objection handling, rapport building and questioning skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with senior business decision makers.

A voice sample or recorded call example is required with every candidate submission.

Self-Management

The successful candidate must be highly independent and capable of managing their own workload.

You should be able to:

  • Manage your own daily pipeline and priorities.
  • Work effectively without constant supervision.
  • Proactively report on activity and progress.
  • Identify when follow-up is required without being prompted.
  • Maintain consistent productivity while working remotely.
  • Demonstrate strong accountability and ownership.

Sales & Technology Skills

Experience with the following tools is advantageous:

  • EspoCRM or comparable CRM platforms
  • RingCentral or similar cloud-based diallers
  • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
  • ZoomInfo
  • Apollo.io
  • Mautic or other marketing automation platforms
  • ChatGPT and other AI productivity/research tools
  • Magento 2

Candidates do not need experience with every platform, but should demonstrate strong overall CRM, sales technology and prospecting-tool proficiency.

Working Hours

Monday to Friday

US Eastern Time: approximately 09:00–17:00 ET

South African Time: approximately 15:00–23:00 SAST, shifting to approximately 16:00–00:00 SAST during US winter time.

Candidates must be comfortable and able to maintain this schedule on a long-term basis.

Short-term or temporary evening availability will not be suitable.

Remote Working Requirements

  • A dedicated, quiet home office.

  • Reliable backup power for outages/load shedding, such as an inverter or UPS.
  • Mobile internet/data failover.
  • A demonstrated ability to remain operational during power or connectivity interruptions.

Candidates will be required to confirm their internet and backup power arrangements in writing.

Close Calendar and Month End Close

ERP Implementation

• Serve as a core accounting contributor on Montera's forthcoming ERP implementation, from requirements gathering through data migration, testing, and go live.

Financial Reporting and Communication

• Prepare monthly reporting packages and financial statements that are ready for leadership, investor, and board level review.

• Maintain a consistent, proactive communication rhythm with the Controller and CFO. No surprises: issues get flagged early, with options attached.

• Support internal and external reporting deliverables for auditors, lenders, and investors.

Operational Accounting (PTP, OTC, and Cash)

• Own procure to pay and order to cash processes, including vendor bill processing, pay runs, customer invoicing, collections, and cash applications.

Capitalization, Project Accounting, and Technical Accounting

• Support capitalization of development and construction costs, maintain construction in progress schedules, and validate asset classifications.

• Draft accounting policies and technical memos, including capitalization policy, lease accounting (ASC 842), and revenue recognition, aligned to data center development and operating models.

Requirements

What You Bring

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance.

• CPA and 5+ years of progressive accounting or finance experience, including time in capital intensive industries. Comfortable operating as a hands on individual contributor.

• Strong technical accounting expertise: U.S. GAAP and financial reporting, project accounting and CIP, capitalization policy and lease structures (ASC 842), and audit ready financial statement preparation.

• Experience with operational accounting (PTP, OTC, and cash), including direct exposure to treasury or cash management.

• Prior involvement in an ERP implementation or systems conversion is strongly preferred.

• Clear, proactive written and verbal communication. This role reports to leadership regularly and needs to be trusted to flag issues before they become problems.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in an environment without established process, and to build that process rather than wait for it.

• High attention to detail combined with strong judgment, balancing rigor, speed, and practicality.

Benefits

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, including holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Recognition & Rewards: Annual bonus program to share in our success.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

Requisition Number: 105969

AI GTM Specialist

Location:You will have the flexibility to work fully remote from anywhere across Arizona.

Insight at a Glance

  • 14,000+ engaged teammates globally
  • $8.2 billion in revenue in 2025
  • Certified as a Great Place to work in 9 Countries in 2025
  • Fortune 500 Company (No. 447) in 2025

We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in cloud, data, AI, cybersecurity, and intelligent edge, we guide organizations through complex digital decisions.

Agentic Workplace Consultant

Role Overview

The Agentic Workplace Consultant is a pivotal role within Insight’s Google Solution Line (GSL), bridging the gap between management consulting and technical execution. Leveraging our Google Solution Line’s business value expertise and the technical depth of Insight’s Agentic Factory, this consultant will work directly with Line of Business (LOB) stakeholders to move organizations from "AI-Curious" to "AI-Native".

Your mission is to drive Agentic Velocity by identifying high-value business friction points and architecting autonomous, multi-step workflows using Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise. You will be responsible for defining the ROI of digital labor and ensuring that AI agents are not just "science projects" but production-grade assets that solve real-world problems.

Key Responsibilities

1. Workflow Discovery & Persona Design

  • Engage with LOB leaders in HR, Finance, Sales, and Engineering to map existing manual workflows to autonomous Gemini Agent capabilities.
  • Conduct "Agentic Audits" to identify "micro-frictions" that can be solved with no-code tools or the Gemini Agent Developer Kit (ADK).
  • Develop custom user personas to understand stakeholder roles and assess the specific benefits of the Agentic Workplace platform for their daily operations.

2. ROI & Business Case Development

  • Lead the development of board-ready Business Cases, including 3-year TCO comparisons between legacy seat-based costs and agentic productivity gains.
  • Establish and report on ROI Value Metrics, such as labor hours saved and accelerated engineering output.
  • Identify and define KPIs that connect AI usage directly to quantifiable business outcomes.

3. Mutual Evaluation Plan (MEP) Execution

  • Quarterback the MEP process, a data-driven approach designed to tailor workshops to a customer's current state.
  • Lead "Day-in-the-Life" sessions showcasing Gemini Enterprise features integrated into real-world business scenarios.
  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure data readiness and security hardening for AI adoption.

4. Strategic Advisory & Enablement

  • Act as a trusted advisor to C-Suite executives, maintaining relationships and overcoming account blockers to grow deals and drive adoption.
  • Support the "No-Code Academy" by training non-technical "Citizen Developers" to build custom agents via Gemini Agent Designer.
  • Establish long-term governance models, including agent identity and access management (AIAM) protocols.

Required Expertise & Experience

Category

Requirement

Experience

5+ years in management consulting or strategic sales, ideally with a focus on SaaS or AI transformation.

Product Knowledge

Deep understanding of Google Workspace, Gemini Enterprise, and the Agent Developer Kit (ADK).

Business Acumen

Mastery of TCO/ROI modeling and the ability to articulate technical benefits to C-Level stakeholders.

Methodology

Proven experience in Organizational Change Management (OCM) and delivering structured evaluation processes like MEP.

Exceptional discovery skills with the ability to "uncover the why" behind business processes.

jobs.title: Head of Market Growth
jobs.excerpt: Rockstar is recruiting for a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis by operating a marketplace for shared living.
jobs.description:
Rockstar is recruiting for a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis by operating a marketplace for shared living. They are a fast-growing, fully remote team rapidly expanding into new markets and looking for a leader to build the systems that turn every new launch into a thriving marketplace.

The Role the Company Needs

The company is entering new markets faster than ever, and they need a leader who can build the repeatable system that turns every new launch into a thriving, self-sustaining marketplace. As their Head of Market Growth, you'll own the strategy and execution behind taking a market from launch to scale by creating exceptional experiences for hosts and members, building a powerful local vendor ecosystem, and establishing the growth flywheel that fuels long-term expansion.

The Person They Are Looking For

You're equal parts builder, operator, and strategist. You love creating order from ambiguity, know how to launch new markets from the ground up, and have a track record of building partnerships and systems that continue producing results long after you've stepped away. You're energized by ambitious growth goals, thrive in cross-functional environments, and enjoy developing teams while solving complex marketplace challenges.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day

  • Launch Markets – Lead the strategy and execution for every new market, ensuring each reaches 250 active units within six months while maintaining high quality standards.
  • Build Playbooks – Design and continuously improve the repeatable systems, processes, and launch playbooks that allow markets to scale beyond the initial launch phase.
  • Grow Ecosystems – Build national and local partnerships with brokers, lenders, contractors, property managers, photographers, and other vendors that help hosts succeed.
  • Drive Referrals – Create referral engines that encourage members, hosts, and vendors to become active advocates who fuel organic growth.
  • Improve Outcomes – Partner with Product, Sales, Marketing, Member Experience, and Host Experience to improve occupancy, NPS, move-in quality, and host success.
  • Analyze Performance – Use data to evaluate launch performance, identify growth opportunities, reduce customer acquisition costs, and optimize every market.
  • Lead Teams – Hire, coach, and develop Market Account Executives and ecosystem leaders while aligning multiple departments around successful launches.
  • Test & Learn – Run structured experiments, evaluate results, and continuously improve how the company enters and scales new markets.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful

  • Market Leadership – 10+ years leading marketplace, growth, partnerships, or operations teams, including significant ownership of a business, market, or P&L.
  • Launch Experience – Proven success launching or scaling new markets for a marketplace, franchise, or multi-location business.
  • Partnership Expertise – Experience building vendor, channel, or partner ecosystems that create measurable business value.
  • Growth Mindset – Demonstrated success improving customer experience, retention, referrals, or other organic growth drivers.
  • Systems Thinking – Ability to design scalable operating models instead of solving problems one market at a time.
  • Analytical Skills – Comfortable making decisions using metrics such as CAC, LTV, occupancy, funnel conversion, referrals, and NPS.
  • People Leadership – Experience building, leading, and developing high-performing distributed teams.
  • Executive Influence – Strong communicator who can align executives and cross-functional partners around ambitious growth initiatives.

The Interview Process

  1. Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by the Hiring Manager.
  2. If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a phone call with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  3. If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with their Chief Growth Officer for one (1) hour.
  4. If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with members of their leadership team for one (1) hour. The panel interview will require a candidate to work on an assessment where you will showcase your market launch skills to the panel for discussion.
  5. If warranted, the final interview would be with their President.
  6. If warranted, then they move to offer!

Compensation, Benefits, and Perks

  • Fully remote position – the company swears!
  • Competitive compensation package including an equity incentive plan and company-wide bonus opportunity
  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Company provided life insurance policy
  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • 401(k) plan
  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis
  • $175,000 – $200,000 a year

Compensation is based on the role's scope, national market benchmarks, the person's expertise and experience, and the impact of their contributions to our business goals. In addition to base compensation, there is potential for a bonus based on growth targets.

Please note: Although the job posting says it's in Atlanta, Georgia, this is a fully remote position. This is a result of their Applicant Tracking System requiring a location to post the role on LinkedIn.

Notice to Applicants

The company participates in E-Verify. All new employees are required to complete an I-9 form and be authorized to work in the United States. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the E-Verify process.

The company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

The company may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist their recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact them.

jobs.excerpt: ABOUT TETRASCIENCETetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence.
jobs.description:
ABOUT TETRASCIENCE

TetraScience is the Scientific Data and AI Company building Tetra OS, the operating system for scientific intelligence. We help the world’s leading life sciences firms turn fragmented scientific data into AI-native assets and scientific workflows that accelerate discovery, development, and manufacturing. TetraScience’s growing ecosystem of strategic partners includes NVIDIA, Databricks, Thermo Fisher Scientific, Snowflake, Google, and Microsoft.

In connection with your candidacy, you will be asked to carefully review “The Tetra Way,” authored by our CEO, Patrick Grady; it is impossible to overstate the importance of this document, and you should take it literally as you decide whether our mission, culture, and expectations are right for you.

The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior .NET Engineer to join our dynamic team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in designing and developing high-performance, scalable applications using C#, the .NET Framework, and TypeScript. The role involves implementing automated testing and leveraging GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines. The candidate should also be proficient in production debugging and possess excellent communication skills. Knowledge and experience with AWS cloud services are also essential.


What You Will Do

  • High-Performance, Distributed, and Scalable Application Design:
    • Architect, design, and maintain distributed applications, ensuring high performance, scalability, and security.
  • Full-Stack Development:
    • Develop backend services (primarily C#/.NET and TypeScript) and cloud APIs, as well as modern, responsive front-end applications using TypeScript/React.
  • Microservices Architecture:
    • Design and implement loosely coupled, independently deployable services using AWS services such as DynamoDB, RDS, SQS, Lambda, API Gateway, and others.
  • Automated Testing:
    • Create and maintain automated unit, integration, contract, and end-to-end tests across microservices and UI layers.
  • CI/CD Pipelines:
    • Use GitHub Actions to implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines for both backend services and front-end applications.
  • Production Debugging & Optimization:
    • Diagnose and resolve production issues in distributed systems, including service-to-service communication, CPU/memory/network bottlenecks, and AWS service performance.
  • Observability & Operational Excellence:
    • Instrument services using OpenTelemetry (or equivalent) to enable earlier fault detection, clearer alerting, and stronger operational visibility. Contribute to SLO definition and MTTR reduction efforts across the platform.
  • Collaboration & Communication:
    • Work closely with product managers, tech leads, and other engineers to deliver reliable, maintainable, and scalable solutions. Communicate technical decisions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

What You Will Bring

Required Skills

  • Strong proficiency in backend service development using C#/.NET.
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and React for front-end UI.
  • Experience building and operating software in both on-premises/customer-hosted environments and cloud-native multi-tenant environments, with an understanding of how debugging, deployment, and scaling differ between the two.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS DynamoDB, RDS, SQS (or an equivalent cloud provider) in production environments.
  • Experience with microservices patterns (service discovery, API gateway, messaging/queueing, data partitioning).
  • Experience with automated testing at multiple levels.
  • Strong Git skills and hands-on experience with GitHub Actions for CI/CD.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for distributed systems in production.
  • Solid understanding of cloud-native architecture and AWS best practices.
  • Familiarity with observability tooling and practices (OpenTelemetry, structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics-based alerting) to support proactive issue detection.

Desirable Skills

  • Familiarity with containerization (Docker) and experience defining AWS infrastructure using CloudFormation (or AWS CDK) to support predictable and repeatable environments.
  • Experience with performance tuning and designing scalable solutions.
  • Experience with, or exposure to, scientific instrument software / Chromatography Data Systems (CDS) e.g., Waters Empower, Thermo Chromeleon, Cytiva UNICORN, Agilent OpenLab, along with knowledge of instrument integration pattern and practices is a strong plus.

Soft Skills Needed:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Strong collaboration skills in cross-functional teams.
  • Analytical mindset with high attention to detail.

Why TetraScience

  • Mission-driven: your infrastructure directly enables scientific drug development processes that save and extend lives.
  • Builder culture: everyone ships — engineers, managers, and leadership. No passengers.
  • Technically ambitious: we are rebuilding how science-grade data infrastructure works, not deploying off-the-shelf solutions.
  • AI-first: we apply AI across every layer of the platform today, not as a future roadmap item.
  • Competitive compensation, meaningful equity, and strong benefits.

Benefits

  • 100% employer-paid benefits for all eligible employees and immediate family members
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • 401K
  • Flexible working arrangements - Remote work
  • Company paid Life Insurance, LTD/STD
  • A culture of continuous improvement where you can grow your career and get coaching

No visa sponsorship is available for this position

The salary range for this position is $170,000-$220,000 USD. The salary range posted reflects our target baseline for this role. Final compensation is determined by a thorough evaluation of factors including the candidate’s specific experience, localized market data, and internal team equity.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewThe American Association for Cancer Research (AACR), with more than 61,000 laboratory, translational, and clinical researchers; population scientists; other health care professionals; and patient advocates residing in 143 countries and territories around the world, is the first and largest organization in the world dedicated to advances in all areas of high-quality, innovative cancer research.
jobs.description:
Overview

The American Association for Cancer Research (AACR), with more than 61,000 laboratory, translational, and clinical researchers; population scientists; other health care professionals; and patient advocates residing in 143 countries and territories around the world, is the first and largest organization in the world dedicated to advances in all areas of high-quality, innovative cancer research. Its mission is to prevent and cure all cancers. The programs and activities of the AACR foster the exchange of new knowledge among scientists and physicians in cancer research as well as in related sciences. The AACR publishes ten peer-reviewed scientific journals and an award-winning magazine for cancer patients and their loved ones; convenes topical scientific conferences and an annual meeting that draws more than 22,500 participants; offers educational workshops that train young investigators in a variety of scientific and clinical areas; funds research fellowships, career development awards, and research grants for both senior and junior investigators; raises public awareness of the progress in the biology, detection, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of cancer; engages actively in advocacy for increased federal research funding and other national policies that accelerate progress against cancer; and interacts with regulatory agencies to support regulatory science and policy. Learn more at www.aacr.org.

About the Project

AACR Project Genomics, Evidence, Neoplasia, Information, Exchange (GENIE) is a publicly accessible international cancer registry of real-world clinico-genomic data assembled through data sharing between 20 of the leading cancer centers in the world. Through the efforts of strategic partners Sage Bionetworks and cBioPortal, the registry aggregates, harmonizes, and links clinical-grade, next-generation cancer genomic sequencing data with clinical outcomes obtained during routine medical practice from cancer patients treated at these institutions.

Job Summary:

AACR Project GENIE® is seeking an experienced Senior Biostatistician to provide statistical leadership across an international real-world clinico-genomic data consortium. This individual will serve as the primary statistical resource for the project, partnering with clinicians, scientists, data managers, and external collaborators to design, execute, and interpret observational research studies using real-world oncology data.

The successful candidate will independently develop statistical analysis plans, contribute to study protocols and publications, design appropriate analytical methodologies, and perform statistical programming in R. This role requires expertise in real-world data, including electronic health records, cancer registries, genomic sequencing data, and longitudinal clinical outcomes, as well as the ability to translate scientific questions into rigorous and reproducible statistical analyses.

This role is ideal for a senior biostatistician who enjoys working independently and leading the statistical design, programming, and interpretation of multiple concurrent studies within a collaborative multidisciplinary environment. The successful candidate will be a self-starter who takes initiative and balances big picture strategy with execution against project goals, bringing an entrepreneurial, visionary approach and the ability to conceive of, execute, and communicate innovative solutions. Additionally, the successful candidate should bring a strong passion for mission-driven causes and a commitment to advancing cancer research through high-quality, collaborative, statistical science.

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the statistical subject matter expert for AACR Project GENIE, providing consultation to investigators, collaborators, and project leadership on study design and analytical strategy.
  • Collaborate with investigators, pharmaceutical clients, and academic institutions to design observational studies using real-world clinico-genomic data
  • Develop statistical analysis plans (SAPs), define study populations, cohorts, endpoints, and analytical methods
  • Contribute statistical expertise to research protocols, study design, and publication planning
  • Perform statistical programming and analyses using R
  • Interpret results and contribute to manuscripts, abstracts, presentations and consortium reports
  • Willing to experiment with new analytic methods as needed.
  • Advise project leadership on appropriate statistical methodologies, and study design
  • Ensure analyses are reproducible, well documented, and adhere to best practices
  • Collaborate with data managers, investigators, and pharmaceutical clients to assess data quality, completeness and fitness for analysis
  • Independently lead the statistical aspects of multiple concurrent observational research studies from study conception through analysis and publication
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

Education:

M.S. or Ph.D. in Biostatistics, Epidemiology, Statistics, or a closely related quantitative discipline.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of post-graduate experience providing end-to-end statistical support for observational research studies using real-world data (RWD), including electronic health records (EHRs), cancer registries, genomic data, claims data, or other longitudinal clinical data sources.
  • Demonstrated experience designing statistical analysis plans (SAPs), contributing statistical sections of research protocols, defining study cohorts, endpoints, and analytical methodologies for observational clinical research.
  • Prior peer-reviewed publications as a statistical collaborator
  • Strong proficiency in R is required, including statistical programming, data manipulation, reproducible workflows, and production-quality analytical code.
  • Experience applying statistical methods commonly used in oncology and observational research, including survival analysis, Kaplan-Meier estimation, competing risks, longitudinal analyses, regression modeling, propensity score methods, missing data approaches, and sensitivity analyses.
  • Experience collaborating with clinicians, scientific investigators, and data management teams to translate research questions into statistically rigorous study designs, with well-honed relationship building skills and outstanding, articulate, and persuasive communication, public speaking, and presentation abilities.
  • Experience interpreting and communicating statistical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences, with exceptional strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities and a proven track record of success in solving complex and dynamic situations.
  • Entrepreneurial, visionary approach with the ability to conceive of, execute, and communicate innovative solutions.
  • Must be a self-starter who takes initiative and can balance big picture strategy and execution against goals.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Python proficiency
  • Experience working with clinico-genomic oncology datasets
  • Familiarity with REDCap or other EDC platforms
  • Experience with Git/GitHub strongly preferred

This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role. You will not be implementing a third-party ERP from scratch — you will be deeply learning a proprietary system and becoming the person the entire company relies on when they have questions, encounter issues, or need training. If you have strong experience with recognized ERP platforms, learn new systems quickly, and take genuine ownership of making sure people actually use the tools they are given, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability during US business hours
  • Become the central ERP knowledge owner for a growing company building its operational infrastructure
  • High-ownership role with direct impact on how the entire organization runs day to day

What You'll Work On

ERP Onboarding and Training

  • Learn the company's proprietary ERP system thoroughly and become the internal subject matter expert
  • Develop and deliver training materials, guides, and walkthroughs for team members across departments
  • Onboard new users and ensure they are comfortable and confident operating in the system
  • Identify knowledge gaps and proactively address them before they become workflow problems

Ongoing Support and Troubleshooting

  • Serve as the first point of contact for ERP-related questions, issues, and troubleshooting requests
  • Diagnose and resolve user issues quickly and accurately
  • Escalate complex technical issues to the appropriate internal or external team with full context
  • Maintain a support log and track recurring issues to identify patterns and systemic gaps

System Documentation and Process Management

  • Create and maintain comprehensive documentation including SOPs, user guides, and process maps for all ERP workflows
  • Keep documentation current as the system evolves and new features are added
  • Ensure team members always have access to accurate, up-to-date reference materials

System Adoption and Continuous Improvement

  • Monitor system usage and adoption across the organization and flag areas of underutilization or confusion
  • Gather feedback from users and surface improvement opportunities to leadership and the development team
  • Support testing and rollout of system updates, new modules, and workflow changes

What You Bring

  • Proven experience working with at least one recognized ERP platform such as NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Acumatica, Epicor Prophet 21, Sage, Odoo, Infor, or SAP
  • Strong ability to learn new systems quickly and become a deep subject matter expert without formal hand-holding
  • Experience training or supporting non-technical end users in ERP or similar enterprise software environments
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills with the ability to explain complex system workflows in plain language
  • Highly organized with strong documentation habits and attention to detail
  • Patient, clear communicator who can support users of varying technical ability without frustration
  • Self-directed and reliable with the ability to own a support function independently

Nice to Have

  • Experience supporting ERP implementations or system rollouts in a distribution, wholesale, or product-based business
  • Background in US accounting workflows including inventory management, order management, or financial reporting within an ERP
  • Experience creating training programs or user documentation for enterprise software
  • Familiarity with ERP customization, configuration, or module setup
  • Prior experience as an ERP administrator, power user, or internal systems trainer

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your ERP experience including which platforms you have worked with and at what depth, and explaining how you would approach becoming the go-to expert for a system you have never used before

Only candidates who submit a Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a fast learner who can go deep on a new system, train others with patience and clarity, and take full ownership of making sure ERP adoption actually happens across an organization, this role gives you the scope and the direct impact to do your best work.

Application Process Overview

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

  1. Initial Application - Submit your application and complete our prequalifying questions
  2. Video Introduction - Record an video introduction to showcase your communication skills and work experience
  3. Role-Specific Assessment - Complete a homework assignment tailored to the position (if applicable)
  4. Recruitment Interview - Initial screening with our talent team
  5. Executive Interview - Meet with senior leadership to discuss role alignment
  6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
  7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
  8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations. We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

RTG works with its local and international partners to help build digital customer experiences, establish engineering hubs and build ventures across multiple industries and domains. In this pursuit, RTG serves as a catalyst for impact and growth through events, spaces and content focused on creating impact and growth across the different interactions.

Octopus is proud to be part of the Robusta Technology Group (RTG), a leading tech consultancy group. With a decade of experience and a successful track record of delivering over 300 projects across Europe, the Middle East, and North America, RTG has established itself as a preferred employer in the Egyptian market. Octopus and Robusta are building a bridge between Europe and Africa, creating tailored hub solutions to connect companies with top talent across the globe.

Job Overview

We are seeking a detail-oriented QA Analyst with 3–5 years of experience in software quality assurance across mobile applications, web platforms, and CMS-driven digital experiences. The ideal candidate will be responsible for validating functionality, UI/UX consistency, responsive behavior, accessibility, and content quality across enterprise digital products.

This role combines functional testing, cross-device validation, content QA, and defect management, with strong collaboration across development, design, content, QA, and product teams in an Agile/Scrum environment.

Role Responsibilities

Test Planning & Test Case Design

  • Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and design specifications.
  • Create and maintain:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test scenarios
    • Regression suites
    • Edge-case validation scenarios
  • Ensure proper test coverage across functional, UI, content, accessibility, and integration requirements.

Mobile Application Testing

  • Perform functional and UI testing on iOS and Android applications across multiple devices, OS versions, and screen sizes.
  • Validate:
    • Navigation flows
    • Responsive layouts
    • Platform-specific behaviors
    • Offline behavior
    • Push notifications
    • Deep linking
    • App lifecycle scenarios
  • Test native, hybrid, and cross-platform mobile applications.

Web Application Testing

  • Execute functional, regression, exploratory, and responsive testing on websites and web applications.
  • Validate consistent behavior across:
    • Desktop
    • Tablet
    • Mobile breakpoints
  • Perform cross-browser testing on:
    • Chrome
    • Safari
    • Firefox
    • Edge

Content QA & CMS Validation

  • Review CMS-authored content and pages for:
    • Content accuracy
    • Formatting consistency
    • Brand compliance
    • Editorial standards
    • Broken links
    • Image/video rendering
    • Metadata
    • Alt text
    • URL structures
  • Perform multilingual and RTL (Arabic) content QA where applicable.
  • Validate authored content within AEM or comparable CMS environments.

UI/UX Validation

  • Compare implemented screens and pages against Figma or approved design files.
  • Identify and report:
    • Spacing inconsistencies
    • Typography mismatches
    • Layout defects
    • Responsive issues
    • Visual alignment problems
  • Ensure high visual and interaction quality across platforms.

Cross-Device & Cross-Browser Testing

  • Validate functionality and appearance across multiple browsers and devices using:
    • Physical devices
    • Emulators/simulators
    • Cloud testing platforms such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs
  • Verify responsive rendering and device-specific behaviors.

Accessibility Testing

  • Perform accessibility validation aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA standards.
  • Validate:
    • Keyboard navigation
    • Color contrast
    • Alt text
    • Semantic structure
    • Screen reader compatibility
    • Focus states
  • Use accessibility testing tools to identify and document issues.

Defect Management

  • Log clear and reproducible defects using JIRA, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
  • Include:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected vs actual results
    • Screenshots/videos
    • Environment details
    • Device/browser information
  • Track defects through resolution, retesting, and closure.

Regression & Release Testing

  • Execute regression test suites for every release cycle.
  • Support:
    • Smoke testing
    • Sanity testing
    • UAT validation
    • Production verification
  • Coordinate release sign-offs with stakeholders and project teams.

API & Integration Testing

  • Perform basic API testing using Postman or similar tools.
  • Validate:
    • API responses
    • Status codes
    • Data integrity
    • Error handling
    • Backend integration behavior

Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers, designers, content authors, product owners, and QA team members in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Backlog refinement
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify gaps in test coverage and QA processes.
  • Contribute to QA documentation, checklists, and testing standards.
  • Stay current with QA methodologies, accessibility standards, and testing tools.

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of experience in software quality assurance and testing.
  • Hands-on experience testing both mobile applications and web applications.
  • Experience performing content QA on CMS-authored websites.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Experience Manager (AEM) or comparable CMS platforms such as:
    • Sitecore
    • Optimizely
    • WordPress
    • Contentful
  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum delivery teams.

Core Technical Requirements

Mobile Testing

  • Experience testing applications on:
    • iOS
    • Android
  • Familiarity with:
    • Native apps
    • Flutter
    • React Native
    • Hybrid applications
  • Experience using:
    • Physical devices
    • Simulators
    • Emulators
  • Understanding of mobile-specific behaviors such as:
    • Permissions
    • Notifications
    • Deep links
    • Offline states
    • App lifecycle handling
  • Familiarity with TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution, or similar tools.

Web Testing

  • Strong experience with:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • Exploratory testing
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Responsive testing
  • Familiarity with browser developer tools for:
    • DOM inspection
    • Console debugging
    • Network analysis
  • Experience using BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, or similar cloud testing platforms.

Content & CMS Testing

  • Experience validating:
    • CMS-authored pages
    • Metadata
    • Alt text
    • Structured URLs
    • Structured data
    • Media rendering
    • Redirects
  • Familiarity with multilingual and RTL content validation.

Accessibility, Quality & Standards

  • Understanding of:

Tools & Collaboration

jobs.title: Programmatic Supply Manager
jobs.excerpt: Buscamos un Programmatic Supply Managerpara integrarse al equipo de Mediam Group en México.
jobs.description:
Buscamos un Programmatic Supply Managerpara integrarse al equipo de Mediam Group en México. Esta posición es responsable de maximizar el valor del inventario publicitario disponible: estructura paquetes premium, gestiona relaciones con partners y SSPs, optimiza deals y desarrolla la demanda en el mercado programático de LATAM.

El perfil ideal combina visión estratégica del ecosistema programático con capacidad analítica para detectar ineficiencias, proponer mejoras y tomar decisiones basadas en datos con autonomía e impacto directo en resultados.

Ubicación: México

Modalidad: Remota

Responsabilidades principales

1. Gestión y optimización de inventario

  • Transformar el inventario disponible en paquetes premium orientados a distintas verticales.
  • Dar seguimiento al performance del inventario por partner, país y formato.
  • Optimizar la priorización de deals según su rendimiento (eCPM).
  • Gestionar la reasignación de impresiones no vendidas hacia partners de demanda alternativos (SSPs).
  • Gestionar la conexión de nuevos partners al ecosistema de supply.

2. Gestión de inventario premium

  • Priorizar la asignación de inventario a partners estratégicos mediante deals directos y PMPs garantizados.
  • Ajustar floor prices según país y vertical para maximizar la monetización.
  • Realizar benchmarks periódicos de performance frente al mercado.
  • Detectar y resolver oportunamente inventario sin monetizar.

3. Análisis y reporting

  • Mapear y analizar la performance por publisher, SSP y país.
  • Monitorear métricas clave de la industria: fill rate, CPM, view rate y viewability.
  • Identificar ineficiencias en la cadena de supply y proponer soluciones de mejora basadas en datos.
  • Auditar deals existentes evaluando rentabilidad, frecuencia y viewability.

4. Desarrollo de demanda y Open Market

  • Impulsar el crecimiento del Open Market, activando demanda incremental a través de distintos SSPs.
  • Colaborar en iniciativas de comunicación institucional relacionadas con partners y publishers.
  • Identificar oportunidades de nuevos acuerdos comerciales que amplíen el alcance del inventario.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Ad Operations y Programmatic Supply: Experiencia previa en gestión de supply programático, ad operations y monetización de inventario digital.
  • SSPs y Header Bidding: Conocimiento de plataformas SSP y mecanismos de header bidding / PMP para optimización de deals.
  • Métricas programáticas: Dominio de fill rate, eCPM, viewability y view rate para análisis de performance y toma de decisiones.
  • Dashboards y reporting: Experiencia con herramientas de visualización y reporte de datos del ecosistema programático.
  • Mercado LATAM / USA: Conocimiento del mercado programático en LATAM y/o USA (deseable).
  • Inglés: Nivel avanzado (deseable para comunicación con partners internacionales).

Experiencia requerida

  • Experiencia previa en roles de Ad Operations, Programmatic Supply o Yield Management.
  • Experiencia demostrable en gestión de deals directos, PMPs y optimización de floor prices.
  • Conocimiento del ecosistema programático: SSPs, DSPs, publishers y cadena de suministro de inventario digital.
  • Deseable: experiencia trabajando con publishers o redes de inventario en mercados de LATAM y/o USA.

Competencias clave

  • Pensamiento analítico: Capacidad para interpretar datos de performance, detectar ineficiencias y proponer soluciones concretas basadas en evidencia.
  • Autonomía y gestión de prioridades: Habilidad para gestionar múltiples partners, deals y mercados de forma simultánea sin perder el foco en resultados.
  • Comunicación efectiva: Capacidad para interactuar con claridad con equipos internos y partners externos, construyendo relaciones de largo plazo.
  • Proactividad: Iniciativa para identificar oportunidades de mejora en el supply, anticiparse a problemas de monetización y proponer acciones antes de ser solicitadas.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?

En Mediam Group estamos redefiniendo el ecosistema de CTV a nivel global. Somos representantes oficiales de ViX en más de 14 países de Latinoamérica y operamos en la vanguardia del inventario programático premium para marcas líderes de la región.

  • Trabajar en la frontera del ecosistema CTV y programático en LATAM, con acceso a las plataformas y partners más relevantes de la industria.
  • Nuestra cultura corporativa se sustenta en valores como el accountability, la productividad, la mejora continua y la innovación.
  • Somos un equipo internacional que se fortalece en la diversidad, se apoya y crece en unidad.
  • Compensación competitiva con planes reales de crecimiento profesional.

Nos comprometemos contigo a llevar un proceso de atracción, selección y evaluación transparente, alineado a la igualdad de oportunidades.

This is a hybrid role: you’ll spend the majority of your time hands-on in the codebase, while also leading a small engineering team, helping organize delivery, mentoring engineers, and acting as the day-to-day technical point of contact for the client. If you enjoy staying close to the technology while also taking ownership of a team and its relationship with the client, we’d love to hear from you.

Our Mission, Vision, and Values

At Space Inch, we prioritize alignment with our clients and team, ensuring a deep understanding of their needs. We are committed to delivering exceptional work while supporting the personal and professional growth of our team members.

Our Stance on AI and Technology Transitions

We don't just "accept" AI; we encourage its usage to enhance productivity and code quality. We’re looking for engineers who are comfortable incorporating AI into their everyday workflow while still applying strong technical judgment knowing how to validate, challenge, and improve AI-generated output.

About Working at Space Inch

  • Our team is around 80 people, primarily based in Croatia, with members across South America, Serbia, and the US; our product team is mostly in the US, with engineering primarily in Croatia and Brazil
  • We are remote-first, though occasional travel may be required, e.g. for our annual company retreats
  • We work on end-to-end projects with a long-term vision
  • We prioritize work-life balance, even with a globally distributed team

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with Java, Spring, and Spring Boot
  • Strong backend engineering and software architecture fundamentals, with experience building and maintaining production systems and microservices
  • Strong experience with relational databases, particularly PostgreSQL
  • Experience with Docker and cloud environments
  • Familiarity with CI/CD, Kubernetes, and modern cloud infrastructure
  • Comfortable owning the full software development lifecycle, from design through production
  • Experience mentoring engineers, providing technical guidance, and supporting their professional growth
  • Comfortable organizing priorities, tracking delivery, and unblocking a team

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude, Cursor, or similar, with the ability to validate and improve AI-generated output
  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Fluent professional English, written and spoken

Key Responsibilities

Engineering — ~75%

  • Build and maintain backend applications and microservices using Java, Spring, and Spring Boot
  • Own technical decisions across architecture and system design
  • Write production-ready code, participate in code reviews, and maintain engineering quality
  • Debug and improve performance, reliability, and scalability
  • Work across databases, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and DevOps
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to improve productivity and code quality

Team Leadership & Client Communication — <25%

  • Coordinate planning, prioritization, delivery, and unblocking for a small engineering team
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and feedback
  • Act as the primary day-to-day technical point of contact for the client
  • Communicate progress, risks, priorities, and dependencies proactively
  • Translate client requirements into clear, actionable work and keep the client, team, and Space Inch aligned

What Will Make You Successful

  • You enjoy keeping both the engineering team and client aligned
  • You’re comfortable switching between coding, technical decisions, mentoring, and client communication

  • You’re curious about new technologies and how AI can make engineering teams more effective

This Role Is a Good Fit If

  • You want to remain primarily hands-on while taking on meaningful leadership responsibility
  • You’ve led a small team and enjoy the mix of coding, mentoring, and coordination
  • You’re comfortable being the technical face of the team to the client

This Role Probably Isn’t for You If

  • Your experience is primarily people management rather than technical leadership
  • You prefer someone else to handle client communication and team delivery

Department Overview

Within the Video Security & Access Control (VS&AC) business unit at Motorola Solutions, we are helping solve some of the biggest challenges around safety and physical security by developing advanced artificial intelligence (AI) technologies and products. Avigilon, a Motorola Solutions brand, designs, develops, and manufactures advanced AI, video analytics, network video management software and hardware, and surveillance cameras that help change the way people interact with their security systems.


Job Description

Reporting to the Group Product Manager, AI & Analytics, you will own the vision, strategy, and execution for key AI and analytics initiatives across the Avigilon platform. You'll be part of an empowered product team operating with a start-up mindset inside a large enterprise.

Artificial Intelligence is transforming the physical security landscape, and this role is at the center of that evolution. You will bring a proven track record of having shipped AI/ML products at scale, taking complex models out of research and deploying them into production environments serving high-volume, real-world workloads. In this role, you will turn next-generation AI, from computer vision and object detection to Vision-Language Models (VLMs), generative workflows, and agentic AI, into intuitive, high-value user workflows that make our entire end-to-end product ecosystem shine.

Beyond your own initiative areas, you will help shape how the broader video product team integrates intelligence to solve complex security problems for our customers. You will maintain clear ownership over product vision, discovery, user experience, and technical model trade-offs while collaborating cross-functionally to ensure seamless delivery.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Own Strategic AI Product Area(s):Take full ownership of assigned AI and analytics capabilities within the Avigilon platform. Define the vision for your area, set outcomes, run discovery, and drive the multi-quarter roadmap for high-scale AI capabilities in close partnership with AI research and engineering teams.
  • Bridge AI Research & Technical Scale:Engage deeply with AI Platform Engineering and AI Research teams to evaluate technical trade-offs around model accuracy, inference latency, compute-to-serve costs, infrastructure scaling, and edge vs. cloud deployment. Translate cutting-edge AI capabilities into well-framed problem statements and intuitive operator experiences.
  • Lead Continuous Discovery:Run a rigorous market discovery practice. Conduct customer interviews, observe security workflows in the field, analyze usage data, and synthesize findings to ensure AI capabilities solve real operational pain points rather than serving as "technology-first" novelties.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Platform Alignment:Partner with Video Management Software (VMS), Access Control, Appliances, and Devices Product Management teams to ensure AI features feel like unified platform experiences across the entire ecosystem.
  • Define and Own Scale Metrics:Build the measurement framework for your assigned AI capabilities. Instrument your product to track adoption, field accuracy, inference reliability at scale, engagement, and business impact. Use data to validate hypotheses, refine models, and make the case for future investment.
  • Influence Across the Organization & Field Engagement:Work with Sales, Support, Training, and Product Marketing to ensure successful launches, strong feedback loops, and customer enablement. Create technical value propositions, respond to field inquiries, and help align stakeholders around AI priorities.

Qualifications:

  • Experience:5+ years of Product Management experience delivering software, cloud, or enterprise solutions, with a demonstrated track record of shipping AI/ML-driven products or capabilities at production scale (e.g., serving thousands of active users, processing high-volume streaming data, or managing large-scale inference workloads).
  • Production AI/ML Depth:Deep understanding of computer vision, deep learning, LLMs/VLMs, and analytics workflows, with the technical fluency to engage meaningfully with AI researchers on model deployment, optimization, latency trade-offs, and cost-to-serve at scale.
  • Empowered Product Thinking:Exceptional critical thinker who is decisive, possesses both technical and business acumen, and has a proven track record of taking complex AI products from research/discovery through to commercial deployment.
  • Continuous Discovery Practice:Experience running customer discovery, conducting field interviews, and translating qualitative and quantitative insights into product strategy and clear requirements.
  • Systems & Scale Thinking:Ability to visualize how edge-to-cloud AI implementations interact at scale, balancing model execution on local hardware versus cloud/on-prem compute costs, bandwidth constraints, and system load.
  • Cross-Functional Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and relationship skills to present product strategy to senior leadership and align cross-functional engineering, hardware, and marketing teams without direct authority.

What Sets You Apart:

  • Large-Scale GenAI or Agentic AI Deployment:Experience launching or scaling products in production that leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Model Context Protocol (MCP), or multi-step AI agents.
  • AI Prototyping:Ability to rapidly stand up AI-generated prototypes to explore possibilities, test hypotheses, and iterate on workflows before engineering build.
  • Security & Computer Vision Domain Knowledge:Prior experience deploying computer vision models or video analytics at scale within physical security, video management systems (VMS), or IoT/hardware environments.
  • Cloud + On-Prem Hybrid Architecture:Experience scaling products that bridge cloud and on-premise deployments, or managing edge-to-cloud model distribution strategies.
