jobs.description:
About VFX

VFX Financial is one of the UK’s fastest-growing FinTechs, helping complex organisations move, manage, and protect money across borders. Built for specialist sectors, multi-jurisdiction structures, and high-compliance environments, we support businesses whose needs go beyond standard banking. We’re selective about who we work with because exceptional service requires focus and commitment.

With six international offices, five regulatory licences, and an 83% CAGR over the past three years, we’re scaling rapidly and earning industry recognition along the way — including the Financial Times FT1000: Europe’s Fastest Growing Companies 2026, CNBC UK’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, Wealth & Finance FinTech Awards 2025, and the Business Growth Award from Business Awards UK.

Behind it all is a team of ambitious VFXers united by collective ownership, a focus on growth, and a shared passion for solving complex problems.

About the Role

We’re seeking a detail-driven and highly capable Back-End Software Engineer to join our engineering team and contribute to the core systems powering VFX’s global financial infrastructure. You will work across complex, high-value domains including multi-currency account architecture, payment routing, treasury operations, risk management, compliance workflows, and API-driven client integrations.

This role is suited to someone who brings discipline, precision, and a strong engineering mindset. You will thrive if you enjoy building resilient, scalable and secure systems that serve sophisticated clients operating across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments. This is an opportunity to deepen your expertise within a regulated FinTech while making a tangible impact across a platform used by global businesses.

This role can be hybrid at our office in Portimao or fully remote across Portugal.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with engineering, product, operational SMEs, and wider stakeholders to translate complex requirements into robust technical solutions.

  • Architect, implement, and rigorously test high-quality .NET applications with a focus on performance, reliability, and scalability.

  • Produce clean, maintainable, and well-documented code aligned with VFX engineering standards.

  • Proactively identify and remediate defects through detailed root-cause analysis.

  • Maintain and enhance existing applications, ensuring resilience and operational efficiency across our .NET ecosystem.

  • Conduct peer code reviews to ensure quality, maintainability, and adherence to engineering best practices.

  • Create comprehensive technical documentation to support future development, onboarding, and architectural clarity.

  • Remain current with emerging .NET technologies and best practices, implementing improvements that strengthen the competitiveness and robustness of our platform.

  • Embed security principles directly into the codebase, addressing risks proactively.

  • Partner with QA teams on test planning and execution to uphold VFX’s high software quality standards.

  • Actively participate in Agile ceremonies, contributing to predictable delivery, improved collaboration, and continuous improvement across sprints.

Key Challenges

  • Building and maintaining enterprise-grade backend systems within a regulated financial environment.

  • Translating complex financial concepts — payments, FX, reconciliation, treasury workflows —into robust engineering solutions.

  • Balancing speed, innovation, and long-term stability across critical systems.

  • Managing competing priorities across stakeholders, systems, and domain areas.

  • Ensuring scalability, security, and operational consistency in a rapidly evolving environment.

Candidate Profile

  • Demonstrates technical rigor, attention to detail, and ownership of outcomes.

  • Able to operate with clarity in complex environments, navigating ambiguity with composure.

  • Communicates confidently across technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Thrives in agile, iterative delivery environments, contributing proactively to team performance.

  • Approaches engineering with discipline and pride, ensuring solutions are secure, reliable, and future-proof.

  • Works effectively both independently and within a high-performing team.

Preferred Background

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in .NET development, delivering scalable, production-grade applications.

  • Strong proficiency in DDD, CQRS, and clean architecture with practical application in prior projects.

  • Solid experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and integration layers.

  • Proficient in unit testing frameworks (NUnit, xUnit) and mocking tools (NSubstitute, Moq).

  • Strong SQL Server or relational database experience, including schema design and performance optimization.

  • Skilled in Git-based version control workflows, including branching strategies and code review processes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Experience in fast-paced, agile engineering environments.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience building and maintaining DevOps pipelines, ideally using GitHub Actions.

  • Exposure to messaging technologies such as Azure Service Bus or gRPC.

  • Previous experience in the financial sector and familiarity with industry-specific constraints.

  • Practical use of tools like Jira within Agile delivery frameworks.

Success Measures

  • Delivery of secure, high-quality, high-performance .NET features that support business and client objectives.

  • A maintainable, well-structured codebase aligned with VFX’s architectural standards.

  • Positive feedback from engineering peers, testers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.

  • Reduced defects, improved stability, and enhanced system performance.

  • Demonstrable contribution to sprint predictability, velocity, and cross-team alignment.

  • Strict adherence to regulatory, security, and operational standards.

Benefits at VFX

We offer more than just perks — we offer ownership.

Our benefits include:

  • Generous Profit Share Plan (PSP)

  • Potential equity opportunities via the Company Share Option Plan (CSOP)

  • Competitive salary

  • Annual all-expenses paid company incentive trip abroad

  • Flexible learning & development budget

PSP & CSOP Details

At VFX, the biggest benefit is the opportunity to act like an owner. Through our Profit Share Scheme (PSP), every team member has a stake in the business by sharing in the profits.

To show you what that looks like, in 2025, PSP participants received over £1,000,000. Historically, VFX has also offered equity opportunities via Company Share Option Plan (CSOP), where more than 80% of eligible VFXers chose to become shareholders — a powerful reflection of the belief and commitment that drives VFX forward.

If you care about building something meaningful, take pride in your work, and are motivated by impact — you’ll thrive here.

Next Steps

If you are successful, you will be contacted for an initial call with the People Ops Team, followed by a test and virtual technical interview.

NMI, a global leader in payment technologies, allows software and sales professionals to deliver payment innovations to their clients without having to build payment expertise in house. We democratize the latest payments technology so that everyone can realize the benefits of easy payments across the full spectrum of commerce. Our mission is to use our expertise to enable more payments, in more ways and more places.   • Align, Trust & Go. We debate openly, listen carefully and challenge thoughtfully. Once we decide, we move forward together - holding ourselves accountable to our commitments, and focusing on what matters most to our customers. That alignment creates momentum.

Why Reeco

At Reeco, we live by our core values - Heart: Humility, Excellence, Ambition, Respect, Transparency, and Trust. We believe that by putting both heart and mind into everything we do, we can transform the hospitality industry. Join us and help build the future of hospitality tech.

Customer success isn't simply about managing accounts. It's about building trusted partnerships, understanding customer goals, driving adoption, and ensuring customers continue to realize measurable value from the Reeco platform. At Reeco, we're looking for an Senior Customer Success Manager to own that journey.

You'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers, ensuring they successfully adopt Reeco, achieve their business outcomes, and continue to grow with us. Na Zup, acreditamos que o futuro é construído por pessoas que desafiam o presente. Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que transformam o mercado e elevam a experiência dos nossos clientes.

Valorizamos o crescimento contínuo dos Zuppers, incentivando cada pessoa a trilhar caminhos que impulsionem sua evolução profissional.
Por meio do Processo Seletivo Interno (PSI), você pode explorar novas tecnologias, projetos e oportunidades de carreira, em um processo transparente, acessível e alinhado aos seus objetivos.

Buscamos um(a) profissional para atuar na construção e evolução de nossa arquitetura de dados, garantindo a escalabilidade, qualidade e governança em ambientes complexos de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse. Como Especialista, você será peça-chave na definição de padrões técnicos, otimização de processos e na colaboração estratégica com times multidisciplinares para potencializar o uso de dados na organização.

O que você fará por aqui

  • Construir pipelines de ingestão, transformação e integração de dados em ambientes escaláveis.
  • Desenvolver e manter arquiteturas robustas para Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Garantir a qualidade, governança e segurança dos dados em todas as fases do ciclo de vida.
  • Implementar e otimizar processos de ETL/ELT com foco em performance e confiabilidade.
  • Definir padrões técnicos e melhores práticas para o uso eficiente das plataformas de dados.
  • Atuar na integração de múltiplas fontes e destinos de dados, promovendo interoperabilidade.
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para alinhar soluções de dados à estratégia da organização.

O que esperamos que você saiba

  • Domínio avançado de SQL para manipulação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Sólida experiência em Python ou Scala aplicada à engenharia de dados.
  • Experiência comprovada com Spark em processamento distribuído.
  • Conhecimento profundo em arquitetura e implementação de Data Lake, Data Warehouse e Lakehouse.
  • Vivência prática com ferramentas de ETL/ELT em ambientes cloud.
  • Experiência avançada em modelagem e governança de dados em escala organizacional.
  • Conhecimento e vivência em plataformas cloud como Azure, AWS ou Google Cloud.

O que acontece após minha aplicação na vaga interna?

Confirmada sua candidatura e analisado que seu perfil faz sentido para a posição escolhida, comunicaremos via e-mail a liderança e BP imediatos sobre sua aplicação em seleção interna.

jobs.excerpt: Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.
jobs.description:
Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

Summary of Position

Teladoc Health is seeking a Senior/Mid Software Engineer – Mirth / Healthcare Interoperability to join our engineering organization and build, enhance, and support healthcare integrations that enable the secure and reliable exchange of clinical and operational data.

This is a hands-on engineering role focused on Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability. The engineer will design and implement complex integration workflows, troubleshoot production interfaces, collaborate with internal teams and external healthcare partners, and contribute to the evolution of our integration platform.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in Mirth Connect and HL7v2, combined with solid software engineering, integration, debugging, and production support skills. Experience with FHIR, EHR/EMR integrations, and healthcare interoperability standards is highly valued.

Key Responsibilities

Healthcare Integration & Engineering

  • Design, develop, configure, test, deploy, and maintain healthcare interfaces using Mirth Connect.
  • Develop complex integration workflows for HL7v2 message parsing, transformation, validation, routing, and delivery.
  • Develop reusable and maintainable JavaScript-based transformations and business logic within Mirth Connect.
  • Integrate healthcare systems using TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, SFTP, and other integration protocols.
  • Translate business and technical requirements into robust, scalable, and production-ready integration solutions.
  • Collaborate with internal engineering teams, healthcare organizations, and external vendors to design and implement interfaces.
  • Contribute to the design and evolution of healthcare interoperability solutions and integration architecture.
  • Identify opportunities to improve integration performance, reliability, maintainability, and operational efficiency.

Production Support & Reliability

  • Monitor and support production healthcare interfaces and integration workflows.
  • Diagnose and resolve issues involving message processing, transformation, routing, connectivity, certificates, and downstream systems.
  • Troubleshoot network and protocol-level issues across MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
  • Perform root-cause analysis for production incidents and implement sustainable corrective actions.
  • Improve interface reliability through effective logging, monitoring, alerting, error handling, and operational automation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation supporting critical production integrations.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet appropriate security, reliability, and operational standards.

Collaboration & Technical Leadership

  • Partner with product managers, architects, engineers, analysts, and external vendors to deliver healthcare integration solutions.
  • Communicate technical designs, issues, risks, and solutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Participate in technical design and architecture reviews.
  • Conduct code and configuration reviews and promote standards for secure, scalable, and maintainable integration development.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including interface specifications, mapping documents, design documents, and operational runbooks.
  • Mentor engineers and serve as a technical resource for Mirth Connect, HL7v2, and healthcare interoperability.
  • Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across the integration platform.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering and/or healthcare integration experience, including 3+ years of hands-on experience developing and supporting Mirth Connect integrations.
  • Strong, practical knowledge of HL7v2, including message structure, segments, fields, components, repetitions, acknowledgments, and common message types.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and implementing Mirth Connect channels, including connectors, filters, transformers, and JavaScript.
  • Strong experience with TCP/MLLP, HTTP/HTTPS, and SFTP.
  • Proven ability to troubleshoot connectivity, message delivery, transformation, routing, and downstream system issues in production environments.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript for Mirth transformations and integration logic.
  • Understanding of SSL/TLS, certificates, keystores/truststores, and secure endpoint configuration.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle practices, source control, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with FHIR, including FHIR resources, APIs, and integration patterns.
  • Experience with EHR/EMR integrations and healthcare information exchange.
  • Experience with CCDA/C-CDA.
  • Familiarity with XDS.b and XCA.
  • Experience working with healthcare interoperability standards and architectures.
  • Experience developing or integrating with REST APIs and web services.
  • Experience with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases.
  • Experience with other healthcare interface engines such as Rhapsody, Corepoint, Cloverleaf, or similar technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Mirth Connect Certified Developer (MCCD) certification.
  • Participation in Mirth Connect, healthcare interoperability, or open-source technical communities.

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

  • Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission.

  • Chart your career path with meaningful opportunities that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.

  • Join a multi-faceted community that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

Cloud Network Architect– Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a forward-thinking software development company dedicated to building innovative solutions that help businesses automate and optimize their operations. We leverage cutting-edge technologies to create scalable, secure, and user-friendly applications.
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a skilled Cloud Network Architect to join our dynamic team and contribute to our mission of transforming business processes through technology.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Cloud Network Architect
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary: $150,000–$180,000 Annually
Experience: 8+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking a Cloud Network Architect to design strategies, reference architectures, and platform capabilities that span multiple cloud providers — AWS, Azure, GCP, and selectively OCI — for enterprises operating on more than one cloud by deliberate choice. The role focuses on portability, abstraction layers, federated identity, cross-cloud networking, and platform offerings that hide cloud-specific complexity from product teams. The ideal candidate has architected meaningful multi-cloud capabilities, understands the trade-offs between portability and cloud-native depth, and brings strong opinions grounded in production experience.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Define multi-cloud strategy, target-state architecture, and adoption guardrails across AWS, Azure, GCP, and OCI as relevant.
  • Design federated identity, SSO, and cross-cloud authorization patterns that let workloads and engineers move between providers without compromising on least-privilege, auditability, or operational simplicity.
  • Architect cross-cloud networking including transit hubs, private connectivity, and zero-trust patterns.
  • Establish reusable infrastructure-as-code patterns that abstract cloud-specific implementations where appropriate.
  • Define container, Kubernetes, and serverless strategies that work consistently across providers.
  • Design data architecture strategies for cross-cloud data movement, residency, and analytics.
  • Drive multi-cloud observability, security monitoring, and unified policy enforcement, designing approaches that work consistently across providers and avoid the complexity of fragmented per-cloud tooling stacks.
  • Establish FinOps practices that operate consistently across multiple cloud providers.
  • Lead disaster recovery and business continuity strategies that span clouds.
  • Partner with security architects on multi-cloud security models, KMS strategies, and key management.
  • Provide guidance to engineering teams on when to use cloud-agnostic versus cloud-native patterns.
  • Produce high-quality architecture artifacts — context diagrams, sequence diagrams, decision records, and reference designs — that capture key technical decisions clearly enough to be understood months or years later.
  • Engage with cloud providers and partners to evaluate roadmap alignment.
  • Stay current with multi-cloud platform and tooling developments, regularly review release notes and community discussions, and translate noteworthy advances into concrete recommendations and adoption proposals for the team.
Required Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in cloud architecture roles.
  • Hands-on architecture experience across at least two major cloud providers.
  • Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security across multiple providers.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code and policy-as-code across clouds.
  • Experience designing federated identity and SSO across cloud platforms.
  • Solid understanding of Kubernetes, container platforms, and managed cloud services.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Multiple cloud certifications across providers.
  • Track record of leading multi-cloud architecture initiatives.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with abstraction platforms (Crossplane, Pulumi, Terraform CDK).
  • Familiarity with cloud-agnostic observability platforms.
  • Experience driving large-scale cloud-to-cloud migrations.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with multi-cloud mandates.
  • Public talks or writing on multi-cloud architecture.

jobs.title: Principal Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: This is a hands-on engineering and technical leadership position.
jobs.description:
This is a hands-on engineering and technical leadership position. You will move fluidly between building production infrastructure, architecting multi-tenant isolation, designing pipeline and policy enforcement, leading strategic architecture decisions, and mentoring engineers. Your success is measured by what every product inherits: a compounding system that outlasts your direct involvement.

What You'll Do

Platform Architecture & Infrastructure Engineering

  • Drive the platform's architecture and runtime direction, including convergence onto one container-orchestrated runtime, tenancy-grade isolation between client engagements, and the contracts every product inherits.
  • Design composable infrastructure as code at fleet scale, with clear input contracts and state boundaries, published as versioned templates and images for every core component.
  • Make the environment lifecycle a one-command operation: created by merging a pull request, destroyed by deleting it, with automated proof nothing is left behind.
  • Design identity and network as a federated, credential-free system — one identity per engagement, just-in-time audited privileged access, separate internal and external edges.
  • Ship telemetry and cost visibility out of the box for every service: standard alerting, service-level objectives on live data, fault injection, and per-engagement cost attribution including AI spend.

Delivery Pipelines, Security & Compliance Engineering

  • Drive the shared delivery pipelines every product runs through, and the pluggable gate framework that quality, security, and AI-governance checks plug into with block-on-fail enforcement.
  • Implement security and compliance as code: release-blocking scanning on every repository, policy and admission control, signed and attested artifacts, and an audit trail and software bill of materials, including AI components, on every build as SOC2 / ISO 27001 evidence.
  • Package the AI-assisted development environment as a versioned, first-class deliverable, and enforce the sandbox boundary for coding agents: default-deny egress, short-lived credentials, isolated shared runners.
  • Run the platform as a product measured by developer outcomes — setup time, time to first commit, pipeline duration, gate false-positive rate, adoption — pruning or redesigning controls when governance burden outgrows benefit, and proving every golden path by shipping through it yourself.

Technical Leadership & Stakeholder Influence

  • Lead the platform's strategic architecture decisions — multi-tenancy, cloud posture, identity provider, network edge — as evidence-based decision documents with real trade-offs, and own the security and reliability evidence the program reports against.
  • Serve as a go-to technical authority on platform architecture and delivery engineering, consulted by senior stakeholders at the design and strategy stages, translating trade-offs and platform risk into actionable guidance, and mentoring engineers and vendor partners with observable improvement in design quality and production readiness.

What You'll Need

Required

  • 15+ years in software engineering, platform or infrastructure engineering, or a closely related technical field.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise in infrastructure as code at fleet scale (Terraform or OpenTofu with Terragrunt or equivalent): module architecture, remote state, multi-environment topology.
  • Demonstrated experience operating multi-tenant Kubernetes platforms in production: GitOps, network and admission policy, workload identity, tenant isolation.
  • Proven track record building CI/CD as a shared platform (GitHub Actions or equivalent), with reusable workflow contracts, fleet-scale branch protection, and enforced quality and security gates.
  • Strong hands-on command of cloud identity and network security on Azure/AWS/GCP or a comparable hyperscaler: workload identity federation, RBAC, private networking, WAF, DNS.
  • Substantive experience with security and compliance as code: scanning toolchains (Snyk, Checkov, Trivy), policy engines (OPA, Kyverno, Azure Policy), supply chain controls (signing, provenance, SBOM), and SOC2 / ISO 27001 control evidence.
  • Production observability with OpenTelemetry or equivalent: collector topology, SLOs and error budgets, alert routing, incident management, fault injection.
  • Has built and operated production application software as a software engineer, in at least one of Go, Python, or TypeScript, and is fluent in testing strategy, code review, trunk-based delivery, and release management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; ability to translate complex technical topics to diverse audiences, including executive stakeholders.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and cross-functional product team collaboration.

Preferred / Additional Qualifications

  • Experience building platforms for consulting, advisory, or professional services, including client-isolation and data-residency requirements.

jobs.excerpt: About Us:Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy.
jobs.description:
About Us:

Spreedly is the Intelligent Payments Platform for businesses that want to own their payments strategy. Founded in 2007 and headquartered in Durham, NC, we give merchants, platforms, and fintechs a single API to connect to 150+ payment gateways and 40+ payment methods across 100+ countries, along with the intelligence to decide where every transaction should go. We're vendor-agnostic by design. Our customers choose their providers, keep their payment data portable, and never have to rebuild their stack to adopt something new.

Payments are getting more complex, not less. Every new market, payment method, fraud tool, and now every AI agent checking out on a shopper's behalf adds another integration and another decision. Spreedly turns that complexity into an advantage. Our PCI Level 1 vault keeps cards and network tokens portable across providers. Smart routing and retries recover revenue lost to avoidable declines. Fraud and 3DS tools plug in with a single API call. And our payments intelligence turns transaction data into decisions merchants can act on. As agentic commerce moves from experiment to real sales channel, we're building the infrastructure that lets merchants accept agent-initiated payments through the providers they already trust.

For the people who work here, that means hard technical problems at real scale, billions of dollars in annual transactions, at a moment when the rules of commerce are being rewritten. If you want ownership and work that shows up directly in your customers' revenue, you'll fit right in.

About the Role

Spreedly is looking for a Support Engineer to take on our most complex customer issues and bridge the gap between support and engineering. You'll go beyond identifying a bug: you'll investigate where it occurs, explain its impact, and give engineering the evidence and technical context needed to resolve it.

You'll join an international support team that serves customers, partners, prospects, and internal colleagues. Our Tier 1 team provides round-the-clock support, while Tier 2 handles deeper technical investigations. This role brings additional engineering depth to that work, particularly in troubleshooting SDKs and complex payments integrations.

This is a hands-on, player-coach role. You'll work directly on difficult cases while helping teammates develop their technical skills. We also want this hire to help lay the foundation for a potential Tier 3 support function. That expansion and any future team leadership role are subject to leadership approval, rather than guaranteed next steps.

We expect roughly 60% of your time to focus on complex customer tickets, most of them from our top-tier accounts. The remaining time will involve retrospectives, customer advocacy, cross-functional projects, and coaching.

Responsibilities

  • Own complex technical investigations, particularly for our top-tier customer accounts. Read and navigate source code, analyze logs, and inspect API and SDK behavior to pinpoint issues.

  • Reproduce customer issues in test environments so findings are confirmed before they reach engineering.

  • Build clear, actionable engineering escalations that explain the problem, where it occurs, and potential approaches to resolving it, with engineering retaining final decisions on changes.

  • Bring SDK troubleshooting expertise to support for our Checkout SDK and share that knowledge across the team in collaboration with engineering.

  • Help manage incidents and keep customers informed, translating technical findings into clear explanations and advocating for their needs across departments.

  • Identify recurring patterns across cases, lead retrospectives, and turn findings into improvements that prevent repeat issues and reduce prolonged back-and-forth with engineering.

  • Improve documentation, share investigation techniques, and coach support teammates through unfamiliar technical problems.

  • Take ownership of cross-functional projects, from defining the problem through completing and rolling out the work.

Candidate Requirements

  • A foundation in software development through professional experience, coding education, or another hands-on path, with the ability to investigate code and explain technical findings.

  • Experience troubleshooting SDKs and working with APIs, including understanding how integrations behave in a web environment.

  • Customer-facing technical experience and the ability to communicate clearly with customers during complex or prolonged investigations.

  • The ability to coach others and lead work without formal authority. You don't need a previous management title, but you should be able to guide teammates and collaborate effectively with engineering.

  • Independent problem-solving and project ownership: you can work through ambiguity, move an investigation forward, and know when to bring others in.

  • Payments experience is strongly preferred because it will help you ramp quickly into complex customer cases. We're also open to candidates who can demonstrate the technical depth and learning ability to succeed without a payments background.

Additional Skills We Value

  • Familiarity with Ruby on Rails and SDKs across React, Android, or iOS.

  • Creating support processes, technical content, or tooling, including practical applications of AI in support.

  • Experience with Zendesk, Jira, or similar ticketing systems.

  • Spanish-language proficiency

We Offer Our US-Based Employees:

  • Competitive salary + Equity
  • Outstanding Medical and Dental benefits, including 100% employer-paid option
  • Company-paid Life and Disability insurance
  • Optional vision and supplemental insurance options, and various Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA)
  • Open Paid Time Off policy + 12 weeks of paid leave for new parents
  • Matching 401(k) plan (5% up to $5,000 yearly)
  • $1,000 annual professional development stipend
  • Monthly home working/digital lifestyle stipend, new MacBook, and one-time accessory reimbursement
  • Access to company-paid professional coaching service
  • Visits to HQ in Durham, North Carolina for remote employee
Spreedly Product Offering:

Spreedly provides an open payments platform. The platform’s connectivity provides payments performance. Key products and services include:

Connect — A unified API that integrates with hundreds of payment gateways, processors, and alternative payment methods worldwide, including digital wallets. Merchants access the global payments ecosystem through one connection.
Vault — A PCI-compliant secure repository for payment methods. Merchants store card data once and reuse it across any payment service, reducing PCI scope and protecting cardholder data at scale.
Optimize — Workflow-driven routing and retry logic that directs each transaction to the best-performing gateway in real time. On average, 7.9% of failed transactions succeed immediately when retried on a secondary gateway. This is where merchants recover lost revenue and increase authorization success rates.
Protect — A flexible fraud and authentication layer, incorporating advanced fraud tools and 3DS. Following Spreedly's acquisition of Dodgeball in September 2025, fraud orchestration and payment optimization now operate within the same platform.
Resolve — Centralized management and reporting that reduces operational silos, strengthens security, and improves billing control across a merchant's entire payment operation.
More Coming Soon! - Keep your eyes peeled for a new product launch by EOY '26

--
What It's Like to Work Here:
We describe our team as "Spreedlings": diverse, forward-thinking, and driven by a shared belief that a more open payments ecosystem benefits everyone. The company operates with a culture built on transparency, courageous collaboration, and self-driven leadership. The team values simplicity in both product and process, and approaches problem-solving with genuine curiosity.
--
We champion the ethical, creative use of AI—if you’re someone who pairs human judgment with modern AI tools to work smarter and drive bigger impact, you’ll thrive here.
--
Spreedly is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering, cultivating, and preserving a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We actively work to drive out even unintentional discrimination in our hiring processes via practices like blindly graded work samples, structured interviews, and diversity awareness training.
Due to the sensitive nature of what Spreedly does - handling payment data - finalist candidates must complete a successful background and reference check.
At this time Spreedly is unable to provide sponsorship for employment, and we are not set up to support remote employees who reside in New York. In order to be considered for employment, applicants must be currently legally authorized to work in the job location country and not require future sponsorship in order to continue working in that country.
We appreciate your interest in our company. Because of the high volume of resume flow, we may only respond to those candidates that we think will be a potential fit.

jobs.title: Agentic Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.excerpt: what to expect We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same.
jobs.description:
what to expect

We are a startup digital agency, and no two projects, clients, or even days look the same. But all of our days are agentic-first.

In ecommerce we build on Shopify and Liquid and Next.js, with custom AWS microservices and apps that take Shopify well past the defaults.

On the marketing side we build highly customised sites in Next.js and React, with careful design and animation and a real focus on how the page performs and feels.

In automotive and other industries we build full platforms, AI tools and integrations, from stock-car locators to configurators and a lot more.

Across all of it, we bring AI into the work through our own products.

Here nothing will be fixed. You will work across changing projects and settings, on long builds that run for months and shorter spikes to figure out how a business can actually use AI, and you will help us rethink how agency work is done.

Sound like your kind of place? Here is what we need from you.

your competencies

We're looking for engineers who are excited by agentic and AI-native systems - turning models into products that hold up under real users, real load, and real time. You'll build LLM integrations, agents, and RAG pipelines, treat prompt engineering as a code discipline, and make systems reliable through evaluation, guardrails, and solid testing. Whether you're building your craft or already shaping the AI architecture of a project, we want to hear from you. We hire across levels - here's what each looks like at OH-SO:

Junior AI/Agentic Engineer

You're building your engineering craft - curious about why and how things work, not afraid to get your hands dirty, and eager to grow. You implement from clear briefs - LLM integrations, prompt scaffolding, RAG components - and write the tests and evaluations that keep them honest, comfortable using AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) under supervision. You want to understand why and how we're building things, ask what the purpose and the constraint are before you start, and your work is reviewed before it merges.

AI/Agentic Engineer (typically 2-3+ years)

You own an AI feature end-to-end - an agent flow, a RAG pipeline, an integration across its error paths and guardrails - delivered independently with light oversight. You build evaluation harnesses to prove quality rather than assume it, use AI coding tools autonomously in production, and contribute to the shared AI backbone (the AI-brain MCP and skill library).

Senior AI/Agentic Engineer (typically 5+ years)

You own the AI outcome of a project - you define the integration shape, the multi-agent architecture and orchestration, the evaluation strategy and guardrails, and you write the ADRs that document why. You're the technical credibility in the room, contribute patterns and skills back to the shared backbone, and mentor the engineers around you. You use AI to define new ways of working, and you think in long runtime: the AI landscape will shift underneath the project, so you build for inheritance and replaceable layers. You help us move forward as an organization and you act as an AI evangelist.


What you bring to the table, at any level:

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI systems in production - integration, agents, RAG, or similar

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and/or TypeScript, and confidence designing and working with APIs

  • A habit of treating prompt engineering as a code discipline — with a real understanding of evaluation, guardrails, and reliability

  • A solid grasp of testing and quality: you build systems that hold up under real use, not just in a demo

  • A genuine interest in agentic systems and where the AI landscape is heading - and the judgement to apply it well, not just talk about it

  • Openness to collaborating with cross-functional teams - from designers to strategists - as well as directly with clients

  • You’re enjoying being part of a team, not a remote desk which prefers to work in isolation most of the time.

what you can look forward to

The stack you’ll work with:

  • Languages & core: Python and/or TypeScript, strong RESTful API design

  • AI & agents: LLM integration, RAG and vector databases, agent frameworks, multi-agent orchestration, MCP and agent infrastructure, prompt engineering, context and memory management, evaluation and guardrails

  • Testing & quality: automated testing, evaluation harnesses, observability and monitoring of AI systems

  • Cloud & infrastructure: cloud platforms, containerisation with Docker and Kubernetes, CI/CD (infrastructure-as-code with Terraform a plus)

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, Google Antigravity

Who you will work with

We are a bunch of colleagues originally from similar backgrounds who got tired of how things were usually done and set out to find better ways. That is the whole reason this company exists, and it is still what we are doing.

About Gumball Digital

Gumball Digital is a performance marketing company that builds and operates consumer-focused digital brands. Through brands like ActiveTrials, Benefinds, and Homebase, we combine proprietary technology, data, and marketing expertise to create high-performing customer acquisition platforms.

Gumball builds consumer web experiences and the internal tools used to manage them. Our work spans multiple brands and often combines product requirements, design, compliance, partner integrations, and engineering.

We are hiring a Technical Project Manager to turn business needs into clear, buildable work and guide that work from intake through release. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who is comfortable working closely with engineers, reviewing smaller changes, and using assisted coding tools to ship limited fixes.

What you will do

  • Turn stakeholder requests into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and test plans before engineering begins.
  • Manage intake and triage. Identify duplicate, incomplete, blocked, or low-priority work and, as you learn the products, take increasing ownership of what is ready to enter the engineering queue.
  • Coordinate work that crosses brands, products, or teams without allowing requirements and decisions to fragment across conversations.
  • Keep Linear current and make each ticket the reliable record of scope, decisions, ownership, and status.
  • Work with engineers to identify technical constraints, separate front-end, backend, data, and integration work, and surface missing decisions early.
  • Coordinate quality assurance with stakeholders and engineering. Make sure important user journeys are tested on the devices customers use and that results are recorded.
  • Review smaller pull requests for alignment with the ticket, obvious implementation risk, and test evidence. Escalate larger or riskier changes to the Engineering Lead.
  • Use Large Language Model (LLM)-assisted coding tools to deliver small, well-scoped fixes. You are responsible for understanding the proposed change, reviewing the diff, testing the result, and following the normal release process.
  • Guide work through development, quality assurance, technical review, and production release. Communicate what is moving, what is blocked, who owns the next action, and what is ready to ship.
  • Support production incidents when assigned by the Engineering Lead.

What we are looking for

  • Experience managing software delivery for a small, fast-moving engineering team.
  • Strong requirements writing: you can turn an incomplete request into behavior an engineer can build and another person can verify.
  • Working knowledge of modern web applications, browser behavior, application programming interfaces (APIs), databases, and GitHub pull requests.
  • Enough code literacy to review a focused diff, recognize when a change exceeds your depth, and safely deliver a small fix with assisted coding.
  • Experience coordinating quality assurance and releases across technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
  • Clear written communication and disciplined follow-through.
  • Availability during the team’s Eastern Time workday.

Helpful, not required

  • Experience with Linear, GitHub, Slack, Next.js, or TypeScript.
  • Experience with consumer web forms, multi-brand products, compliance-sensitive changes, affiliate marketing, or partner integrations.
  • Experience using LLM-assisted development tools in a controlled review and release process.

How the team works

You report to the Engineering Lead and work directly with engineers and stakeholders. Engineers own feature implementation. You own clarity, coordination, and delivery, with room to handle smaller technical changes yourself. The Engineering Lead retains responsibility for high-risk technical review, production decisions, and incident assignments.

Salary

$65,000.00 - $80,000.00 USD per year (Remote (United States))

Flosum is the only enterprise-grade DevOps, Data Backup & Archive, Trust Center, and Data Seeding platform built 100% native on the Salesforce platform. Our customers are among the most demanding in the world: Fortune 500 enterprises in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, government, life sciences) who require SOX compliance, zero-trust architecture, and audit-grade governance. jobs.excerpt: We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Software Architect to provide technical leadership and architectural direction across complex, high-scale software and data platforms.
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Software Architect to provide technical leadership and architectural direction across complex, high-scale software and data platforms.

This role will have a particular focus on Identity Resolution, including the design of systems that accurately identify, match, link, and resolve individuals, households, organizations, devices, and other entities across large and diverse datasets. In addition to Identity Resolution, the Principal Software Architect will be responsible for designing scalable enterprise applications, distributed systems, large-scale data-processing platforms, and low-latency APIs and services.

The ideal candidate will have deep, hands-on expertise across Java, Python, Scala, Apache Spark, and SQL, with strong experience designing systems on AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks.

This is a senior technical leadership role requiring the ability to define architectural direction, evaluate technology choices, solve complex engineering challenges, and work closely with engineering teams to ensure solutions are scalable, reliable, secure, maintainable, and performant.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and drive the architecture for enterprise-scale Identity Resolution platforms and services.
  • Design systems for deterministic and probabilistic identity matching, entity resolution, identity graphs, record linkage, deduplication, and identity consolidation.
  • Develop architectures capable of resolving identities across large, diverse, and rapidly changing datasets.
  • Design solutions supporting both real-time and batch Identity Resolution use cases.
  • Define strategies for identity matching, confidence scoring, survivorship, source prioritization, identity linking, and identity lifecycle management.
  • Design and optimize low-latency APIs and services capable of supporting high-throughput, highly available production workloads.
  • Architect distributed applications and services using Java, Python, and Scala, selecting the appropriate language and framework based on workload and system requirements.
  • Design high-scale data-processing pipelines and platforms using Apache Spark, including Spark workloads implemented in Scala and Python.
  • Design and optimize data solutions using Snowflake and Databricks for large-scale analytical and operational workloads.
  • Design highly efficient data models and SQL-based solutions supporting transactional, analytical, and Identity Resolution workloads.
  • Define appropriate caching, concurrency, partitioning, indexing, persistence, and data-access strategies to meet stringent performance and latency requirements.
  • Define cloud-native architectures using AWS and modern distributed computing patterns.
  • Design integration patterns between AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, internal applications, APIs, and external data providers.
  • Evaluate technologies, frameworks, databases, processing engines, and architectural approaches based on performance, scalability, reliability, cost, and operational complexity.
  • Establish standards and best practices for application architecture, API design, data architecture, distributed processing, security, observability, testing, and software development.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to translate architectural designs into practical, scalable, and maintainable implementations.
  • Provide technical direction during the development of complex systems and assist engineering teams in resolving difficult performance, scalability, and design challenges.
  • Conduct architecture and design reviews to ensure systems align with established technical standards and long-term platform strategy.
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and guide teams in optimizing APIs, applications, Spark workloads, SQL queries, and distributed-processing systems.
  • Define architectural approaches for resiliency, fault tolerance, high availability, disaster recovery, and operational monitoring.
  • Collaborate with engineering, data engineering, product, security, infrastructure, and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Mentor senior engineers, technical leads, and architects and help develop architectural capabilities across the engineering organization.
  • Stay current with evolving technologies and industry practices related to Identity Resolution, distributed systems, cloud computing, data platforms, and software architecture.

Identity Resolution Expertise

The Principal Software Architect should have significant experience designing or working with Identity Resolution, Entity Resolution, Customer 360, Master Data Management, identity graph, or similar large-scale matching systems.

Strong candidates should understand concepts such as:

  • Deterministic and probabilistic matching
  • Exact and fuzzy matching techniques
  • Entity and record linkage
  • Identity graphs and relationship modeling
  • Identity stitching and consolidation
  • Match confidence and scoring
  • Attribute normalization and standardization
  • Duplicate detection and resolution
  • Survivorship and golden-record strategies
  • Source reliability and attribute precedence
  • Real-time versus batch identity resolution
  • Incremental identity processing
  • Large-scale identity datasets
  • Data quality and identity accuracy measurement
  • Privacy, security, and governance considerations associated with identity data

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing complex enterprise software systems.
  • Proven experience serving as an Architect, Principal Engineer, Staff Engineer, or equivalent senior technical leader.
  • Deep experience designing and implementing Identity Resolution, Entity Resolution, identity graph, Customer 360, Master Data Management, or similar systems.
  • Strong expertise in Java, including enterprise application development, high-performance services, concurrency, and distributed application design.
  • Strong expertise in Python, including application development, data processing, automation, APIs, and distributed data workloads.
  • Strong expertise in Scala, particularly for distributed systems and large-scale data-processing applications.
  • Deep experience with Apache Spark, including architecture, optimization, partitioning, distributed execution, performance tuning, and large-scale processing.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL, including complex queries, relational data modeling, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Demonstrated ability to select appropriately between Java, Python, Scala, Spark, and SQL based on performance, scalability, maintainability, and workload requirements.
  • Strong experience designing REST APIs, microservices, distributed applications, and high-throughput backend services.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and optimizing low-latency and low-latency APIs.
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems concepts, including concurrency, caching, partitioning, consistency, resiliency, scalability, and fault tolerance.
  • Extensive experience with AWS and cloud-native application architecture.
  • Strong experience with Snowflake, including data modeling, performance optimization, security, data sharing, and large-scale data-processing patterns.
  • Strong experience with Databricks, including Spark-based processing, distributed data engineering, optimization, and production workload management.
  • Experience designing systems that span application, API, distributed-processing, data, and cloud infrastructure layers.
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles, design patterns, API design, data structures, algorithms, and application performance.
  • Experience with modern CI/CD practices, automated testing, source control, and production software delivery.
  • Strong understanding of security, privacy, authentication, authorization, encryption, and data-protection practices.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex architectural and performance problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience architecting large scale Identity Resolution platforms.
  • Experience designing Identity Resolution systems that support both high-volume batch processing and real-time API-based resolution.
  • Experience designing and optimizing large-scale Spark applications using both Scala and Python.
  • Experience with graph databases or graph-oriented data models.
  • Experience with probabilistic matching algorithms, machine learning-based matching, or advanced entity-resolution techniques.
  • Experience designing APIs with stringent latency, throughput, and availability requirements.
  • Experience with event-driven and streaming architectures.
  • Experience with containerized workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code technologies such as Terraform or CloudFormation.
  • Experience designing multi-region or highly available cloud architectures.
  • Experience establishing enterprise architecture standards and technical governance.
  • Experience modernizing legacy applications and data platforms.
  • Experience working with large-scale consumer, marketing, advertising, financial, or customer identity datasets.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Want to build the data foundation powering AI and self-serve analytics at scale? As part of Samsara's Marketing Data and Analytics (MDA) Engineering team, you will shape the technical roadmap alongside our BI and Data Science peers. You will architect core Databricks pipelines, Gold Layer tables, and semantic models, turning ambitious, ambiguous business challenges into high-value data products, autonomous agents, and cross-functional automation.

This role is open to candidates residing in the US.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Partner on defining the strategy and multi-quarter roadmap for MDA's data and AI foundation.
  • Architect and own Samsara's marketing data infrastructure: ETL/ELT pipelines, Databricks Gold Layer tables, and the core data models that power segmentation, targeting, automation, and analytics.
  • Design the semantic layers, data dictionaries, and structured documentation that enable self-serve BI and conversational analytics, partnering with the BI team to ensure core sales and marketing KPIs are built on trusted, well-modeled data.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, Sales, and R&D into clear requirements and scalable solutions, working autonomously without dedicated PM support and influencing decisions with data and sound reasoning.
  • Lead complex, cross-team initiatives end to end: stand up new data pipelines and integrations quickly, manage risk across interdependent teams, and own the reliability and data quality of what ships.
  • Serve as the senior technical lead for the team's hardest problems: raise the bar for engineering quality and code review, remove bottlenecks that slow multiple teams, and mentor engineers and analysts.
  • Drive the strategic use of AI to solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: build AI-enabled data products and agents, with the integrations, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation practices that keep them reliable and trustworthy.
  • Identify and automate manual workflows with AI across Marketing and GTM teams, taking ideas from concept to prototype to production and influencing org roadmaps.
  • Ship high-quality Python and SQL, increasingly by directing agentic coding tools, while holding a high bar for reviewing and verifying AI-generated work before it reaches production.
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or AI engineering, including deep hands-on data engineering experience.
  • Expert-level Python and SQL, with strong hands-on data modeling and DBT experience.
  • Deep experience with data warehouse and lakehouse architectures, ETL/ELT, and the modern data stack, including hands-on Databricks (or similar, such as Snowflake or BigQuery).
  • Experience building semantic layers and structured documentation optimized for AI ingestion and agentic workflows.
  • Agentic coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) are part of your regular workflow, and you verify and take ownership of AI-generated output.
  • Experience building, shipping, evaluating, and monitoring LLM or agent systems in production.
  • Track record of leading complex, cross-team data initiatives, including independent requirements gathering with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting Marketing, Sales, or Product teams.

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience working with Databricks and building AI Agents within the ecosystem.
  • Software engineering background beyond data or AI engineering, with a track record of turning ambiguous, unfamiliar problems into well-architected, delivered solutions.
  • Expertise in data visualization and building dashboards for sales and marketing KPIs.
  • Familiarity with go-to-market data and systems: CRM (e.g., Salesforce), marketing automation, web analytics, and MarTech tools.
  • Experience building interactive applications with Streamlit, Claude workflows, or web frameworks.
  • Data science, machine learning, or predictive analytics experience.
  • Comfort working in an exploratory environment, testing and iterating on new data sources and methodologies.

The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed.

The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below.

Annual Base Salary
$137,445—$231,000 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.
